Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the job:

OpenTable is seeking an Account Manager responsible for leading customer retention and revenue growth within your territory of restaurants, reporting to the Manager, Account Managers. In this role, you will be in tune with the local restaurant industry and proactively engage with restaurant customers to serve as a trusted advisor. You will be innovative in overcoming customer obstacles, provide constructive perspectives to challenge current thinking, and use our world-class technology to empower restaurants to focus on their team, their guests, and their bottom line.

Note: Applicants must live in either the Pacific Time Zone or Hawaii-Aleutian Time Zone to align with the team and market. Seattle or Hawaii residence strongly preferred. Domestic travel will be required throughout West Coast and Hawaii.

Responsibilities:

  • Cultivate and build upon existing high-level relationships to serve as a trusted advisor to restaurants and lead retention rates by aiding in re-signing customers with expired contracts.
  • Account Retention & Revenue Growth: Build and maintain strategic relationships with restaurant leadership to achieve quarterly retention and upsell targets, including contract renewals and premium marketing tool adoption.
  • Understand customer needs, identify sales opportunities to sell premium marketing tools, and achieve quarterly company goals and sales objectives.
  • Assist restaurant management with system configuration to optimize reservation flow.
  • Build and utilize data-driven presentations for ongoing business reviews and educate operators about industry trends using actionable, data-driven insights.
  • Act as an advocate and high-level point of contact for restaurant customer concerns and resolve cross-functional issues.
  • Track weekly meeting and call activity in Salesforce, conduct monthly meetings with Elite members, and capture product upgrade feedback for the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 2-3+ years of account management or equivalent experience in a restaurant/hospitality environment with validated customer service skills.
  • Residency in the Pacific Time Zone or Hawaii-Aleutian Time Zone to align with the team and market. Seattle or Hawaii residence strongly preferred. Domestic travel will be required throughout West Coast and Hawaii.
  • Deep expertise in restaurant operations and management, including comprehension of P&L and financial statements.
  • Proven ability to handle objections and comfort leading consultative sales conversations to achieve retention and revenue goals.
  • Strong writing, presentation, social, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with confidence delivering training and speaking to groups.
  • Valid driver’s license and transportation, with residency in Hawaii, Pacific, or Mountain Time Zones to align with the territory and team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • College degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience using AI tools to draft and personalize outreach, research accounts, capture interaction data, and determine future strategy.
  • Knowledge of Google Suite, Salesforce, and Apple products and operating systems.
  • Experience collaborating with marketing teams to help design and execute restaurant-specific marketing programs and promotional participation.
  • Demonstrated ability to keenly track economic and industry drivers and thrive in an unstructured, forward-thinking environment.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this United States located role is $70,000 - $80,000USD. This role is also eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

Work Environment & Flexibility:

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion:

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead an AI-native content intelligence and publishing venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Orbitwell is an AI-first content workflow that turns a professional's own judgment and stories into a consistent, firm-approved public presence. The platform captures private input through conversation, audio, and dictation, drafts voice-matched content grounded in that person's real expertise, and routes every draft through configurable firm guardrails and human verification before it reaches a ready-to-publish queue. Rather than another point solution for capture, writing, or scheduling, Orbitwell is designed to be the system of record for expert-driven publishing inside professional-services firms.

The venture begins with an initial product, 30+ validation interviews, and a working prototype to accelerate iteration and go-to-market. We are now seeking a founder to lead the venture from here.

Market Context

  • ~500,000+ US professional-services firms in wealth and legal alone (33,000 RIAs, 418,000–463,000 law firms), most under 10 people

  • Professional-services AUM/revenue is growing and consolidating: RIA assets under management +22.3% YoY to $176.8T; RIA M&A hit a record 322 deals in 2025, up from 272; law firm employment +1.4% in 2025

  • The category proving willingness to pay for this workflow, personal/employee advocacy software, is a $0.5B–$2.2B market in 2026, growing at double-digit CAGR through the early 2030s

  • Generative AI content creation, the underlying technology wave, is a $14.8B market in 2024 projected to reach $80.1B by 2030 (32.5% CAGR)

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Define the ICP wedge (creators vs. teams vs. agencies), pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Expand from internal design partners to external users (creators, teams, agencies), validate retention and willingness to pay, and build the go-to-market motion through creator-led distribution

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

How to Apply

raw.excerpt: About The OpportunityNetrix Global is looking for a client-facing Full-Stack Developer to build secure enterprise web experiences, backend APIs, and cloud-hosted applications that support Microsoft, AI, and business platform solutions.
raw.description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a client-facing Full-Stack Developer to build secure enterprise web experiences, backend APIs, and cloud-hosted applications that support Microsoft, AI, and business platform solutions.

The developer will use C#/.NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, and Azure services to deliver custom-code capabilities that are not suited to low-code platforms alone. The role includes identity integration, API design, testing, deployment readiness, and production troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate takes end-to-end ownership, communicates confidently with clients, and collaborates across AI, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and DevOps teams. Success in this role means delivering secure, tested, and responsive applications with maintainable architecture and clear operational visibility.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Participate in client discovery and translate functional and non-functional requirements into practical technical designs.
  • Develop responsive React-based user experiences and C#/.NET backend services and APIs.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization using Entra ID, OAuth, and role-based access patterns.
  • Integrate Microsoft services, enterprise systems, databases, and external APIs.
  • Design SQL data access patterns and maintain clear API contracts, error handling, and validation.
  • Write unit and integration tests; participate in peer reviews and maintain clean, supportable code.
  • Deploy and operate applications on Azure using App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights as appropriate.
  • Support CI/CD, release troubleshooting, observability, and root-cause analysis with the DevOps and Test teams.
  • Explain architecture trade-offs, estimate delivery efforts, prototype rapidly, and document technical decisions and handoff guidance.

What You Will Bring To The Table

We are looking for a professional who combines technical ownership with strong client partnership. Success in this role requires curiosity, accountability, practical judgment, and the ability to move work forward while keeping stakeholders informed.

  • Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders during discovery, delivery updates, risk discussions, and project handoffs.
  • Take ownership of outcomes, follow work through to completion, and escalate risks early with supporting evidence.
  • Use documentation, experimentation, and collaboration to solve unfamiliar problems rather than waiting for step-by-step direction.
  • Adapt to evolving technologies, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards.
  • Contribute to a supportive engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and professional client interactions.

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, and SQL.
  • Solid understanding of authentication and authorization, Entra ID/OAuth, Git, unit testing, Azure development, and secure coding practices.
  • Strong debugging skills, end-to-end ownership, clean-code discipline, and peer-review practices.
  • Ability to lead client-facing technical discussions, decompose requirements, estimate work efforts, and communicate architecture trade-offs.
  • Experience with .NET, .NET Core, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD; familiarity with Jest, React Testing Library, and SPFx fundamentals.
  • Exposure to Azure OpenAI integration, Next.js, Python, Copilot extensibility, Docker, or Dataverse integration.
  • Secure, tested, and responsive applications and APIs.
  • Reliable identity and enterprise-system integrations.
  • Maintainable custom-code foundations for AI agents, Microsoft 365 (M365), and Power Platform solutions.
  • Clear monitoring, documentation, and operational handoff.

Work Schedule: This is a client-facing role. The successful candidate will be expected to participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, demonstrations, delivery reviews, and issue-resolution discussions during the assigned shift.

Standard Shift: 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM India Standard Time (IST), equivalent to 2:30 AM to 11:30 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). During U.S. daylight saving time, the equivalent schedule is 3:30 AM to 12:30 PM Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).

About Us

At Netrix Global, our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals, and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!   

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today’s most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.  

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country’s top system integrators.  

At Netrix, we’re driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.  

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Sales Operations will manage all team members within the Commercial Sales Operations department and drive the strategy and execution of sales support work including the automating key systems and processes in order to help keep our sales team’s time spent serving our customers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Sales Operations Strategy & Process Improvement

·Work with a broad set of key stakeholders to design, launch, and maintain innovative sales and technical sales enablement processes, programs, and systems.

·Manage day-to-day sales operations and enablement functions, ensuring they run efficiently and support the needs of the commercial sales organization.

·Analyze existing processes and workflows to identify and implement improvements.

·Partner with sales leadership to ensure key metrics are easily accessible and reported on for systems and processes.

Salesforce & Sales Technology Management

·Manage Salesforce, including support requests and escalated administrative needs, providing prompt and complete resolution of technical challenges and business support issues.

·Manage platforms and applications, including vendor relationships.

·Evaluate and implement additional applications and tools that integrate with Salesforce and the broader technology stack.

·Leverage AI as needed to streamline workflows, automate routine tasks, and increase efficiency across sales operations and enablement.

Project Management, Data & Cross-Functional Coordination

·Manage sales operations functions and projects to ensure timely completion.

·Communicate and coordinate with key IT resources on behalf of the sales team and manage project inputs for IT systems related to the commercial sales organization, to support smooth planning and execution.

·Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer and prospect data.

·Serve as a facilitator between sales systems and cross-functional teams, helping each group access, interpret, and act on the information and reporting they need.

Team Leadership & Other Duties

·Hire, onboard, train, and offboard sales operations team members.

·Perform other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Minimum of five (5) years of hands-on experience administering and automating Salesforce, including building Flows, workflow rules, and approval processes to support sales teams.

  • In-depth understanding of the capabilities and constraints of Salesforce combined with a solid understanding of standard business processes.

·Proven track record of collaborating with sales team and sales leadership to analyze existing processes and workflows.

·Ability to recognize opportunities for process improvement that enable sales teams to obtain the information they need quickly and effectively.

·Ability to work on multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong passion for customer service.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels within an organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

·Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • Certified Salesforce Administrator.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and use sound judgment to prioritize requests, resolve system and process issues, and make decisions that support the sales organization.

·Ability to manage multiple projects at once and collaborate effectively with sales, IT, and other cross-functional partners to deliver on time.

·Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and system information clearly to sales teams and leadership, with strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

·Ability to meet critical deadlines for system changes, reporting, and project deliverables.

·Ability to adapt quickly to changing business priorities, sales needs, and project schedules.

·Commitment to providing responsive, high-quality support to internal sales teams and the customers they serve.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber requires a pre-employment background check as conditions of employment. Ziply Fiber may require a pre-employment drug screening.

Ziply Fiber is a drug free workplace.

WellRight is a corporate wellness leader delivering customizable and complete wellness programs, used by organizations to improve the health and well-being of their employees and clients. What sets us apart is our dedication to tailoring solutions to the unique needs of each customer we serve.

At WellRight, we embrace and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are united by a common purpose: to create a meaningful impact through well-being programs that engage and inspire participants while delivering tangible results. Our goal is to foster well-being in the workplace with a versatile and empowering solution, allowing each individual to embark on their own well-being journey. We invite you to explore how you might contribute to our mission.

JOB SUMMARY:

At WellRight, we value and celebrate diversity ~ in backgrounds and experiences. WellRight is a leading provider of corporate wellness software, used by organizations to improve the health and well-being of their employees and clients. Our mission is to change people for good through positive habit formation, focusing on six dimensions of holistic health: physical, emotional, financial, social, occupational, and purpose. WellRight offers flexible, fun, easy-to-use software that powers over 500 corporate wellness programs. As a proud member of Workforce Magazine’s list of top 10 Corporate Wellness Providers, WellRight is the preferred choice for organizations as they improve the health and well-being of their partners and clients.

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is responsible for driving participation in the WellRight platform by working collaboratively with the greater sales team to ensure that sales targets are achieved. The ideal candidate is responsible for securing new logos and revenue, predominantly with Mid-Market to Enterprise-sized businesses.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish a wide-reaching network of new logo opportunities in the employer market.
  • Implement strategies to secure short and long term revenue streams.
  • Work independently to secure meetings with potential new clients via inbound and outbound lead generation efforts.
  • Represent WellRight at exhibitions and networking events.
  • Manage a sales pipeline, progressing prospects from lead to close.
  • Strong focus on maintaining high conversion rates and thorough qualification of prospects.
  • Maintain a strong knowledge of the Corporate Health & Wellbeing industry to enable consultative/collaborative and powerful client relationships.
  • Commitment to accurate CRM usage and reporting through Salesforce
  • Commitment to usage of sales tools and technologies for day-to-day business operations.
  • Maintain a personal commitment to remaining completely up to date with all internal processes and policies, department- and company-wide.
  • Weekly personal forecasting

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of sales experience. Ideal industry experience in digital healthcare, wellness and/or employer benefits
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Excellent interpersonal, writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • SaaS/Industry experience preferable
  • Proven negotiation skills
  • Experience with sales forecasting for multiple audiences
  • Good track record of delivering results and working towards sales targets
  • Clear, effective, and confident communicator with clients at different levels within an organization
  • Travel up to 40% to multiple U.S. states

Preferred Competencies:

  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative on tasks and projects
  • Able to manage project deadlines and prioritize tasks effectively
  • Open to feedback and collaborative continuous learning
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Focused on delivering high-quality project outcomes
  • Collaborative and able to work effectively across cross-functional teams
  • Ability to work autonomously when required
  • Adaptable to change and evolving business needs
  • A keen interest in the corporate Health and Well-being industry
  • Strong alignment with WellRight's mission to improve holistic health

OUR TEAM:

WellRight is based in Chicago with a remote team distributed across the country.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. People of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives are welcome here. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

We value every WellRight team member’s unique talents, contributions, and viewpoints. If you’re passionate about technology and wellness, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every listed requirement. You never know what opportunities might arise in the future!

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • Competitive Compensation Structure
    • We provide a competitive base salary plus an uncapped commission structure.
  • Unlimited PTO + 11 Company Paid Holidays
    • We believe in mutual trust between employer and employee. Employees are encouraged to take time off to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • VTO (Volunteer Time Off)
    • As part of our WellRight Gives Back program, employees may participate in scheduled volunteer opportunities or on their own time, at a minimum of 3 hours per quarter.
  • Flexible work schedule
    • We support a high level of autonomy and responsibility, believing that flexibility and asynchronous work lead to the best outcomes.
  • Whole Wellness
    • We offer affordable health, dental, and vision options.
    • Long-term and short-term disability insurance is fully covered by WellRight, along with additional voluntary benefits such as supplemental life insurance, transit benefits, legal services, identity protection, and pre-tax savings accounts.
    • We pride ourselves on reducing your healthcare burdens by offering a robust variety of benefits plan options designed to support diverse individual needs.
  • 401(k) program matching
    • 100% with Company contribution of up to 4%. All matches are immediately vested.
    • We’re dedicated to supporting your financial future.
  • Pet Wellness
    • We offer access to a comprehensive pet wellness plan that reimburses employees for preventive and routine pet care. At WellRight, we believe pets are an extension of the family, and we provide resources to help you better support and care for your furry friends.
  • Paid Pregnancy Medical Leave & Paid Parental Leave
    • We offer up to 12 weeks of paid medical leave for pregnancy and up to 6 weeks of paid parental leave for spouses, adoption, or foster care placement.
    • Families come in many forms, and we believe in supporting working parents with appropriate leave.
  • At-home internet stipend
    • In our primarily remote work environment, we want to ensure you have the tools and environment needed for success.
  • Immediate access to a Udemy Business license
    • As we grow, your professional development is vital to our collective success. Udemy offers our employees unlimited access to online learning resources.
  • Rewards and incentives for participation in our WellRight Wellness Program
    • We prioritize your well-being with unlimited monetary incentives through our WellRight Wellness Platform and a $125 Annual Fitness Tracking Equipment Allowance.

raw.title: Senior Key Accounts Manager (Central/West)
raw.excerpt: Description:The Senior Key Accounts Manager - Regional Payers is a senior individual contributor responsible for the business-to-business relationships, strategic account planning, and measurable business performance of an assigned regional payer portfolio.
raw.description:
Description:

The Senior Key Accounts Manager - Regional Payers is a senior individual contributor responsible for the business-to-business relationships, strategic account planning, and measurable business performance of an assigned regional payer portfolio. The Senior Key Accounts Manager will be accountable for gaining, protecting, and improving profitable formulary and medical policy access; influencing downstream adoption and accurate implementation of parent-account access; identifying and advancing financially sound regional contracting opportunities; quantifying business impact; leading approved pull-through; and bringing actionable payer intelligence into portfolio and launch decisions. This role requires cross-functional leadership with Pricing and Contracting, Finance, Legal, Medical Affairs and MSLs, Brand, Patient Services, Field Reimbursement, Sales, Trade, Analytics, Government Affairs, and other internal stakeholders.

Essential Functions:

Opportunity Advancement and Business Outcomes:

  • Secure, maintain, and improve profitable formulary placement and written medical policy coverage across pharmacy and medical benefits.
  • Identify and advance financially sound regional contracting and strategic partnership opportunities in alignment with the applicable Key Account Manager and approved parent-account strategy.
  • Build and present business cases using volume, claims, reimbursement, formulary, competitive, rebate, discount, and financial data; clearly articulate forecast impact, access risk, expected return, and recommended action to senior leadership.
  • Support or lead approved regional contract discussions and manage opportunities through approval, signature, implementation, and performance monitoring.
  • Measures of success: advance at least one priority opportunity each quarter and deliver two to three documented access or business wins annually.
  • Current portfolio measures include advancing at least two systemic access issues across the Specialty portfolio; targeting two measurable coverage or implementation improvements through priority BCBS and other regional plans and selected large IDN specialty centers or health-system accounts; and qualifying three Biosciences or Pipeline opportunities, including Medicaid coverage opportunities, with at least one advanced annually.

Account Focus and Coverage Intelligence:

  • Serve as the primary account owner and day-to-day Amneal contact for assigned East or West regional health plans and downstream payer accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with Amneal portfolio objectives and the applicable parent-account strategy.
  • Build multi-level relationships across pharmacy, medical, contracting, industry relations, utilization management, and other relevant customer functions.
  • Maintain current knowledge of each account's decision-making structure, lines of business, PBM and rebate aggregator relationships, benefit design, utilization management, coverage criteria, and implementation processes.
  • Maintain a cross-portfolio coverage, barrier, and opportunity tracker for priority Blues, regional plans, IDNs, health systems, and Medicaid plans.
  • Measures of success: Every priority account has current coverage status, a defined business issue or opportunity, an accountable owner, a next step, and timing.

Strategic Engagement and Pull-Through:

  • Lead approved regional payer, Blue, IDN, health-system, or state engagement when tied to a defined access issue, contracting opportunity, implementation need, or broader business priority.
  • Develop, implement, and measure PRC-approved pull-through strategies based on formulary and medical policy access.
  • Work with Sales, Field Reimbursement, Patient Services, Brand, Medical Affairs, Trade, and other matrix partners to resolve barriers and maximize the value of access wins.
  • Communicate account-specific coverage changes, affordability issues, and local business impact through approved training, business reviews, regional calls, and other appropriate forums.
  • Measures of success: priority engagements have a clear objective, next step, and documented outcome; meeting volume alone is not a performance measure.

Field, Launch, and Portfolio Insight:

  • Quarterback regional account initiatives and coordinate appropriate engagement by Key Account Managers and cross-functional partners.
  • Bring customer insights, emerging payer trends, regional access opportunities, and competitive intelligence into parent-account planning, brand strategy, contracting decisions, and portfolio planning.
  • Support launches by ensuring regional payer plans, implementation requirements, and field communication are incorporated into launch readiness.
  • Maintain knowledge of payer economics, relevant laws and policy changes, competitor activity, and patient affordability dynamics.
  • For pre-launch activities across the Pipeline, gather compliant regional intelligence on testing and confirmed diagnosis, PA and coverage criteria, competitors, benefit pathway, and review timing; map the top five priority regional plans and conduct payer discussions when they inform a broader launch decision.
  • Measures of success: provide quarterly regional coverage and payer updates with a clear field, brand, contracting, or launch action.

raw.title: Senior Key Accounts Manager (Central/West)
raw.excerpt: Description:The Senior Key Accounts Manager - Regional Payers is a senior individual contributor responsible for the business-to-business relationships, strategic account planning, and measurable business performance of an assigned regional payer portfolio.
raw.description:
Description:

The Senior Key Accounts Manager - Regional Payers is a senior individual contributor responsible for the business-to-business relationships, strategic account planning, and measurable business performance of an assigned regional payer portfolio. The Senior Key Accounts Manager will be accountable for gaining, protecting, and improving profitable formulary and medical policy access; influencing downstream adoption and accurate implementation of parent-account access; identifying and advancing financially sound regional contracting opportunities; quantifying business impact; leading approved pull-through; and bringing actionable payer intelligence into portfolio and launch decisions. This role requires cross-functional leadership with Pricing and Contracting, Finance, Legal, Medical Affairs and MSLs, Brand, Patient Services, Field Reimbursement, Sales, Trade, Analytics, Government Affairs, and other internal stakeholders.

Essential Functions:

Opportunity Advancement and Business Outcomes:

  • Secure, maintain, and improve profitable formulary placement and written medical policy coverage across pharmacy and medical benefits.
  • Identify and advance financially sound regional contracting and strategic partnership opportunities in alignment with the applicable Key Account Manager and approved parent-account strategy.
  • Build and present business cases using volume, claims, reimbursement, formulary, competitive, rebate, discount, and financial data; clearly articulate forecast impact, access risk, expected return, and recommended action to senior leadership.
  • Support or lead approved regional contract discussions and manage opportunities through approval, signature, implementation, and performance monitoring.
  • Measures of success: advance at least one priority opportunity each quarter and deliver two to three documented access or business wins annually.
  • Current portfolio measures include advancing at least two systemic access issues across the Specialty portfolio; targeting two measurable coverage or implementation improvements through priority BCBS and other regional plans and selected large IDN specialty centers or health-system accounts; and qualifying three Biosciences or Pipeline opportunities, including Medicaid coverage opportunities, with at least one advanced annually.

Account Focus and Coverage Intelligence:

  • Serve as the primary account owner and day-to-day Amneal contact for assigned East or West regional health plans and downstream payer accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with Amneal portfolio objectives and the applicable parent-account strategy.
  • Build multi-level relationships across pharmacy, medical, contracting, industry relations, utilization management, and other relevant customer functions.
  • Maintain current knowledge of each account's decision-making structure, lines of business, PBM and rebate aggregator relationships, benefit design, utilization management, coverage criteria, and implementation processes.
  • Maintain a cross-portfolio coverage, barrier, and opportunity tracker for priority Blues, regional plans, IDNs, health systems, and Medicaid plans.
  • Measures of success: Every priority account has current coverage status, a defined business issue or opportunity, an accountable owner, a next step, and timing.

Strategic Engagement and Pull-Through:

  • Lead approved regional payer, Blue, IDN, health-system, or state engagement when tied to a defined access issue, contracting opportunity, implementation need, or broader business priority.
  • Develop, implement, and measure PRC-approved pull-through strategies based on formulary and medical policy access.
  • Work with Sales, Field Reimbursement, Patient Services, Brand, Medical Affairs, Trade, and other matrix partners to resolve barriers and maximize the value of access wins.
  • Communicate account-specific coverage changes, affordability issues, and local business impact through approved training, business reviews, regional calls, and other appropriate forums.
  • Measures of success: priority engagements have a clear objective, next step, and documented outcome; meeting volume alone is not a performance measure.

Field, Launch, and Portfolio Insight:

  • Quarterback regional account initiatives and coordinate appropriate engagement by Key Account Managers and cross-functional partners.
  • Bring customer insights, emerging payer trends, regional access opportunities, and competitive intelligence into parent-account planning, brand strategy, contracting decisions, and portfolio planning.
  • Support launches by ensuring regional payer plans, implementation requirements, and field communication are incorporated into launch readiness.
  • Maintain knowledge of payer economics, relevant laws and policy changes, competitor activity, and patient affordability dynamics.
  • For pre-launch activities across the Pipeline, gather compliant regional intelligence on testing and confirmed diagnosis, PA and coverage criteria, competitors, benefit pathway, and review timing; map the top five priority regional plans and conduct payer discussions when they inform a broader launch decision.
  • Measures of success: provide quarterly regional coverage and payer updates with a clear field, brand, contracting, or launch action.

description: Hello!  🦜Thanks for checking out our job posting.

raw.title: [Flexible & Remote] Relocation Consultant, APAC
raw.excerpt: Hello!  🦜Thanks for checking out our job posting.
raw.description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team – huzzah!

We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere – one move at a time.

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be—immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

About the role

Flexible Relocation Coaches work with PerchPeek to support current markets with surges in business volume, provide flexibility for Relocation Coach capacity, and improve coverage to support relocators across multiple markets and timezones. This role will work within a network of third-party consultants and with PerchPeek’s Network Manager to deliver quality customer experience in line with customer requirements and PerchPeek’s SLAs for quality and productivity.

Previous experience in the Global Mobility / Relocation industry and knowledge of relocation management and/or destination services is helpful, but not essential, as we’ll provide a free training course on how to become a successful Flex Relocation Coach. You’ll also receive paid training on all of our internal systems. You might be an awesome Relocation Coach if you’ve previously worked as a Customer Success Manager, Concierge, Personal Assistant, Support or Operations Specialist, or if you’ve worked in industries like travel, hospitality, SaaS startups, or HR.

Scope of Work

In more detail, Flexible Relocation Coaches will be contracted to deliver end-to-end Relocation Coach services to a diverse portfolio of relocators by:

  • Building trusted relationships with relocators over the duration of their relocation journey as their main point of contact, delegating tasks when appropriate.
  • Communicating with relocators via a) the PerchPeek app and b) through consultative and supportive calls to understand the customer’s needs, explain relocation services, and provide expertise, guidance & support to relocators within your portfolio.
  • Handling difficult or complex relocator enquiries or situations, using critical judgement to ensure the best outcomes for your movers, including escalating these as appropriate.
  • Providing the “right expertise at the right time” on all aspects of the relocation journey and life in the destination country to equip relocators to integrate successfully to their new location.
  • Supporting relocators in understanding and abiding to their company’s relocation policy, including management of their relocation allowances.
  • Recommending and coordinating additional relocation services from providers, working within PerchPeek’s Supply Chain. Examples include immigration, tax or shipping providers.
  • Systems Cleanliness: utilising Operations and Relocation Experience processes to the highest standards to help make sure that our teams and systems run smoothly. i.e. ensuring collected data is accurate and useful for data analysis, reporting, and insights.
  • Process implementation: supporting the rollout of process improvements by engaging with new processes and tools.
  • Appropriately delegating relevant tasks to third-party consultants, monitoring service delivery to ensure all tasks are completed to a high quality within PerchPeek’s delivery SLAs.
  • Identifying and managing escalations, delivery issues and inefficiencies appropriately to ensure your deliverables align with service delivery requirements, policies, and expectations.
  • Familiarising yourself with PerchPeek’s products and providing guidance to relocators on how they can utilise the Relocator App and its tools and content.
  • Advocating for high-quality knowledge capturing and contributing to developing the PerchPeek content library.
  • Collaborating with other Relocation Coaches for creative problem-solving and knowledge sharing.

About You

Requirements
  • The role requires fluency in verbal and written English, as well as awareness or first-hand knowledge of major cities and lifestyle norms in the APAC region.
  • Knowledge of additional APAC countries and local lifestyles is preferred.
  • No prior relocation experience is required, as we provide a comprehensive free training and up-skilling program to fully prepare you for success as a Relocation Coach.

While not necessary, we’re especially interested in candidates with the below:

  • You share our value of Delighting Customers: in this role, you have the customer’s needs at the heart of your thoughts and actions every day.
  • You are organised, efficient and prioritise your time so that you can balance being both proactive and reactive to the needs of your portfolio of customers and manage them across different timelines and stages of their relocations.
  • You are an eloquent and concise communicator and can tailor your written and verbal communications to the specific customer. You are comfortable managing expectations and diplomatically handling concerns or objections.
  • You are relentlessly focused on delivery. Things move quickly at PerchPeek, but even faster for our customers, so you should relish challenges and demonstrate a strong natural instinct to drive things to completion.
  • You keep an eye on the details! Every relocation has its nuances, and it’s important to understand, track and translate these into accurate recommendations.
  • You display comfort in ambiguous situations and are confident in working through unknowns and adapting to challenging customer needs or expectations.
  • You are resilient in a range of situations. From constant changes as a business and product development to specific customer failures, you are comfortable adapting, learning and applying it to the next customer.
  • You are highly autonomous and thrive in a 100% remote and independent working environment without losing personal motivation, initiative, or productivity.

As a Quality Control Advisor at Zensurance, you’ll do more than just audit files and catch errors. You’ll help us dig into root causes so we can prevent issues before they happen.

This role is key to ensuring our broking teams stay accurate, compliant, and efficient as we scale.

Reporting to the Team Lead, you’ll analyze trends, identify underlying performance gaps, and help create practical solutions that support our brokers' day-to-day work. You’ll serve as a dependable quality partner, working alongside Sales Leaders and cross-functional teams to refine workflows, elevate team learning, and maintain high service standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Audit Execution: Perform regular audits of sales files to ensure alignment with our quality and compliance standards.

  • Root Cause Analysis: Investigate recurring errors and customer concerns to uncover underlying causes and prevent repeat issues.

  • Reporting & Trends: Track audit metrics and prepare reports that highlight operational patterns, error trends, and areas for improvement.

  • Resource & Training Enablement: Create practical job aids, tip sheets, and reference materials that help brokers avoid common pitfalls.

  • Process Improvement: Share constructive feedback on existing workflows and update documentation as new tools and processes roll out.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Underwriting, and Product teams to align on quality standards, address bottlenecks, and support licensing compliance.

Requirements:

  • Industry Experience: 2+ years of auditing experience in the commercial insurance industry.

  • Licensing & Designations: A RIBO license or progress toward industry designations (such as CAIB or CIP) is a strong asset.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and look past symptoms to solve underlying process issues.

  • Documentation Skills: Experience creating straightforward job aids, workflows, or training guides.

  • Analytical Ability: Comfortable reviewing data, spotting trends, and drawing actionable insights from metrics.

  • Communication Skills: Clear, constructive communication style with a focus on coaching and enablement rather than policing.

  • Organization & Independence: Strong time-management skills with the ability to handle recurring audit cycles independently.

Benefits & Perks at Zensurance:

At Zensurance, we know that when our people thrive, so does our business. That’s why we offer a flexible, people-first work environment designed to support your well-being, growth, and success.

If you're looking for a team that values learning, collaboration, and impactful work, we’d love to meet you!

• Home office allowance to create a comfortable workspace

• Top-tier tech: "Office in a box" with all necessary tech equipment

• Half days before public holidays: Enjoy half days before long weekends

• Health & personal spending accounts to invest in wellness your way

• Parental leave top-up, because family comes first

🚀 Investing in Your Growth:

• Education assistance reimbursement for courses, conferences, books, and memberships

• Opportunities to learn from industry experts and grow your career

🤝 Staying Connected:

• Weekly Friday huddles to share updates and connect across teams

• Virtual & in-person team-building events to strengthen our culture

AI Tools and Your Interview:

We know AI is a valuable tool, and you're welcome to use it to prepare for your interview. However, please don't use AI assistants during the live interview itself. We want to have an authentic conversation with you, and using AI during the interview could affect our evaluation of your suitability for the role.

Just so you know, we use an AI scribe to help us take notes and review interviews, ensuring a fair and clear process.

Diversity & Inclusion:

Zensurance celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and provide accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need support, let us know, we’re here to help.

raw.description:
Position Description

Tenna is searching for a Regional Manager, Customer Accounts to lead and continue to build our team of Customer Account Managers (CAMs) across the Central United States. In this front-line leadership role, you’ll make sure every CAM on your team is set up to win and every customer in your region gets real value from the Tenna platform, driving retention and expansion along the way. Day to day, you will work side by side with your team, reviewing account health, product adoption, escalations, and renewal risk, and stepping in to help lead the conversation when a key customer is at risk. You will coach, develop, and continue to grow your team of CAMs, and partner with Sales, Product, Support, and Professional Services to improve outcomes across the Central United States. This is a unique opportunity to scale a high-performing team and help shape how Tenna grows with its customers. Ready to lead? Apply now!

Why Tenna?

At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us, and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets anytime, anywhere, on one comprehensive platform. Apply now!

Note: To be considered, candidates must live in or be willing to relocate to one of the following states: Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, Missouri, Colorado, Nebraska, Louisiana, Iowa, Minnesota, or Arkansas.

Responsibilities

  • Supervises, coaches, and develops a regional team of Customer Account Managers, growing the team to approximately nine CAMs across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB segments
  • Accountable for the team’s retention and expansion results, including gross and net revenue retention, logo retention, and renewal performance
  • Reviews account health with each CAM on a regular cadence, including product adoption, usage trends, support escalations, and renewal risk, and ensures every CAM has a clear, current plan for their accounts
  • Steps in personally to help lead customer conversations when key or Enterprise accounts are at risk, while CAMs manage the day-to-day account work
  • Maintains an accurate view of upcoming renewals and expansion opportunities, flags risk early, and brings forward recommendations rather than just problems
  • Reduces unmanaged Red and Yellow accounts by ensuring documented recovery plans are in place and followed through
  • Partners with Regional Territory Managers and Sales on clean handoffs for new customers, renewals, and expansion opportunities
  • Participates in hiring, onboards, and ramps new CAMs, setting clear goals and performance standards from day one
  • Runs weekly one-on-ones, account reviews, and team operating cadences, and builds individual development plans that grow CAMs into stronger customer advisors
  • Addresses performance issues directly and constructively, holding the team accountable to clear standards
  • Assigns accounts and balances workloads across the team based on segment, complexity, and capacity
  • Ensures the team follows Tenna’s playbooks and has the training and tools needed to deliver a consistent customer experience
  • Ensures consistent customer progress reviews, Business Review Meetings, and strong executive relationships across key accounts
  • Partners with Professional Services to improve onboarding and shorten time to value for new customers
  • Brings field feedback and recurring customer needs to Product, and partners with Support to resolve systemic issues that affect multiple customers
  • Maintains Salesforce discipline across the region so customer data and reporting are accurate, timely, and actionable
  • Travels to customer sites for Enterprise and Platinum customer visits, strategic business reviews, team coaching, and company events
  • Shares field insights with leadership to improve health scoring, playbooks, and processes as Tenna scales

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or post-sales roles
  • 2+ years of direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance-managing customer-facing team members
  • Track record of driving renewals, retention, and expansion, with measurable results you can speak to
  • Working knowledge of SaaS account metrics, including GRR, NRR, churn, health scoring, adoption, ARR, and ACV
  • Experience supporting Enterprise and Mid-Market customers in complex, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Experience managing complex customer escalations; experience supporting a remote or distributed team is a plus
  • Strong Salesforce experience, including account management, opportunity tracking, and reporting
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; familiarity with Jira, service desk systems, and customer health reporting
  • Confidence leading difficult customer conversations and building trust with C-level stakeholders
  • Experience in a growth-stage or scaling B2B SaaS organization, with a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach
  • Proactive, transparent, and data-driven, with a bias toward execution and clear follow-through
  • Ability to travel approximately 25%–35%
  • Experience in construction technology, fleet or equipment management, telematics, IoT, or industrial SaaS is strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with construction ERP platforms such as Viewpoint/Vista, Spectrum, or Foundation is an absolute plus

Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information:

  • Full-time opportunity.
  • Location: Remote. Must live in/be willing to relocate to one of the following: TX, OK, KS, MO, CO, NE, LA, IA, MN, or AR.
  • Travel to customer locations is required, approximately 25%–35%.
  • Competitive compensation packages are offered.
  • Opportunities for growth and personal development within a highly dynamic team.
  • Robust, low-cost benefit packages are offered.
  • Benefit coverage begins on the first date of employment.
  • Paid Time Off and Volunteer Time Off are offered.
  • Dependent Care offered.
  • 401k match.
  • Employee referral bonuses.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Tenna is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome different perspectives and opinions to foster innovation, authenticity, and excellence across all parts of our company, and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

raw.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS:

As a Principal Architect for Data & AI in Kainos, you’ll be accountable for successful delivery of contemporary data/ AI solutions across multiple customers.


You’ll have gravitas within the data/ AI community and strong thought leadership, working with senior stakeholders to agree principles, strategic direction and functional and non-functional designs. You'll manage other architects and engineers in the capability to help them navigate their careers.


You will provide assurance and support to multi-skilled agile teams by understanding the outcomes the solution is trying to achieve, the technical implications and complexity surrounding you and your teams' designs and helping teams make the right decisions. As a technical leader, you will work with your colleagues to lead the development of policy and standards, develop customer relationships, develop account strategies and share knowledge and mentor those around you. You’ll do this whilst advising about new technologies and approaches, with room to learn, develop and grow.


MINIMUM (ESSENTIAL) REQUIREMENTS

  • Broad knowledge of a spectrum of current and emerging data and AI technologies, and able to communicate clearly and influence C-level stakeholders (such as IOT, edge processing, event driven data architectures, serverless processing, file system, object, document, key-value, search, RDBMS, graph, cognitive services, machine learning).
  • Proven experience being accountable for designing, building and productionising modern data or AI intensive applications, including systems that are distributed and scalable.
  • Has experience with public cloud data platforms, at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP including use of IaaS, SaaS and PaaS offerings.
  • Comfortable with data integration techniques such as messaging, queuing, change data capture or data virtualisation.
  • Able to prioritise customer concerns, for example incorporating non functional concerns into application design and prioritise your time across multiple major projects particularly when working to deadlines.
  • Has pro-actively developed business and applied an understanding of the commercial implications of their decisions.
  • Motivate and empower teams to create an inclusive and creative culture for our people to perform well, learn and grow with a focus on wellbeing.

DESIRABLE

  • Experience in managing others, setting objectives, giving feedback and leading performance reviews.
  • Actively shares their thoughts and views on technology.
  • Has participated in technology communities.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

raw.title: Account Manager
raw.excerpt: About SafeLeaseAt SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change.
raw.description:
About SafeLease

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

When someone rents a storage unit, SafeLease protects what they store inside, and the storage owner earns revenue from it. SafeLease is a product of Etude, focusing on the self storage insurance industry.

Account Managers at SafeLease are strategic partners to self-storage owners and operators. You'll help each customer shape how their tenant protection program runs in their business, then grow it into a meaningful revenue line across their portfolio.

You'll build a deep understanding of how storage businesses operate and pair it with a consultative, data-driven approach that helps customers get more from their program. Your success is measured by customer retention, program performance, and revenue growth through expansion and upgrades.

Responsibilities

  • Learn how each customer operates and guide how they roll out their protection program: which tenants are enrolled, how it's priced, and how it fits their move-in process.

  • Become the go-to expert on our products, our customers, and the self-storage industry.

  • Use performance data to show customers what's working, what to change, and the value their program delivers.

  • Bring ideas that help customers hit their goals and run a stronger business.

  • Build relationships that last and grow the partnership as their business grows.

  • Proactively share what you hear with Product, Sales, and Support to shape what we build next.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years in B2B account management, customer success, or consultative sales with a revenue target.

  • Strong commercial judgment and a history of growing accounts, not just managing them. You know how to find where a customer can get more value and develop a plan to turn it into new business.

  • You make complex problems simple and communicate them clearly.

  • You're self-motivated, adaptable, and curious, and you do your best work when things move fast.

  • No storage or insurance background needed. We'll teach you the industry.

Why SafeLease?

The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners.

The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity.

The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.


If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check.

The Director of eDiscovery and Data Solutions works closely with eDiscovery leadership including the leader(s) of the eDiscovery and Information Management practice to manage firmwide -technology-enabled eDiscovery services. Serving as a senior adviser to firm leadership and the eDiscovery and Information Management practice, the Director combines firm business goals and client priorities into a clear service, technology, and investment roadmap for eDiscovery matters. The role is accountable for the performance, growth, governance, and financial sustainability of the eDiscovery and Data Solutions (“EDDS”) function, while identifying broader opportunities to use data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to improve matter delivery and defensibility of process.

The Director leads the eDiscovery and Data Solutions team, shapes strategic vendor and platform decisions, and partners across Practice Management, Innovation, Information Technology, Information Security, the GC’s Office, Finance, and other business functions to develop scalable solutions. Success is measured by client value, quality and defensibility, adoption, operational and financial performance, risk management, and the team’s contribution to the firm’s strategic priorities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the firmwide strategy for eDiscovery and Data Solutions, with a multi-year roadmap aligned to firm, practice, client, and matter priorities.
  • Serve as a senior technical adviser to eDiscovery leadership and the eDiscovery and Information Management practice on discovery technology strategy, security and management, cost, and the effective use of data and technology in the context of litigation.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
