raw.description:
Summary:

The Permitting Analyst is responsible for executing end-to-end permitting services for energy and infrastructure projects, including oil and gas, renewables, and related facilities and linear infrastructure. The role supports assigned projects from intake through approval, including preparation of permit applications and supporting documentation, coordination of internal inputs, and agency submittal follow-through. The Permitting Analyst maintains accurate status and timeline visibility for Project Managers and clients, supports routine agency coordination and deficiency responses, and ensures permit deliverables are accurate, complete, and agency-ready.

The Permitting Analyst coordinates permitting work across internal teams (Project Management, Survey, Engineering, GIS) and external stakeholders (clients, agencies, and vendors) to ensure submittals align with applicable federal, state, and local requirements. Typical scopes include county and municipal permits, state oil and gas commission filings (e.g., ECMC, TX RRC, WOGCC, NMOCD), and federal permitting (e.g., BLM ROW/APD), along with permit condition tracking and compliance support through post-approval reporting and closeout as assigned. The role reports to the Permitting Manager, who sets work priorities, allocates resources, and provides department oversight, and receives technical guidance from the Senior Permitting Analyst as assigned.

Expected Results in the Role:

  • Permitting requests are executed end-to-end with clear scope, required inputs, and realistic timelines established early and maintained through approval.
  • Submittals are accurate, complete, and agency-ready with minimal rework, supported by consistent QA/QC checks and documentation standards.
  • Permitting tasks are visible and actively managed with reliable status tracking, due dates, and ownership clearly communicated to Project Managers and clients.
  • Agency coordination is timely and professional, including routine follow-up and deficiency responses, with appropriate escalation when requirements, schedules, or conditions change.
  • Internal coordination is effective across Project Management, Survey, Engineering, and GIS to obtain inputs on time and prevent downstream delays.
  • Permit conditions and assigned post-approval obligations are tracked and supported through execution, including reporting and closeout needs that impact field work and project deliverables.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Permitting Delivery and Execution

  • Execute permitting work for assigned projects from intake through approval, including application preparation, supporting exhibits, and submittal packaging.
  • Confirm permit scope, required inputs, dependencies, and target timelines with the Project Manager and internal teams; identify schedule constraints and escalate risks early.
  • Prepare and submit permit applications for local, state, and federal jurisdictions as assigned, following agency requirements and client standards.
  • Track permit status, approvals, conditions, and expirations; document requirements, constraints, and next steps and communicate impacts to the project team.
  • Support permit condition tracking and assigned post-approval obligations, including required reporting, notifications, and closeout documentation.

Agency, Client, and Internal Coordination

  • Coordinate with agencies to confirm procedures, timelines, and documentation requirements; document communications, decisions, commitments, and outcomes.
  • Respond to routine agency questions and deficiency requests; coordinate corrections and resubmittals; escalate complex, ambiguous, or higher-risk technical issues to the Senior Permitting Analyst or Permitting Manager as appropriate.
  • Coordinate with clients and internal teams (Project Management, Survey, Engineering, GIS) to obtain required inputs, resolve data gaps, and maintain schedule alignment.
  • Provide clear and timely status updates to Project Managers and clients, including risks, dependencies, and action items; support client meetings as assigned and escalate material changes in scope, schedule, or requirements.

Quality, Documentation, and Process Discipline

  • Produce accurate, complete permitting deliverables consistent with company standards; apply QA/QC checks prior to submittal. Obtain required technical review before submittal in accordance with department QA/QC standards, including review of complex, ambiguous, or higher-risk requirements by the Senior Permitting Analyst or Permitting Manager as appropriate.
  • Maintain organized project records and document control from intake through approval and closeout, including agency correspondence, decisions, and supporting documentation.
  • Use and contribute to checklists, templates, and documented processes to reduce rework and improve predictability.
  • Identify recurring issues or bottlenecks and recommend process improvements to the Permitting Manager.

Reporting and Visibility

  • Maintain accurate task lists, due dates, and permit status tracking in department systems; keep permitting timelines current and visible.
  • Provide recurring updates to the Permitting Manager on workload, deadlines, constraints, and risks; support reporting needs as required.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None.
  • May provide task-level guidance to Permit Technicians as assigned; no direct supervisory responsibility.

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Permitting execution: Demonstrated ability to prepare, coordinate, and submit permitting packages across local, state, and federal jurisdictions; able to manage multiple concurrent permits with competing deadlines.
  • Regulatory process knowledge: Working knowledge of permitting workflows and agency expectations for energy and infrastructure projects, including typical requirements for state oil and gas commissions and federal land permitting (e.g., BLM).
  • Project coordination: Strong ability to manage intake, scope confirmation, dependencies, and deliverable schedules; anticipates constraints and communicates impacts early.
  • Quality and attention to detail: Produces accurate, complete, agency-ready submittals; consistently applies QA/QC practices, checklists, and documentation standards.
  • Communication: Clear, timely communication with Project Managers, clients, agencies, and internal teams; able to document requirements, decisions, and status updates.
  • Client service and professionalism: Maintains professional presence and responsiveness; handles agency and client interactions with sound judgment and appropriate escalation.
  • Organization and prioritization: Able to run a permitting queue, prioritize effectively, and maintain reliable tracking of tasks, due dates, and ownership.
  • Technical proficiency: Proficient with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word); comfortable learning and using permitting portals, project tracking tools, and document management systems.
  • Independent work habits: Able to work effectively in a remote environment, maintain responsiveness during core business hours, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

Preferred Skills & Abilities:

  • Multi-jurisdiction experience: Experience supporting permitting across multiple counties and agencies, with familiarity across varying requirements and submittal expectations.
  • Agency-specific familiarity: Prior experience with ECMC, TX RRC, WOGCC, NMOCD, and/or BLM permitting processes and common submittal requirements.
  • Permit conditions and closeout: Experience tracking permit conditions, post-approval reporting, and closeout requirements through project execution.
  • Process improvement: Experience developing checklists, templates, SOPs, dashboards, or workflow improvements that reduce rework and increase visibility.
  • Professional services delivery: Experience supporting multiple clients and projects simultaneously in a consulting/professional services environment.

Required Education, Certifications, and Experience:

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in permitting, regulatory support, or compliance tracking for energy and infrastructure projects (oil and gas, renewables, and related facilities and linear infrastructure).
  • Permitting experience: Demonstrated experience preparing and submitting permit applications and coordinating supporting documentation for local, state, and/or federal jurisdictions.
  • Coordination experience: Experience coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders (Project Managers, clients, agencies, and vendors) to meet timelines and quality expectations.
  • Systems and documentation: Experience maintaining organized project records, permit tracking, and documentation to support visibility and predictable delivery.

Preferred Education, Certifications, and Experience:

  • Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Natural Resources, Planning, GIS, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Agency familiarity: Experience with state oil and gas permitting processes (e.g., ECMC, TX RRC, WOGCC, NMOCD) and/or federal permitting (e.g., BLM ROW/APD).
  • Multi-state experience: Experience supporting permitting across multiple states or basins (e.g., Colorado, Texas, New Mexico, Wyoming).
  • Post-approval compliance: Experience tracking permit conditions, post-approval reporting obligations, and closeout requirements through project execution.
  • Professional services: Prior experience in a professional services/consulting environment supporting multiple clients and deadlines.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements:

  • Reliable internet access and a designated, quiet workspace are required.
  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time, including regular use of a keyboard, mouse, and monitors.

Other Need-to-Know Items:

  • Remote work within the domestic United States is acceptable.
  • Standard work hours are Monday-Friday, generally aligned to Mountain Time, to support collaboration with clients, agencies, and internal teams. Flexibility is supported within continental U.S. time zones, provided core team availability and communication are maintained.
  • Evening or weekend work may occasionally be required to meet project deadlines. All time worked must be accurately recorded in accordance with company policy.
  • Travel may be required on occasion for team collaboration, training, or project support.
  • Employment is limited to candidates authorized to work in the United States and able to perform work within continental U.S. time zones.
  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required.

raw.excerpt: Why RTI RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition.
raw.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

The Center of GenOmics and Applied Public Health at RTI International has an opening for an experienced Genomics Analyst focused on processing, quality control, and analysis of genomics, metabolomics, proteomics, and/or data generated by collaborative research networks. Working with investigators, laboratory partners, and multidisciplinary project teams, the analyst will analyze and interpret complex datasets and contribute to research on human health and disease. The ideal candidate will have a master’s degree in a relevant discipline, strong programming and analytical skills, experience with high-dimensional biomedical data, a solid foundation in human genetics, and experience applying statistical and computational methods to the analysis of omics data. This position is available in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remotely.


What You'll Do

  • Process and quality-check metabolomics, proteomics, and/or data generated using various platforms by commercial providers or university laboratories, including data tables generated by vendors or laboratories and raw instrument files, using platform-appropriate workflows for data cleaning, filtering, normalization, missing-data assessment, and batch-effect evaluation.
  • Implement and troubleshoot platform-appropriate workflows to convert raw instrument data into quantified metabolite or protein data, including feature detection, identification or annotation, and quantification as appropriate to the assay and in consultation with laboratory partners.
  • Develop, maintain, and document reproducible processing and analysis workflows; produce analysis-ready datasets, quality-control summaries, and data dictionaries.
  • Coordinate with laboratory and data-management partners to receive and validate data deliveries, reconcile sample identifiers and metadata, harmonize datasets across batches or studies, and resolve data-quality issues.
  • Conduct exploratory and statistical analyses under the guidance of project investigators, and support integration of metabolomics and proteomics data with other omics, clinical, phenotype, and environmental data.
  • Support the center’s broader genomic analyses as needed, including genotype data quality control and imputation, genome-wide association studies, and integration of genetic data with metabolomic and proteomic data (e.g., protein or metabolite quantitative trait locus mapping).
  • Prepare tables, figures, methods descriptions, and technical reports; contribute to manuscripts and communicate processing decisions and analytical results to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Support proposal development by providing input on technical sections, such as data-processing workflows, analytical approaches, and associated resource needs.

What You'll Need

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, Statistics, or a related discipline, with 1 year of relevant work experience.
  • Experience managing large biomedical datasets, validating sample and feature metadata, and analyzing high-dimensional data.
  • Hands-on experience processing metabolomics, proteomics, and/or other omics data, including raw instrument data, with a strong understanding of platform-specific quality control, preprocessing, and generation of analysis-ready datasets.
  • Working knowledge of bioinformatics tools and statistical methods for omics data processing, analysis, visualization, and biological interpretation.
  • Foundational knowledge of human genetics and genomics, including genetic variation, genome builds and annotation, linkage disequilibrium, population structure and genetic ancestry, and common genomic data formats (e.g., VCF, PLINK, FASTQ/BAM).
  • Proficiency in R and/or Python, including writing clear, reusable, and well-documented code.
  • Experience working in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate respectfully and effectively with colleagues across disciplines and research teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • To qualify, candidates must legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorhip for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.).

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in working in high-performance computing and/or cloud computing environments, particularly AWS or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with commercial proteomics platforms, such as Olink, including interpretation of vendor-provided quality-control metrics and processing of delivered data, and familiarity with mass spectrometry-based metabolomics or proteomics workflows and upstream laboratory processes; wet-lab experience is helpful but not required.
  • Experience with both metabolomics and proteomics, cross-study harmonization, multi-omics integration, or pathway and enrichment analyses.
  • Experience with genetic analyses, such as genotype quality control and imputation, GWAS, QTL mapping (e.g., pQTL or mQTL), DNA methylation array processing, or RNA-seq analysis, using tools such as PLINK, SAIGE, or Bioconductor packages.
  • Experience using version control, such as Git, and workflow-management tools to support reproducible analyses.
  • Experience with human subjects research data.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We’re Changing the PropTech Industry

We’re a profitable, growth-stage company building industry-leading martech and data products for the PropTech space. Our focus is on our category-leading AI and data SaaS products with triple-digit growth rates.

We’re a fully remote team of 100+ spread across the U.S. from coast to coast. We operate on a strict no a**holes policy and are proud to have built a community of highly performant people that take our work seriously, but not ourselves. And, we're looking for exceptional people to help further accelerate our growth.

While we’ve raised $30MM+ to date from some of the world’s best investors, we’re profitable with a strong balance sheet and an indefinite runway. We pride ourselves on achieving rapid growth without having to incinerate capital.

About Our Products

ApartmentIQ is the all-in-one data platform powering smarter decisions across multifamily—covering 40M units with daily property and market intelligence used for surveys, research, and revenue management. We're trusted by 65% of the NMHC Top 50. Our sister company, MavenAI, delivers AI-powered marketing automation built by industry experts and integrated directly with property management systems, serving over 2M units.

The Role

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead a new AI-native initiative. This is a 0-to-1 role: You’ll move from customer conversation to shipped product faster than most companies write a spec, work directly with customers, and build alongside product leadership, design, and engineering. We want someone who thinks like a product leader and can also get their hands dirty with design, prototyping, and rapid iteration. If you’ve been called “the person who just gets things built,” this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product line end to end — from discovery and positioning through launch and adoption
  • Decide where models belong in the experience and where they don’t — the judgment calls that separate a product that is genuinely AI-native from AI bolted onto reporting
  • Ship fast. Write specs, design workflows, build prototypes, and work side-by-side with designers and engineers to get features into production
  • Design evaluation frameworks to systematically measure output quality — build test suites, analyze answer patterns and edge cases, and use those signals to iteratively improve performance
  • Define and validate the guardrails that make the product’s output safe, explainable, and trustworthy when real dollars ride on it
  • Shape the data foundation the product stands on — what we need, what has to be normalized, and which questions that finally lets us answer
  • Stand up customer feedback loops (weekly cadences with key accounts across operators, asset managers, and ownership groups) and use those signals to prioritize ruthlessly
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and our existing product teams to make sure the product lands well and drives adoption

What We’re Looking For

Builder mentality over pedigree. We care about what you’ve shipped and how quickly
  • 8+ years in product management at a high-growth startup or tech company — including at least one product you owned from 0-to-1, end to end
  • Shipped 0-to-1 products that customers actually use — not just features on a roadmap slide. Founder and co-founder backgrounds encouraged
  • Strong product instincts with design sensibility
  • Fluency in leading customer discovery and translating messy qualitative feedback into clear product direction
  • Experience defining quality metrics and building evaluation loops — you’ve measured whether something is working and used those signals to make it better
  • Hands-on with LLMs: A large part of this job is the model layer, so ideally you have built with modern AI tools or have a track record of learning new technology fast
  • Bias to action and iteration over perfection and process
  • A background in BI, analytics, or data platforms is welcome if you’re clear-eyed that this generation of the category gets built differently
  • Proptech, multifamily, or real estate experience is a plus but not required

Why Choose Us

  • Remote-First: We offer the freedom to work from home across most of the U.S. You’ll enjoy the flexibility of remote work, balanced with high-energy in-person offsites to build real connections and celebrate our wins together.
  • Competitive Compensation: We believe in hiring the best and paying accordingly. You’ll receive acompetitive salary that reflects your impact and expertise.
  • Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with our flexible vacation policy and dedicated paid parental leave to support you and your family’s biggest milestones.
  • Your Health Matters: Stay healthy with high-quality Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for you and your family.
  • Peace of Mind (On Us): We fully invest in your security with 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance.
  • Protection for Your Whole Crew: Access supplemental insurance for the unexpected, plus specialized coverage to keep your pets happy and healthy, too.
  • Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial goals with our 401k Program, helping you build for the long term while you help us build the company.

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Data Scientist to join our Talent Analytics & Insights team. In this role, you will leverage your research design, regression analysis, and predictive modelling skills to support our investigations into critical workforce questions such as attrition drivers, workforce planning, internal mobility, employee engagement, and performance outcomes

Over time you will take on increasingly sophisticated modeling and analytic challenges. You will support not just producing numbers, but in producing advice and answers that senior leaders will use to make critical workforce decisions. To this end, excellent oral and written communication skills will differentiate the best candidates for this position.

This is not a back-end data engineering role. We are looking for someone who enjoys applied research, analytical problem-solving, and the challenge of making data useful for real decisions.

While work may be performed remotely, preference will be given to qualified candidates able to work occasionally from our Reston, VA office.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct descriptive and diagnostic analyses of workforce data to surface trends, anomalies, and actionable patterns (e.g., attrition hotspots, promotion rates, engagement shifts)
  • Apply hypothesis testing, correlation analysis, and regression techniques and other methods to answer workforce questions with rigor
  • Extract, join, transform, and validate data from enterprise data warehouse and HR systems using SQL
  • Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and deliver end-to-end analyses from scoping through presentation
  • Communicate findings clearly to HR and business stakeholders, including visualizations, written summaries, and presentations
  • Partner with HR functions throughout the lifecycle of analytics initiatives — from data gathering and exploratory analysis through delivery and documentation
  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and confidentiality of highly sensitive workforce data

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Psychology, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Computer Science, or related discipline) with 5+ years of relevant experience; or Master's degree in a relevant field with up to 3 years of experience (including graduate research or internships)
  • 9+ years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Solid grounding in statistics, including hypothesis testing, correlation, and regression modeling
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying, filtering, joining, and aggregating structured data from relational databases
  • Proficiency in a statistical programming language (R or Python) for data manipulation, analysis, and visualization
  • Ability to interpret analytical results accurately and communicate findings clearly in written and verbal form
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, well-documented work
  • Proven ability to manage projects independently, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-quality results
  • Demonstrated integrity and discretion when working with sensitive data
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Must be a US citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in people analytics, organizational behavior, industrial-organizational psychology, or workforce research
  • Exposure to machine learning concepts and practical application (academic projects, internships, or professional experience)
  • Experience with Workday reporting and HRIS data structures
  • Familiarity with Alteryx or similar tools for data preparation and workflow automation
  • Experience working with HR or employee data in a professional or research setting

Target Salary Range

$80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

We are seeking a Senior Virtual Power Plant Operations Expert to oversee the operational integrity of our Virtual Power Plant software. In this role, you will bridge the gap between energy market strategies and the performance of physical assets. You will act as the primary owner of our SaaS platform, ensuring that our portfolio of assets—specifically Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)—is configured, monitored, and dispatched effectively to meet commercial objectives.

Note: We can only consider candidates based in Austria, Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, Slovakia, Spain, and the UK (or open to relocation to one of these countries, provided the candidate holds the right to work).

What you do

As part of our handpicked team of experts, you will

  • SaaS Platform Ownership & Configuration: Serve as the functional owner of the VPP software. You will configure system parameters, adjust logic for new commercial products, and ensure the platform is optimized to translate market signals into physical asset behaviour effectively.

  • Vendor Management & Roadmap Coordination: Act as the primary liaison with the external software provider. You will be responsible for translating internal operational requirements into technical feature requests, monitoring vendor performance against SLAs, and driving the resolution of software bugs to minimize operational downtime.

  • Asset Monitoring & Incident Resolution: Monitor the real-time activity of the asset portfolio to ensure accurate dispatch. You will serve as the first line of defense for operational issues, troubleshooting root causes (software logic vs. connectivity) to mitigate revenue loss and avoid grid penalties.

  • New Asset Integration: Manage the technical onboarding process for new assets entering the VPP. This involves configuring telemetry, validating communication protocols, and conducting end-to-end control tests to ensure seamless commercial activation.

  • Operational Support (On-Call): Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to support the trading and dispatch teams. You will provide critical problem-solving during non-standard hours to ensure continuous reliability of our grid services.

Requirements

How you fit into the team

  • Energy Industry Expertise: A strong understanding of power markets (Day-Ahead, Intraday, Balancing) and the operational processes required to deliver power to the grid.

  • German Balancing Markets: Hands-on experience with FCR and aFRR prequalification in Germany, with the operational requirements of delivering these products, and with their settlement.

  • Asset Dispatch Experience (BESS Focus): Proven experience in the monitoring or dispatching of energy assets. Specific experience with Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)—including knowledge of State of Charge (SoC) management and cycling constraints—is a strict requirement.

  • Technical Application Management: Demonstrated ability to manage complex B2B software tools (SaaS). You must be comfortable navigating admin interfaces, configuring detailed settings, and understanding automation logic.

  • Coding Experience: programming skills are a plus (Python, C#)

  • Industrial Communication Protocols: Familiarity with industrial communication standards is a distinct advantage, specifically IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP, AMQP, or similar IoT protocols used for asset connectivity.

  • Gateways & Controllers: Experience working with communication gateways, multiprotocol gateways, or PLCs

  • Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow/automation, Salesforce data modeling, security/sharing, APIs, asynchronous processing, and platform limits
  • Ability to manage technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
  • Ability to develop, test, maintain, and support integrations between Salesforce and SaaS, custom, cloud, or on-premises applications using REST APIs, event-driven patterns, middleware, custom connectors, and web services
  • Strong knowledge of source control, CI/CD, code review, testing, release management, and DevSecOps practices
  • Ability to perform technical impact and dependency analysis and recognize when architectural, security, data, or enterprise escalation is required
  • Must be able to write technical specifications, implementation documentation, root cause analyses, and engineering standards

Physical Requirements:

Local Infusion is the fastest growing infusion provider in the United States, with a mission to transform the specialty infusion industry, because patients deserve better. By providing both exceptional, patient-centered care and the proprietary, AI-driven technology powering it, Local Infusion accelerates access, simplifies workflows, and improves outcomes for everyone in the infusion journey — from patients and clinicians to health plans, health systems, employers, and pharma.

Clinicians can spend less time on paperwork and more time with patients, bringing comfort, connection, and community back to healthcare. With Local Infusion, every patient and every care team is fully supported, every step of the way.

Role Overview: Infusion Nurse Practitioner

We are seeking a skilled and compassionate Nurse Practitioner (NP) to support the clinical launch of our new infusion centers. This part-time (approx 8 hours/week or 1 day/week) in-person role is dedicated to providing high-quality patient care and support through the launch of our new centers. The ideal candidate will bring clinical expertise, attention to detail, and a commitment to patient safety and operational excellence.

Location: Remote. Work from Home.

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Ensure effective communication with patients across all aspects of their care (scheduling, symptoms, inquiries, etc.)

  • Coordinate with referring/prescribing providers to ensure effective delivery of care through order clarification, patient status, and plan of care communication

  • Resolve clinical escalations, in accordance with policies and procedures

Quality & Compliance Responsibilities

  • Onboard new Medicare patients, completing establishment calls and documentation

Key Accountabilities

  • Clinical Quality

  • Regulatory Clinical Compliance

Qualifications:

  • Current and unrestricted Nurse Practitioner license in Indiana.

  • Minimum 2 years of Nurse Practitioner experience in outpatient or infusion-based care.

  • Strong clinical judgment, experience in IV therapy preferred.

  • Excellent communication, documentation, and organizational skills.

The Local Infusion Way

Local Infusion is a respectful, upbeat, and remote-first team united by our mission of shaping the way specialty infusion care is delivered. Strong proficiency in Python and AI development libraries.

– Hands-on experience with AI frameworks

– Proficiency with AI orchestration

– Working knowledge of vector databases

  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and containerization technologies

PREFERRED SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES

eClerx Digital is the trusted partner of choice to many of the world’s largest global brands for creative production, e-commerce/web operations, and analytics and insights services. Global industry leaders partner with us to cost-effectively scale their digital activities by leveraging our highly skilled blended resource model.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

People come to TopDog Law at one of the hardest moments of their lives: injured, overwhelmed, and unsure of what comes next. They need someone in their corner who knows their name, understands their situation, and is actively fighting to get them the best possible outcome. The Case Manager exists to be that person, a dedicated advocate who owns the client relationship completely and ensures no one ever feels like just a file number. When this role is done right, clients feel heard, supported, and confident that someone is genuinely working for them.

What You Will Own

  • Own the client relationship from day one through settlement, the Welcome Call is yours, the relationship is yours, and the outcome is yours
  • Be the client's dedicated advocate, connecting them to the right care fast and walking them through one of the most stressful experiences of their life with confidence and compassion
  • Drive cases forward with urgency, moving through each phase with precision and purpose
  • Build demand packages that tell a compelling story and negotiate toward outcomes that make a real difference for real people
  • Be the source of truth on every case you touch, leveraging cutting-edge technology to stay sharp, move fast, and never let anything slip
  • This is not a hand-off role, it's full ownership, and for the right person, it's one of the most impactful seats in the firm

What You Bring

Required:

  • 2–6 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in Florida
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor's degree or Paralegal Certificate
  • Experience in a high-volume or fast-growing law firm
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $61,200 to $85,000 per year, commensurate with experience (Remote, Florida)
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The role

You will be BJAK's person on the ground, responsible for getting the business established and growing. That means building partner relationships from scratch, working out how the market operates, and shaping the strategy that sits behind both.

This is a broad role in a new market. Some weeks will be partnership negotiation, others will be regulatory groundwork, operational setup, or working out why something is not converting. We are looking for someone comfortable moving between all of it rather than a specialist in any one part.

What you will do

Partnerships

  • Identify, approach and close partnerships with financial institutions and ecosystem players

  • Own each relationship end to end, from first conversation through negotiation, onboarding, integration and go-live

  • Lead commercial negotiations, with sound judgement on pricing and partnership economics

  • Keep a visible pipeline, with disciplined follow-up and clear reporting

  • Work with legal, product, technology and compliance to get agreements live quickly

Get the market working

  • Establish how we operate locally, including the regulatory requirements that apply to us

  • Work with external counsel and internal compliance on the policies we need in place as we grow

  • Act as a primary point of contact for regulators and manage filings and communications

  • Own monthly revenue, volume and activation targets, and drive partner productivity after go-live

Strategy and operations

  • Set the local strategy — which segments we go after, which partners matter most, where we compete and where we do not

  • Build the operating rhythm behind it, from reporting and planning through to the processes the team runs on

  • Feed what you learn locally into our wider regional and global strategy, and bring the global playbook back into the local market

  • Work with teams across the group, taking what has already worked elsewhere rather than rebuilding from scratch

What we are looking for

  • Fluent Indonesian and English, written and spoken

raw.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Events Marketing team is part of Stripe's broader Americas Marketing organization and builds high-impact event experiences across key industry, product, and segment priorities. The Product and Financial Services portfolio supports programs that drive pipeline, deepen customer relationships, and accelerate adoption of Stripe's revenue and financial infrastructure products. In this role, you'd join a team that values precision, creativity, sound judgment, and strong operational partnership.

What you’ll do

We're looking for an experienced events professional to own the planning and execution of a focused portfolio of Product and Financial Services events within AMER Events Marketing. You'll lead end-to-end delivery of event programs aligned to Stripe's Financial Services and product go-to-market priorities, spanning third-party industry conferences and Stripe-hosted experiences. Your portfolio will include Financial Services programs such as Money20/20 and product-focused industry events. Day to day, you'll manage multiple concurrent programs while partnering closely with field marketing, product marketing, partner marketing, and external agencies to deliver experiences that support pipeline, account engagement, and relationship depth.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end planning, coordination, and onsite execution for a portfolio of Financial Services and product-focused third-party and first-party events, including Money20/20.
  • Translate event objectives into clear program plans, audience experiences, workbacks, staffing plans, and success measures
  • Partner with field marketing, demand generation, product marketing, partner marketing and industry go-to-market teams to align programs with business priorities and audience needs
  • Develop, manage, and track event budgets, surfacing variances, timeline risks, and scope tradeoffs early with recommended paths forward
  • Serve as the primary event point of contact for agencies, vendors, venues, and other external partners supporting the portfolio.
  • Manage logistics end to end, including venue sourcing, vendor coordination, contracts, catering, audio/visual, staffing, run-of-show, and onsite execution
  • Independently manage day-to-day planning and delivery across assigned programs, coordinating stakeholders and keeping workbacks on track.
  • Maintain accurate event data in relevant event-management and CRM systems to support registration, lead capture, pipeline attribution, and reporting.
  • Lead post-event reporting across pipeline influence, lead generation, engagement, and budget performance, and turn findings into practical improvements
  • Present post-event findings, learnings, and recommendations to the Head of AMER Events and relevant GTM stakeholders.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 4–6 years of event-management experience, preferably in B2B technology, fintech, financial services, payments, or product marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering third-party sponsorships and company-hosted events from planning through onsite execution and post-event reporting.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-stakes events concurrently.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across marketing, sales, product, and executive audiences.
  • Experience managing event budgets, vendors, agencies, and operational details.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional dependencies.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience producing Financial Services, fintech, payments, or product-marketing events.
  • Familiarity with product and industry events such as Money20/20, MRC, and MAG.
  • Familiarity with Revenue, Money Management, or related Stripe product narratives.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and event-management platforms such as Splash, Cvent, or comparable tools.
  • Experience supporting executive-level programs, including roundtables, hosted dinners, and invitation-only summits.
  • Strong analytical mindset and experience using event data to inform decisions and report pipeline attribution.

raw.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Nottingham, covering Nottingham or surrounding areas such as Derby (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Customer Care команди шукаємо Customer Care Specialist.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • відповідь на запити клієнтів через визначені канали зв'язку (чати, листи);

  • надання інформації про продукти / послуги;

  • вирішення проблем та співпраця з профільними командами за необхідності;

  • документування взаємодії з користувачами;

  • моніторинг і дотримання визначених особистих кількісних та якісних показників;

  • фіксація та передача фідбеку клієнтів.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • володіння англійською на рівніUpper-Intermediate та вище;

  • комунікативні навички: відмінне вміння спілкуватися з різними типами клієнтів, включаючи незадоволених або роздратованих;

  • емпатія: здатність поставити себе на місце клієнта, розуміти його потреби та почуття;

  • уважність: вміння уважно сприймати інформацію та ставити відповідні запитання для чіткого розуміння проблеми або запиту клієнта;

  • стресостійкість: здатність зберігати спокій в складних або конфліктних ситуаціях;

  • організованість та пунктуальність: вміння пріоритезувати завдання для своєчасної відповіді на запити клієнтів;

  • командність: здатність ефективно співпрацювати з колегами та іншими відділами компанії для розв'язування питань клієнтів;

  • відкритість: не боїшся нових викликів, показати себе, працювати над покращеннями;

  • вміння ефективно користуватися комп'ютером та програмним забезпеченням: володієш навичками роботи з електронною поштою, чатами та іншими базовими програмами.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • володіння німецькою;

  • досвід роботи в підтримці;

  • володіння навичками роботи в CRM-системах, омніканальних платформах;

  • досвід роботи в iGaming.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

P.S. Якщо після відгуку не бачиш нашого листа – зазирни у “Спам” або інші розділи. Іноді наші відповіді губляться там 👀

raw.description:
Senior Data Engineer – Snowflake & dbt | Remoto México y LATAM

En DaCodes buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Datos Senior para construir una plataforma en Snowflake que transforme información de distintos sistemas en datos confiables para negocio y soluciones de inteligencia artificial.

Si disfrutas construir pipelines, resolver diferencias entre fuentes y asegurar que los indicadores sean correctos, esta oportunidad puede interesarte.

Modalidad: Remoto · Tiempo completo
Ubicación: México y Latinoamérica
Idioma de trabajo: Español
Inglés: Intermedio, con comprensión de documentación técnica

Requirements

El proyecto

Construirás un almacén de datos en Snowflake integrando bases de datos, APIs y archivos. Tendrás responsabilidad sobre la extracción, transformación, modelado, calidad, seguridad y operación de la capa de datos.

Trabajarás con usuarios de negocio y un ingeniero de IA para que los agentes consulten información con métricas claras, cifras verificables y permisos de acceso adecuados.

Qué harás

  • Desarrollar pipelines desde SQL Server, SAP ASE/Sybase, APIs REST y archivos, utilizando conexiones ODBC y un patrón de conectores basado en Openflow.
  • Conservar los datos originales y sus marcas de extracción para permitir reprocesos sin consultar nuevamente las fuentes.
  • Construir capas Bronze, Silver y Gold, modelos dimensionales y mecanismos de historización.
  • Desarrollar transformaciones con dbt, incluyendo modelos incrementales, pruebas y documentación.
  • Homologar catálogos e identificadores entre sistemas mediante equivalencias versionadas y controles de cobertura.
  • Implementar reglas de calidad, cuarentena y conciliación contra fuentes y reportes de negocio.
  • Orquestar cargas nocturnas, monitorear ejecuciones y resolver fallas.
  • Administrar permisos y políticas de acceso en Snowflake, además de controlar rendimiento y consumo de créditos.
  • Colaborar en modelos semánticos, consultas verificadas y pruebas de exactitud para el consumo por agentes de IA.
  • Documentar linaje, operación y procedimientos de recuperación para transferir la solución al equipo del cliente.

Qué necesitamos

Experiencia en ingeniería de datos

  • Al menos cinco años construyendo almacenes de datos en producción y dos años trabajando con Snowflake.
  • SQL avanzado y experiencia investigando esquemas y reglas de sistemas con poca documentación.
  • Modelado dimensional: esquemas estrella, dimensiones conformadas e historización.
  • Trabajo directo con negocio para definir métricas, homologar información y resolver diferencias entre reportes y fuentes.

Snowflake y dbt

  • Dominio de warehouses, RBAC, row access policies, masking y resource monitors.
  • Experiencia avanzada con dbt: transformaciones, pruebas declarativas, materializaciones incrementales y documentación generada.
  • Capacidad para diagnosticar problemas de rendimiento y controlar consumo de recursos.

Integración y operación

  • Experiencia extrayendo datos de SQL Server y SAP ASE/Sybase.
  • Integración de APIs REST con autenticación, renovación de tokens, paginación, límites de peticiones y reintentos.
  • Orquestación de pipelines, monitoreo, calidad de datos, cuarentena y reprocesos.

Datos para IA

  • Experiencia integrando almacenes de datos con soluciones LLM: modelos semánticos, Text-to-SQL gobernado y consultas verificadas.
  • Conocimiento práctico de trazabilidad, controles de acceso y evaluación de precisión y repetibilidad de respuestas.

Suma puntos si tienes experiencia con

  • Snowflake Intelligence, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents o Cortex Search.
  • Openflow, Dynamic Tables o Snowpark.
  • RAG sobre documentos integrado con datos estructurados.
  • ERPs sobre Sybase o SQL Server.
  • Certificación SnowPro Core o Advanced.

Qué valoramos

Autonomía para llevar una solución hasta su operación, rigor para validar cifras y comunicación clara para explicar decisiones técnicas y diferencias de información.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.

📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.

🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.

🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).

🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).

🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.

📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.

📢 Clases de inglés.

🏅 Orgullosamente certificados como Great Place to Work.

raw.description:
Study Now runs Global Student Pathway (GSP), a production education marketplace and student-recruitment platform used daily by counsellors, admissions officers and agent partners across nine destination markets. We have just brought the platform fully in-house, and you will be the person who makes it boringly reliable: deployed safely, monitored properly, backed up provably, and secure enough to hold student visa and identity documents.

What you’ll do


  • Assess and harden our estate across Linode and DigitalOcean, fronted by Cloudflare — topology, regions, MongoDB, storage — and own the resilience plan from day one, against defined targets: 99.9% uptime, 4-hour recovery from total provider failure (RTO), no more than 1 hour of data loss (RPO).

  • Build the 3-2-1 backup regime: hourly encrypted MongoDB dumps to a second region, automatic off-provider replication, a local encrypted archive — proven by monthly restore drills, not assumed to work.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD for our MEAN-stack application so releases ship with zero downtime — rolling restarts behind a load balancer, then blue-green — with the QA team’s automated suite wired in as a release gate.

  • Run monitoring, alerting and incident response: uptime, error rates and performance visible at all times, with alerts reaching the right person before users notice; write and rehearse the disaster-recovery runbook.

  • Own the security posture: secrets management, access control, Cloudflare WAF and rules, security-audit remediation, and UK GDPR alignment for the student data GSP holds (passports, visa documents, education records).

  • Manage cloud costs across providers, report spend monthly, and evaluate consolidation or AWS-based recovery on evidence — our current position is hardened-in-place with off-provider backup.

  • Document everything as runbooks usable by our two engineers without you on the call — a small team means no tribal knowledge.

What we’re looking for


  • 4+ years running production infrastructure for a live web application, including at least one platform you were personally accountable for.

  • Hands-on with the pieces we run: Linux servers on Linode/DigitalOcean (or similar VPS providers), Cloudflare (DNS, caching, WAF), Docker, and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Ansible) strongly preferred.

  • MongoDB operations in production: replica sets, backups, restores and migrations under load.

  • Deploying and operating Node.js applications — our stack is MEAN (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node).

  • Evidence of security thinking: hardening, secrets management, access reviews; experience preparing for or remediating a security audit is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable being the only infrastructure person: pragmatic, communicative, biased to documentation and automation over heroics.

Nice to have

Experience in edtech, CRM-style platforms or other systems holding sensitive personal data; UK GDPR / Cyber Essentials familiarity; experience taking over a platform from a departing team.

Working with us

Remote from India, employed through an employer-of-record or as a direct contractor (agreed at offer). Company laptop provided.

Salary: £1,170 – £1,950/Month

raw.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:


Job Description

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer leads the design, development, and deployment of complex features in the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. This role builds high-performance React and Next.js (TypeScript) features and works closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.

This individual drives the technical direction of features, contributes to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning, and mentors junior engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex front-end features in React and Next.js, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Build Server and Client Components that follow the team’s rendering and caching standards, including read-your-writes behavior for decision forms.
  • Implement backend-for-frontend (BFF) endpoints and integrate with .NET (C#) and Python (FastAPI) services, and Entra ID / OpenID Connect authentication.
  • Build data-heavy screens, including large grids, PDF and document viewers, rich-text editors, and workflow wizards, using component libraries such as KendoReact or MUI.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive the technical direction of features, contributing to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning.

Agentic User Experience

  • Build streaming user interfaces (SSE) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative UI using the Vercel AI SDK, assistant-ui, and CopilotKit over the AG-UI protocol.
  • Implement human-in-the-loop flows that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations, including Pydantic AI tool-approval interrupts.
  • Implement robust handling for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including retries, timeouts, resumable streams, and clear status messaging.
  • Contribute to the AG-UI event contract and shared-state design with the agent team.

Engineering Excellence

  • Conduct thorough coding reviews, provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best coding practices.
  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Build accessible components that meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 and resolve accessibility defects.
  • Write component and end-to-end tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Identify and implement improvements to CI/CD pipelines, supply-chain controls, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working to ensure high availability and reliability of the user experience.

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns to benefit the team.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Handle patient data safely under HIPAA, keeping PHI out of browser storage, client logs, and telemetry.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
  • Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with Next.js, including Server and Client Components, server-side rendering, and streaming.
  • Experience building streaming or real-time user interfaces using Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.
  • Experience building data-heavy enterprise screens using component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI.
  • Experience integrating front ends with REST APIs and backend services, including the backend-for-frontend pattern.
  • Experience implementing authentication with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect.
  • Strong knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, with experience building accessible applications.
  • Experience with Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and Git-based workflows, including pull requests.
  • Strong, daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team of technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, present to stakeholders, and write detailed documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with agentic UI frameworks and protocols such as AG-UI, CopilotKit, assistant-ui, or the Vercel AI SDK.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop experiences for AI agents, including approval and override workflows.
  • Familiarity with Python and Pydantic AI.
  • Experience with FHIR R4; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus.
  • Experience consuming events from Azure Service Bus or similar message brokers.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and OpenTelemetry.

• Experience with C# and .NET.

  • Experience integrating AI services, models, or agents into production applications.
  • Healthcare domain experience, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID.
