raw.title: IT Delivery Manager (Remote - US)
raw.excerpt: OverviewWorld Travel Holdings is seeking an experienced, remote IT Delivery Manager to help us deliver innovative solutions that make leisure travel more accessible and fun.
raw.description:
Overview

World Travel Holdings is seeking an experienced, remote IT Delivery Manager to help us deliver innovative solutions that make leisure travel more accessible and fun. This crucial role will oversee and lead a team of business analysts, scrum masters and project managers in a hybrid waterfall/agile process and partner with strategic business partners and technical leaders to bridge the gap between business and technology. The ideal candidate will be an excellent critical and strategic thinker, be a strong team leader, and have a deep understanding of business analysis and project management methodologies, responsibilities, and best practices.

About the Company

World Travel Holdings, headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, is the nation’s largest cruise agency and an award‑winning leisure travel company with nearly 40 travel brands. Through owned brands and private‑label partnerships, we sell cruises, villas, resort day passes, and luxury travel services. With a top-rated franchise, a UK cruise division, and a strong commitment to employee engagement and remote work, World Travel Holdings offers a people-focused culture. Learn more: WorldTravelHoldings.com

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and manage a team of business analysts, scrum masters and project managers providing guidance, support, coaching and fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment
  • Establish and maintain best practices for requirements gathering, documentation and stakeholder engagement
  • Set clear performance expectations and ensure accountability for delivery commitments
  • Foster a culture of growth, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Position yourself and the team as technical and business thought leaders, to drive business outcomes through a deep understanding of technology
  • Train, mentor, and support teams in Agile and Waterfall methodologies

Business & Technology Alignment

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into clear, actionable requirements
  • Maintain a holistic understanding of business processes, customer journeys, and technical dependencies
  • Build a strong understanding of the technical ecosystem, across the front end experiences to the back end services and APIs
  • Jira administrator, trainer and champion the adoption of BA tools, including project and technical documentation repositories and knowledge bases

Program Management & Delivery Oversight

  • Lead the development and execution of long-range portfolio plans, defining scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets
  • Establish governance structures for decision-making, escalation, and reporting
  • Oversee resource planning and allocation for project managers, scrum masters, business analysts, and cross-functional delivery teams
  • Act as Program Manager across all delivery tracks, managing dependencies, risks, and milestones holistically
  • Provide unified program status, risks, and priorities to leadership
  • Ensure scope, timeline, and budget adherence for all projects
  • Proactively escalate issues and provide solution-oriented recommendations
  • Manage projects through the full life cycle: Initiating, Planning, Executing, Monitoring & Controlling, and Closing
  • Lead Scrum Masters in effective Agile ceremonies and Project Managers in roadmap delivery

Requirements Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end process of gathering, analyzing, and developing business requirements documents and user stories
  • Develop and maintain high-quality artifacts including business requirements, acceptance criteria, business process flows and system interaction diagrams
  • Ensure requirements reflect scalability, security, quality and usability considerations
  • Maintain and improve governance practices and tools (project intake, prioritization, status reporting, retrospectives, planning)
  • Perform high level business requirements gathering and assessments early in the project life cycle, prior to project being assigned to a delivery team
  • Ensure the effective configuration, administration, and utilization of project management platforms such as Jira, SmartSheets and SharePoint
  • Ensure consistent documentation practices (RAID tracking, status reports, change logs)
  • Facilitate executive workshops, steering committees, and cross-functional discovery sessions.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders (business, operations & technology) by clarifying needs, challenging assumptions, and identifying opportunities for optimization
  • Ensure stakeholder alignment on program goals, success metrics, and dependencies
  • Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and cross-functional discussions to align on scope and deliverables
  • Build strong relationships across technology, business, and operations teams
  • Translate business objectives into actionable delivery plans.
  • Provide executive-level reporting that translates Agile progress into milestone-based tracking

Risk & Issue Management

  • Build structures to capture and validate assumptions for all program/project plans
  • Identify, track, and resolve risks and issues at both project and program levels
  • Ensure delivery teams have the support, decisions, and clarity needed to succeed
  • Anticipate bottlenecks and act early to remove blockers

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field required
  • 8+ years of relevant business analysis, project management, and project leadership experience, with a minimum of 2 years as a people manager
  • Relevant business analysis, project management, and Agile certifications preferred (e.g., Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), etc.)
  • Experience working in a hybrid model of a blend of waterfall and agile project delivery
  • Demonstrated expertise in understanding data flows, integrations, and cloud-based (GCP & Azure) architectures for front-end and back-end platforms
  • Advanced proficiency in using SQL, Excel, Tableau, or other data analysis tools is highly desirable. Experience in data modeling, database design, or software development is a plus
  • Intimate working knowledge of agile tools required, preferably Jira and Confluence, but understanding of tools such as Trello, Scrumwise and demonstrated ability to implement and learn a new tool accepted
  • Ability to translate complex technical details into business-friendly language
  • Familiarity with cruise ship operations or the travel industry, including revenue management, passenger booking systems, and onboard operations a plus
  • Employees must be in good standing; no written warnings in the past six months

Compensation & BenefitsEstimated Pay Range: $140,000 - $160,000

Benefits Overview:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with discretionary company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Travel discounts and employee perks
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Professional development and learning opportunities

Gloss is a U.S. based digital marketing agency founded in 2007, and we've had a full-time Filipino staff since 2008.

We are seeking a full-time, senior level "Rock Star" Web Developer with at least 5 years experience who can work from home in the Philippines.

This is a dynamic and exciting position as you will lead our highly diverse development efforts in a fast-paced digital marketing environment.

It is absolutely imperative that you have at least 5 years experience and meet the qualifications in this job description.

We are only hiring top-notch "cream-of-the-crop" talent!

JOB DESCRIPTION

We have internal resources for design, copywriting and content creation, but the right candidate will be very comfortable leading the development effort and providing overall technical expertise in all phases of digital marketing, including the following:

  • Corporate Website: Ongoing site development and enhancement of our website
  • Email Marketing: Listbuilding, content creation, optimization, analytics, API development
  • Social Media Marketing & Promotion: Content distribution, organic traffic, paid traffic, optimization, analytics, API development
  • Content Marketing: Content creation, internal organization/process, distribution
  • Paid Advertising: Tracking, reporting, API development

JOB REQUIREMENTS

We are looking for top talent, so you must have the following skill sets (specifically in a digital marketing environment):

  • Expert level experience implementing Wordpress plugins, CSS, themes, templates, customization and API integration
  • Expert level experience implementing PHP, SQL, CSS, HTML and databases
  • Expert level experience implementing and deploying APIs
  • Proven ability working with tracking systems, analytics, conversion/pixel/postback tracking, and reporting
  • Proven ability in researching, recommending and implementing solutions to meet project requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple projects (with support from our full-time Filipino Project Manager)
  • Your own computer and Internet connection

PERSONALITY REQUIREMENTS

  • You'll have plenty of support (e.g. tools, resources, infrastructure, assistance from our VAs and more...), but you must have the mindset that you "own" your projects. If you're the type of person who waits to be told what to do at every step throughout a project, then this position isn't right for you.
  • You'll be provided with very clear project instructions and requirements, but you must also be able to work independently, figure things out for yourself, do your own research when necessary, and adopt an attitude of "I'm going to do whatever it takes to get the job done!"
  • You must have a natural curiosity and passion for learning new technology, not just for the sake of the technology itself, but in how technology can be used to maximize the potential of our digital marketing efforts.

    For example, we want someone who will (proactively) drill down into all of the features and functionality of software and tools we own and (proactively) tell us, e.g. "I discovered this feature we can implement to create a better user experience (or improve conversion rate, or increase ROI, or enhance operations, etc...).

COMPENSATION PACKAGE

Our goal is to work with professionals seeking long-term employment. We offer competitive pay and flexible hours. Compensation packages include the following:

  • Guaranteed 100% On-Time Salary Payments
  • 13th Month Bonus
  • Paid National Holidays
  • Raises & Performance Bonuses

title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
description: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
raw.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
raw.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

raw.excerpt: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
raw.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

raw.description:
Position Summary

Are you passionate about clinical documentation, risk adjustment, and improving the quality of patient care? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and quality of clinical documentation across our organization.

If you're a collaborative problem solver with a strong background in Medicare and Medicaid Risk Adjustment, HCC Coding, Clinical Documentation Improvement, and provider education, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Clinical Documentation Improvement & Risk Adjustment

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on ICD-10-CM Coding Guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and Risk Adjustment methodologies.
  • Conduct proactive medical record reviews to evaluate documentation quality, diagnosis coding accuracy, co-morbidities, complications, and appropriate secondary diagnoses.
  • Ensure patient conditions are accurately documented and coded to support quality care and appropriate risk stratification.
  • Identify documentation and coding trends impacting patient risk scores and value-based care performance.

Provider Education & Training

  • Develop and deliver engaging education programs for providers, coders, and clinical care teams.
  • Provide ongoing guidance on documentation best practices, coding updates, compliance requirements, and risk adjustment principles.
  • Create educational tools, resources, and training materials that improve coding accuracy and documentation quality.
  • Partner with providers to identify opportunities for documentation improvement and workflow optimization.

Value-Based Care & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate with contracted health plans on risk adjustment and value-based care initiatives.
  • Support auditing activities, review health plan findings, and develop performance improvement plans when needed.
  • Participate in clinical quality, revenue cycle, population health, and data analytics initiatives.
  • Monitor regulatory, coding, and reimbursement changes and communicate impacts across the organization.

Data Analysis & Collaboration

  • Analyze documentation and coding trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work closely with clinical leadership, coding teams, health plans, and operational stakeholders.
  • Help drive strategies that improve quality scores, risk adjustment accuracy, and overall organizational performance.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Certified Risk Coder (CRC) through AAPC or CDI/CCS certification through AHIMA.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Medicare and/or Medicaid Risk Adjustment, including HHS-HCC, CMS-HCC, or DxCG methodologies.
  • Strong experience with ICD-10 coding and clinical documentation review.
  • In-depth knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, and disease processes.
  • Expertise in HCC coding and risk adjustment programs.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to educate audiences at all levels.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current RN license in good standing.
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) through AAPC.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience, preferably in a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) or primary care environment.
  • Experience with Epic Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.
  • Experience supporting value-based care and population health initiatives.

Why Join Us?

At our organization, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care while supporting a mission focused on improving community health. Your expertise will help ensure providers have the tools and knowledge needed to deliver high-quality, value-based care to the populations we serve.

What We Offer

100% Remote Work – Work from anywhere within the United States.

100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance – Comprehensive medical coverage at no cost to employees on one of our health plans.

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and maintain work-life balance.

403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Contribution – Invest in your future with retirement savings support.

Professional Development & Education Assistance – Grow your skills through ongoing learning, certifications, and educational opportunities.

Mission-Driven Culture – Join a team dedicated to strengthening community health and expanding access to quality healthcare services.

Disclaimer

At this time, Health Choice Network is not able to employ individuals who reside or work in California. Applicants must reside and perform work in an approved state at the time of hire and throughout employment.

raw.excerpt: The OrganizationWhat if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose?
raw.description:
The Organization

What if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose? Wayfinder, a division of Lemnis, was founded at the Stanford d.school to answer this question. Our goal is to double our impact each year for the coming years. Our vision is to become the preeminent future-readiness curriculum company in the world — leading the global movement of purpose, meaning, and belonging-based education worldwide.

Wayfinder joined the Lemnis Collective as a nonprofit division in 2026. As a public charity, Lemnis is dedicated to the concept of the unlimited learner. Their mission is to create more accessible, flexible, learner-centered systems that help young people navigate the challenges and opportunities of the future. Wayfinder and Lemnis share that vision, especially when it comes to supporting learners in underserved communities and the institutions that serve them.

Wayfinder is the third organization to join the Lemnis Collective. The Collective brings mission-aligned organizations (both for-profit assets and nonprofits with earned revenue) under the Lemnis umbrella through mergers and acquisitions. Lemnis provides long-term, mission-driven investment, stability, freedom from the pressure of constant fundraising, and operational and strategic support, so organizations like Wayfinder can stay focused on our mission, impact, growth, and innovation.

What We Value

You’ll be joining a team of incredibly motivated and dedicated staff members committed to living our organization's values. We work collaboratively across teams, and we feel and act like a purpose-driven organization. To the best of our abilities, each person’s role aligns with their own sense of purpose, which feeds into Wayfinder’s larger sense of purpose.

Read this article about our workplace culture in Conscious Company.

We value equal access, inclusive community, and belonging, and these values are represented in our product, our team, and our school partners.

Product: We develop our learning tools using human-centered design principles. We work with grade-level experts to ensure our curriculum is developmentally appropriate and engaging at all levels. Every Wayfinder lesson is supported by relevant research, prototyped in classrooms, and vetted by teachers over rounds of feedback and iteration. We use Universal Design for Learning principles to give every student an equal opportunity to succeed.

Team: Our team is composed of people from all different backgrounds and walks of life. We intentionally recruit, hire, and work with people of all identities + experiences. We focus on belonging: being connected, accepted, and valued by the people around us.

School Partners: We intentionally target a wide array of educational partners, from traditional to non-traditional, that work with a range of students from different socioeconomic groups. We’ve taught our curriculum in high-need schools in the Bronx, independent schools in Silicon Valley, and after-school programs in San Antonio.

The Role

At Wayfinder, we believe every student deserves to develop belonging, purpose, and future-ready skills. Our web platform supports students, educators, and school communities through durable skill development, college and career readiness, and MTSS. We're looking for a Product Manager to help us build it with clarity, care, and momentum.

You’ll be the person who keeps our roadmap moving. As part of a small team, you’ll handle both product management and project management: shaping what we build and why, and managing the projects, tickets, and timelines that turn our plans into shipped features. You’ll make sure product, engineering, and product marketing are working from the same picture. You’ll also dig deep. Before we build anything, you’ll make sure we truly understand the problem, not just the broad strokes, by talking with educators, reviewing prototypes with stakeholders, and asking the questions that surface edge cases and key insights early.

This role is for someone who loves bringing people together around a shared plan, is comfortable in both technical conversations and classroom ones, and is excited about building AI-enabled products that make a real difference for students. You'll report to our VP of Product, and work closely with design, engineering, curriculum, and marketing.

We strongly encourage people from traditionally underrepresented populations in tech—such as women, People of Color, People with Disabilities, and LGBTQ+ people, etc—to apply!


Responsibilities

  • Manage projects across the product roadmap, owning timelines and progress from planning through release.

  • Facilitate sprint planning with engineering and design, keeping the backlog groomed and priorities clear for each cycle.

  • Write and maintain clear specs, user stories, and tickets, including acceptance criteria, so engineering can build with confidence.

  • Manage task creation and movement in Jira, keeping tickets organized, up to date, and moving through each stage of development.

  • Partner closely with engineering to understand technical constraints, make smart tradeoffs, and keep work moving.

  • Support QA and acceptance testing to confirm that what we ship matches the spec, and triage incoming bugs so the most important issues get fixed first.

  • Coordinate and facilitate discovery alongside design: identify stakeholders (including current and prospective partners), schedule review sessions, synthesize feedback, and help ensure we're building the right things in the right ways.

  • Dig into the details of the problems we're solving, asking the questions that uncover edge cases, dependencies, and unmet needs before they become surprises.

  • Coordinate feature launches from start to finish, set release timing, collaborate on support materials and announcements, and ensure product marketing and enablement, and support resources are ready before anything goes live.

  • Be the go-to source of product information for product marketing, enablement, and sales, answering questions, supporting RFP responses, and providing what teams need to communicate clearly with current and new partners.

  • Help keep in-product language clear and educator-friendly, reviewing copy on new features and suggesting edits that follow our product language guidelines.

  • Build consensus across teams, bringing different perspectives together and helping everyone align on priorities and decisions.

  • Define success metrics for features, track product analytics, and use data to guide decisions and measure impact.

  • Review incoming feedback from educators, partners, and internal teams throughout the year, and decide what to act on, whether that means building it now, adding it to the backlog, or closing the loop on why not.

  • Bring recommendations to roadmap planning based on what you're learning from feedback, data, and the market.

  • Stay current on the PreK-12 edtech landscape, including competitors, trends, and what districts are asking for, and share what you learn with the team.

  • Help shape and deliver AI-enabled features that make work easier for educators and learning more meaningful for students.

  • Communicate roadmap status, changes, and decisions clearly and proactively to stakeholders across the company.



Requirements

Essential experience

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, project management, or a closely related role on a software product.

  • Experience working on PreK-12 edtech products, ideally in areas like durable skill development, college and career readiness, or MTSS.

  • Strong technical understanding to work closely with engineers, discuss tradeoffs, and translate between technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A track record of managing complex projects, timelines, and backlogs, and of shipping on schedule.

  • Experience with Jira or similar task management software.

  • Strong skills in writing specs, user stories, and tickets that are clear, thorough, and easy to act on.

  • Experience working directly with internal and external stakeholders to review prototypes, gather feedback, and turn it into clear decisions.

  • Comfort with data: defining usage goals and success metrics, working with product analytics, and using evidence to make decisions.

  • A talent for building consensus and keeping teams aligned, even when priorities compete.

  • A habit of using AI tools to work faster and smarter, such as drafting tickets and specs, synthesizing feedback, or analyzing data.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a knack for explaining product details clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • A detail-oriented mindset and genuine curiosity about how people use products.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.


Preferred experience

  • Experience building or managing AI-enabled products or features.

  • Familiarity with design thinking, user research, or usability testing.

  • Experience working in a startup or other fast-moving environment.

  • Experience working with product marketing or enablement teams on launches and messaging.

  • An undergraduate degree or equivalent experience in a related field.

Benefits

    We offer a competitive package that is based on location and experience. We also offer the following benefits:

  • + 403b: We care about your ability to save for your future.

  • + Family Focus: Parental leave and flexibility for families.

  • + Time Off: Unlimited PTO policy to encourage people to get out and see the world.

  • + Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision policies + a monthly wellness stipend.

  • + Goodies: Whatever hardware and software you need to get the job done.

  • + Team Fun: Regularly scheduled events, annual retreat, and celebrations.

  • + Learning: Learning & Development Opportunities to grow your skills and career.

  • + Great team: Working with fun, hard-working, kind people committed to making a difference!

  • + Flexible culture: We are results-focused and entirely remote.

  • + And much more! Lots of other perks make this company an incredible place to work.

EEO Statement

At Wayfinder, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Wayfinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Pay Transparency

Wayfinder compensation is based on various factors including but not limited to job location, a candidate's education, training, experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value analysis including seniority and merit systems, as well as internal pay alignment. Annual salary is just one component of Wayfinder’s total compensation package. Additionally, Wayfinder provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, a monthly stipend, office buildout stipend, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off. Compensation ranges may differ based on contract value but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. An applicant's salary history will not be used in determining compensation.

Reasonable Accommodations

Wayfinder is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact HR at .

Additional Notice

Please note that this job description is only a summary of the typical functions of the job, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible responsibilities, tasks, and duties.

raw.title: Senior Transmission Planning Engineer - Stability Studies
raw.excerpt: Ready to make a difference? We are a relentlessly client-focused group re-imagining, re-designing, and re-engineering the way electric utilities tackle industry problems.
raw.description:
Ready to make a difference?

We are a relentlessly client-focused group re-imagining, re-designing, and re-engineering the way electric utilities tackle industry problems. Our transmission planning team delivers technically rigorous power system studies and strategic planning support to utilities, developers, and grid operators navigating one of the most dynamic periods in the history of the electric grid — from large-scale renewable interconnection and large load growth to FERC-driven transmission reform. We are seeking an experienced power system engineer with deep stability expertise who can independently execute transient stability and dynamic simulation studies, serve as a technical resource to clients and project teams, and help develop less-experienced engineers. Steady-state transmission planning experience is a strong plus.


Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment in the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

The Ideal Candidate
You are a technically deep power system stability engineer with a track record of leading complex stability and dynamic simulation studies from kickoff through final deliverable. You build, validate, and interpret dynamic models for conventional generation, inverter-based resources, and battery storage, and you can explain what the results mean for grid reliability. Experience with steady-state power flow and contingency analysis for transmission planning is a strong complement. You take ownership of your work and your clients. You move fluidly between dynamic studies, interconnection processes, and steady-state analysis without losing the thread.


What you will be doing:

  • Lead transient stability and dynamic simulation studies for utility planning and interconnection work using PSS/E, PSLF, and TSAT, evaluating conventional generation, inverter-based resources (IBR), and battery energy storage systems (BESS)
  • Develop, review, validate, and tune dynamic models, including generic renewable models (e.g., WECC) and user-defined models, through model quality tests such as flat-start, step-response, and fault ride-through checks
  • Assess stability performance against NERC TPL-001 and regional planning criteria and PRC-024/PRC-029 ride-through requirements, including voltage recovery, damping and oscillatory behavior, and critical clearing times
  • Perform voltage stability (PV/QV), weak-grid, and short-circuit-ratio screening, and coordinate with electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies where needed
  • Perform NERC reliability standards studies and assessments, including TPL-001 stability analysis and MOD-026/027/032/033 model verification and validation
  • Lead the stability portion of generation and large-load interconnection impact studies, including feasibility, facilities, and cluster/serial study processes across CAISO, MISO, PJM, ERCOT, WECC, and other regional footprints
  • Serve as technical lead or study manager on transmission planning engagements, owning scope, schedule, quality, and client relationship
  • Develop Python-based automation and tooling to improve study execution efficiency, model management, and output quality
  • Support steady-state load flow and contingency analysis (PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld) for utility transmission planning and interconnection studies
  • Support long-range transmission expansion planning, including load growth, generation retirement, and renewable buildout scenarios and FERC Order 1920 and Order 2023 compliance work
  • Author and QA technical study reports for regulatory filings, client deliverables, and interconnection submissions
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical review, guidance, and day-to-day collaboration
  • Participate in business development through proposal writing, scope development, client presentations, and identification of new opportunities
  • Track FERC policy, NERC standards, and grid technology trends, such as IBR performance requirements, to inform client strategy and internal capability development

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline, from an ABET-accredited college or university
  • 8+ years of experience in power system studies, with a focus on transient stability and dynamic simulation analysis
  • Hands-on experience performing stability studies and developing or validating dynamic models in PSS/E, PSLF, or equivalent software
  • Must be located in the United States, Canada or Puerto Rico.

What we would like you to have:

  • Advanced experience with transient, voltage (PV/QV), and small-signal stability studies, including development, validation, tuning, and interpretation of dynamic models
  • Experience evaluating stability performance of conventional generation, IBR, and BESS, including dynamic model verification under NERC MOD-026/027 and ride-through requirements under PRC-024/PRC-029 and IEEE 2800

Position Overview

Power your Future with Qualus in our Digital Solutions department as a Senior Power Systems Engineer. As a Senior Power Systems Engineer you will play a pivotal role in large scale system integration programs and take on the delivery of ADMS/OMS system and integration implementations from our leading ADMS/OMS software partners. You will also be providing consulting and project management services to our existing customers on projects involving product installation, integration development, interface support, modeling, application tuning, and system maintenance.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate all technical aspects of the project including planning, design, development, testing, and deployment.
  • Develop and execute system build plans accounting for software architecture, information security, and hardware deployment.
  • Work with the Project Manager and provide technical input into the overall project schedule, budget, resource requirements, and risk management.

  • Installation and configuration of OSI monarch advanced distribution management applications

  • Identify and troubleshoot any issues that arise during the implementation process.
  • Keep up to date with the latest developments in the field and ensure systems are implemented in accordance with industry best practices.
  • Travel to customer sites and work directly with customers to successfully deliver, test, and integrate systems
  • Contribute to proposals, work plans, budgets, and schedules for services opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field of study.
  • Ten (10) years of combined experience in project management and utility systems software implementation and consulting.
  • Demonstratable experience interacting with clients to understand relationships and priorities.

  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift work efforts based on client business goals.
  • Knowledge of project integration lifecycle and methodology.
  • Excellent problem-solving, written and oral communications and customer service skills.
  • Ability to lead and facilitate workshops covering the full breadth of the project lifecycle.

  • Experience in configuring Maven, Leitmotif, and eMAP

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Job Description Summary

Responsible for activities and processes that help the sales organization achieve business objectives
Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Guided by commercial practices and policies that may be shaped by the role. Has significant control/influence over commercial priorities. There is moderate autonomy within the role to enter into/execute Commercial arrangements. High levels of Commercial judgement are required to achieve outcomes required.

Job Description

Our business purpose:

We are a purpose-driven team delivering life-changing clarity through precision diagnostics, enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases such as Alzheimer’s, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer. By bringing together radiopharmaceuticals and PET imaging infrastructure, we help expand access to precision diagnostics for providers, health systems, and most importantly, patients. Behind every scan is a heartbeat, and behind every heartbeat is a story. We treat each one like it matters.

Who thrives here:

You’ll thrive here if you care deeply about your teammates, the people we serve, and doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring curiosity, structured thinking, and disciplined execution, with the confidence to bring a point of view and ask challenging questions. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, turning complexity into practical solutions, and collaborating across boundaries. You go deep to understand the business while thinking broadly about how what works can be shared and scaled.

Sales Excellence Business Partner (BP)

The Sales Excellence Business Partner (BP) is a strategic advisor and execution partner to senior sales leadership, connecting commercial strategy with disciplined field execution. The BP builds and continuously improves the commercial operating system that enables sales leaders and sellers to execute with greater clarity, visibility, discipline, and confidence.

As a proactive thought partner, the BP brings a Sales Excellence perspective to business decisions, constructively challenges assumptions, and assesses the operational readiness of commercial and go-to-market (GTM) strategies. Once decisions are made, the BP translates priorities into practical, scalable processes, capabilities, tools, insights, and operating mechanisms that drive sustained execution.

The BP goes deep within the franchise while building with scale in mind, solving for business needs while leveraging proven practices and identifying solutions that can be shared, standardized, or scaled across the broader organization.


Responsibilities for this highly visible role include, but are not limited to:
Build & Improve the Commercial Operating System

  • Develop a deep understanding of the franchise, customers, market dynamics, growth priorities, and field realities to anticipate business needs.
  • Define and reinforce sales standards, processes, standard work, KPIs, and operating rhythms that establish what good looks like.
  • Translate commercial and GTM strategies and priorities into executable sales motions (e.g. new customers, referral business, renewals), field priorities, capabilities, tools, and performance measures.
  • Assess operational readiness and partner cross-functionally to shape capabilities across Salesforce, analytics, incentive compensation, training, and other areas critical to field execution.
  • Continuously improve solutions based on business needs and execution performance, sharing best practices that can be standardized or scaled across franchises.

Create Visibility & Enable Better Decisions

  • Define and operationalize leading and lagging KPIs that answer critical business questions, such as customer segmentation, pipeline creation, deal velocity, conversion rate, and forecast accuracy.
  • Translate business questions and data into actionable insights and forward-looking visibility into performance, risks, opportunities, and progress toward targets.
  • Detect deviations from plans and standards early, diagnose root causes, and recommend actions that enable better, data-driven decisions.

Drive Execution Discipline & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and reinforce the sales operating cadence across pipeline, forecast, performance, account, and territory reviews.
  • Ensure business reviews drive decisions, actions, accountability, and follow-through, not simply reporting.
  • Monitor Salesforce adoption, data quality, pipeline and forecast health, and execution against standards; identify gaps and drive corrective action.
  • Coach leaders and sellers on effective use of sales processes, tools, analytics, and standard work, driving sustained adoption through reinforcement and continuous improvement.

Strategic Partnership & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Operate as a trusted partner within the franchise leadership team, bringing a proactive Sales Excellence perspective, constructively challenging thinking, and translating decisions into field execution.
  • Serve as the voice of the franchise in shaping broader commercial capabilities while leveraging and sharing best practices across the organization.
  • Lead through influence to align cross-functional partners, such as Marketing, Product and Program Management, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, and Training, around shared outcomes, success metrics, and operating principles.
  • Help shape capabilities such as capacity planning, incentive compensation design, territory alignment, and quota planning based on franchise strategy and selling motions.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Sales Operations, Sales Excellence, or Commercial Operations, with meaningful experience supporting complex sales organizations.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of best-in-class sales structures, processes, methodologies, and operating models, with the ability to adapt proven practices to different business contexts.
  • Strong end-to-end understanding of sales processes, including GTM execution, pipeline and forecast management, account and territory management, operating cadence, and performance management.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure and build scalable sales processes, capabilities, KPIs, standard work, and operating mechanisms, balancing franchise needs with solutions that can be replicated or scaled.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with proficiency in Salesforce and Power BI and the ability to leverage data and AI to investigate business questions, perform ad hoc analysis, diagnose root causes, and translate insights into actionable recommendations while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.
  • Strong business acumen, structured thinking, executive communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to partner with senior leaders, constructively challenge, navigate ambiguity, and drive cross-functional initiatives through adoption.
  • Experience in pharmaceuticals, radiopharmaceuticals, or healthcare businesses with similar commercial models and selling motions is preferred.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
Learn more about Pear:

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
Learn more about Keet:

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

Requirements

  • Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.

  • Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).

  • Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.

  • Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.

  • Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.

  • Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).

  • Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.

  • Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.

  • Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).

  • Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.

Market Context

Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.

This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Business Process & Systems Analyst

Position Location: Remote

JOB SUMMARY

The Business Process & Systems Analyst improves how work gets done across Smart Tech by simplifying processes, automating workflows, and optimizing business systems. This role partners across departments to develop practical, standardized solutions and enable employees to use them effectively.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Process & Workflow Design (35%)

  • Partner with departments to understand business needs, pain points, and opportunities for improvement
  • Document current-state processes and design efficient, standardized future-state workflows
  • Identify bottlenecks, manual work, duplicate efforts, and unclear ownership
  • Translate business needs into clear process, workflow, and system requirements
  • Develop process documentation and continuously evaluate workflows for improvement

Business Systems Ownership (25%)

  • Own and serve as the internal expert for Smartsheet, PowerBI and assigned business systems
  • Establish standards for system structure, permissions, templates, automation, and ownership
  • Partner with departments to select and implement the right system solutions for their needs
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and improve business systems to ensure they are scalable, reliable, and well documented

Automation (20%)

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate manual or repetitive processes
  • Design, build, test, and maintain automations using Smartsheet, Power Automate and other approved tools
  • Automate workflows, approvals, notifications, data movement, and reporting to improve efficiency and consistency
  • Partner with IT on complex integrations and troubleshoot automations to ensure reliable, sustainable solutions

Enablement (20%)

  • Create and deliver training, coaching, and resources to help employees effectively use business systems and workflows
  • Create templates, standards, and user-friendly guidance that support consistent, independent use
  • Support process and system rollouts through training, testing, communication, and adoption
  • Gather feedback and continuously improve training, workflows, and system usability

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, commercial, and jobsite environments
  • On occasion may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 10%, which may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Must be located near a major US airport
  • A valid form of identification acceptable for domestic air travel is required for travel associated with this position
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities, including client sites, meetings, business development activities, errands on behalf of the business, and industry conferences

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience with business process analysis, process mapping, requirements gathering, workflow design, or continuous improvement
  • Ability to analyze a business problem before selecting or building a technology solution
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear process designs, system configurations, automation requirements, and documentation
  • Strong facilitation, problem-solving, organizational, and analytical skills
  • Ability to create clear process maps, SOPs, job aids, training materials, and user documentation
  • Ability to train and coach users with different levels of technical proficiency
  • Experience supporting system rollouts, testing, adoption, and change management across multiple departments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a service-oriented, collaborative approach
  • Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with department leaders, process owners, Organizational Excellence, and IT

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Required

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, Organizational Development, Process Improvement, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in business analysis, business systems, process improvement, operations enablement, workflow design, or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience designing and improving cross-functional business processes
  • Hands-on experience with Smartsheet or a similar work management platform, including sheets, forms, reports, dashboards, and workflow automation
  • Experience with Microsoft PowerBI and SQL based servers
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate or a similar workflow automation platform
  • Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and M365 environment
  • Demonstrated experience documenting requirements, workflows, processes, and end-user guidance

Preferred

  • Experience in construction, engineering, technology integration, or another project-driven industry
  • Experience facilitating process-improvement workshops and supporting organizational change
  • Exposure to PMO/BMO environments, operational governance, Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous-improvement methods
  • Relevant credentials such as Smartsheet certification, Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals, Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), or Lean Six Sigma

BENEFITS

Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

STC does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to STC in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where STC has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of STC and STC will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.
