We are especially interested in applicants with the following experience: cardiovascular or general non-active experience, including a background in animal tissue

A Day in the Life and the Impact You’ll Make:

This role requires backgrounds in the medical device industry, specifically prior roles in R&D, Manufacturing, Clinical, or QA/RA. Individuals in this role generally hold advanced degrees, e.g., Ph.D. or MSc. The successful candidate possesses knowledge and understanding of the challenges of a medical device manufacturer and is dedicated to sharing their experience and perspective in a professional and constructive manner. Our goal is to seek consensus on solutions while maintaining a focus on compliance.

Leading complex regulatory and technical projects, DEKRA is your global partner in the testing and certification of medical devices. We are one of the five largest Notified Bodies in the world for companies involved in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of medical devices, including high-risk and innovative medical devices and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices. DEKRA is a recognized auditing organization for the Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP). This program is designed to allow a single audit for medical device manufacturers that is accepted in multiple regulatory jurisdictions. As an established, well-recognized certification body, we maintain a global network of offices and state-of-the-art laboratories, taking pride in supporting the worldwide access of medical products to markets including Europe, Taiwan, USA, UK, Canada, Brazil, Australia, and Japan.

What You’ll Do:

  • Contribute to a safe and healthy work environment by actively participating, taking responsibility, and following established procedures and policies.
  • Review client medical device documentation to assess compliance with applicable European regulatory requirements.
  • Apply working knowledge of global regulatory frameworks to evaluate manufacturers’ processes and products.
  • Plan and conduct audits to assess continued compliance with ISO 13485, MDSAP, MDD, AIMD, IVD, MDR, IVDR, UKCA, and TCP requirements. Audit assignments include defined target allocations for preparation, execution, and reporting activities, and adherence to established timelines and productivity expectations is required.
  • Review product design documentation using STED formats, including engineering and manufacturing records, and clearly document deficiencies or compliance gaps. Completion targets will align with the experience level and scope of assigned reviews.
  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 7–12 client accounts, ensuring timely delivery of services and responsiveness to client needs.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and technically sound client reports within defined timelines.
  • Present DEKRA’s findings to clients using professional communication and presentation skills.
  • Serve as a Level 2 or higher owner of 4–10 DEKRA knowledge modules, maintaining familiarity with assigned content.
  • Work with minimal supervision while demonstrating the ability to assess regulatory compliance and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Analyze regulatory requirements and make sound, supportable determinations regarding compliance pathways.
  • Collaborate effectively with external consultants and cross-functional stakeholders to support project objectives.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Medicine, Pharmacy, (Micro)biology, Biotechnology, Clinical Physics, or a related medical device discipline. (MS or PhD preferred but not required.)
  • 5–10 years of experience in a similar role within a Notified Body/Accreditation Body environment, or a combination of education and relevant medical device industry experience.
  • Strong background in design engineering or manufacturing.
  • Experience in global regulatory affairs, including CE Medical Device Directives and related European frameworks.
  • Experience working within or managing one or more of the following schemes: ISO 13485, MDSAP, MDD, AIMD, IVD, MDR, IVDR, UKCA, TCP.
  • Broad knowledge of engineering principles and technical applications used in the development of medical devices.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to work effectively within project teams.
  • Comfort presenting findings to client leadership and mid-sized audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deliver results on time.
  • Proactive mindset, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently within established processes.

Physical Considerations:

  • Must be able to work in a variety of client locations, environments, and conditions.
  • Must be able to accommodate working various shifts as client activities are scheduled.
  • Must be able to withstand the rigors of travel.
  • May require difficult travel and long periods of driving.
  • Ability to move and conduct work with full range of motion.
  • Ability to lift 25-50lbs.
  • Extended periods of computer-based work
  • Extended periods of standing

Travel Considerations:

  • Domestic and/or international travel required, estimated up to 35%

What You’ll Receive for the Value You Bring:

Compensation:

The base pay for this position ranges from $120,000 annually to $190,000 annually. Actual pay is based on several factors including market location and position-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits:

DEKRA North America strives to provide a competitive benefits package to colleagues and promotes physical, emotional, and financial well-being. Colleagues can self-select from our benefits to create a package unique to their needs. These benefits include access to competitive health care and retirement benefits, paid time off, mental health well-being resources, and opportunities to learn and develop. Below is a list of benefits we offer our colleagues:

Health & Well-being Benefits:

  • Health care benefits: medical & prescription, dental, vision (including Domestic Partners)
  • Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity supplemental insurance
  • Company Health Savings Account contribution
  • Flexible Spending Account for eligible health care and dependent care expenses
  • Paid time off such as vacation, sick leave, and floating holidays
  • Mental and emotional support resources through our Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness Program to increase activity and health habits, with ability to earn participation rewards
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Travel Assist (Domestic/International)

Financial Benefits:

  • Participation in a 401(k) plan, with an employer match
  • Company paid Short- & Long-Term Disability benefits
  • Group term life insurance with options to buy-up for self and others
  • Tax-free Service Awards

Growth and Development Benefits:

  • Regional Advancement Program
  • Education Assistance Program
  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance
  • Internal training and development resources to grow your career
  • Annual Career Goal Setting and Performance Review cycle participation

This list provides an overview of benefits provided for US-based colleagues; the DEKRA North America Employee Benefits Guide outlines plan details and further related eligibility requirements.

Additional Position Details:

  • Reports to: Technical Director
  • Work Model:Remote
  • Work Location:US-based Remote
  • Supervises Others:No
  • Status: Full-time; Regular
  • FLSA Classification:Exempt
  • Visa Sponsorship Eligibility:This position is eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Growth in DEKRA:

DEKRA colleagues are welcome to apply for any position that is a potential match with their qualifications if performance in their current role is in good standing. The career path following this specific role is as follows:

  • Project Manager II
  • Senior Project Manager
  • Principal Project Manager

About Us:

As a global provider of comprehensive services and solutions, we help our customers improve their safety, security, and sustainability outcomes. DEKRA is the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification (TIC) companies offering innovative professional services in the fields of vehicle inspection, expert appraisals, industrial product testing & certification, management system certifications, leadership consulting, and much more. DEKRA is a purpose-driven organization with a deep passion to make the world a safer place on the road, at work, and at home. In DEKRA, you will be part of a continuously growing organization with a 100-year history involved in more than 50 countries on five continents.

We hope you’ll consider a career with DEKRA North America as we strive to become the Global Partner for a Safe World!

DEKRA North America is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

DEKRA North America is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or accommodation while seeking employment, call +1 (770) 971-3788. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

DEKRA North America will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.

DEKRA North America participates in the E-Verify program to confirm eligibility to work in the United States.

This is a paid remote position. Must be located within the United States.

Why PPM Works

raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.

Market Context

Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.

This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Field Sales Representative

Location: Leicester, covering Leicester or surrounding areas (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

Position Title: Business Process & Systems Analyst

Position Location: Remote

JOB SUMMARY

The Business Process & Systems Analyst improves how work gets done across Smart Tech by simplifying processes, automating workflows, and optimizing business systems. This role partners across departments to develop practical, standardized solutions and enable employees to use them effectively.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Process & Workflow Design (35%)

  • Partner with departments to understand business needs, pain points, and opportunities for improvement
  • Document current-state processes and design efficient, standardized future-state workflows
  • Identify bottlenecks, manual work, duplicate efforts, and unclear ownership
  • Translate business needs into clear process, workflow, and system requirements
  • Develop process documentation and continuously evaluate workflows for improvement

Business Systems Ownership (25%)

  • Own and serve as the internal expert for Smartsheet, PowerBI and assigned business systems
  • Establish standards for system structure, permissions, templates, automation, and ownership
  • Partner with departments to select and implement the right system solutions for their needs
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and improve business systems to ensure they are scalable, reliable, and well documented

Automation (20%)

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate manual or repetitive processes
  • Design, build, test, and maintain automations using Smartsheet, Power Automate and other approved tools
  • Automate workflows, approvals, notifications, data movement, and reporting to improve efficiency and consistency
  • Partner with IT on complex integrations and troubleshoot automations to ensure reliable, sustainable solutions

Enablement (20%)

  • Create and deliver training, coaching, and resources to help employees effectively use business systems and workflows
  • Create templates, standards, and user-friendly guidance that support consistent, independent use
  • Support process and system rollouts through training, testing, communication, and adoption
  • Gather feedback and continuously improve training, workflows, and system usability

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, commercial, and jobsite environments
  • On occasion may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 10%, which may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Must be located near a major US airport
  • A valid form of identification acceptable for domestic air travel is required for travel associated with this position
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities, including client sites, meetings, business development activities, errands on behalf of the business, and industry conferences

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience with business process analysis, process mapping, requirements gathering, workflow design, or continuous improvement
  • Ability to analyze a business problem before selecting or building a technology solution
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear process designs, system configurations, automation requirements, and documentation
  • Strong facilitation, problem-solving, organizational, and analytical skills
  • Ability to create clear process maps, SOPs, job aids, training materials, and user documentation
  • Ability to train and coach users with different levels of technical proficiency
  • Experience supporting system rollouts, testing, adoption, and change management across multiple departments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a service-oriented, collaborative approach
  • Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with department leaders, process owners, Organizational Excellence, and IT

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Required

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, Organizational Development, Process Improvement, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in business analysis, business systems, process improvement, operations enablement, workflow design, or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience designing and improving cross-functional business processes
  • Hands-on experience with Smartsheet or a similar work management platform, including sheets, forms, reports, dashboards, and workflow automation
  • Experience with Microsoft PowerBI and SQL based servers
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate or a similar workflow automation platform
  • Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and M365 environment
  • Demonstrated experience documenting requirements, workflows, processes, and end-user guidance

Preferred

  • Experience in construction, engineering, technology integration, or another project-driven industry
  • Experience facilitating process-improvement workshops and supporting organizational change
  • Exposure to PMO/BMO environments, operational governance, Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous-improvement methods
  • Relevant credentials such as Smartsheet certification, Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals, Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), or Lean Six Sigma

BENEFITS

Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

STC does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to STC in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where STC has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of STC and STC will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

A Day in the Life and the Impact You’ll Make:

Individuals in this role generally hold advanced degrees, e.g., Ph.D. or MSc. The successful candidate possesses knowledge and understanding of the challenges of a medical device manufacturer and is dedicated to sharing their experience and perspective in a professional and constructive manner. Our goal is to seek consensus on solutions while maintaining a focus on compliance.

Leading complex regulatory and technical projects, DEKRA is your global partner in the testing and certification of medical devices. We are one of the five largest Notified Bodies in the world for companies involved in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of medical devices, including high-risk and innovative medical devices and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices. DEKRA is a recognized auditing organization for the Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP). This program is designed to allow a single audit for medical device manufacturers that is accepted in multiple regulatory jurisdictions. As an established, well-recognized certification body, we maintain a global network of offices and state-of-the-art laboratories, taking pride in supporting the worldwide access of medical products to markets including Europe, Taiwan, USA, UK, Canada, Brazil, Australia, and Japan.

What You’ll Do:

  • Contribute to a safe and healthy work environment by actively participating, taking responsibility, and following established procedures and policies.
  • Review client medical device documentation to assess compliance with applicable European regulatory requirements.
  • Apply working knowledge of global regulatory frameworks to evaluate manufacturers’ processes and products.
  • Plan and conduct audits to assess continued compliance with ISO 13485, MDSAP, MDD, AIMD, IVD, MDR, IVDR, UKCA, and TCP requirements. Audit assignments include defined target allocations for preparation, execution, and reporting activities, and adherence to established timelines and productivity expectations is required.
  • Review product design documentation using STED formats, including engineering and manufacturing records, and clearly document deficiencies or compliance gaps. Completion targets will align with the experience level and scope of assigned reviews.
  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 7–12 client accounts, ensuring timely delivery of services and responsiveness to client needs.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and technically sound client reports within defined timelines.
  • Present DEKRA’s findings to clients using professional communication and presentation skills.
  • Serve as a Level 2 or higher owner of 4–10 DEKRA knowledge modules, maintaining familiarity with assigned content.
  • Work with minimal supervision while demonstrating the ability to assess regulatory compliance and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Analyze regulatory requirements and make sound, supportable determinations regarding compliance pathways.
  • Collaborate effectively with external consultants and cross-functional stakeholders to support project objectives.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Medicine, Pharmacy, (Micro)biology, Biotechnology, Clinical Physics, or a related medical device discipline. (MS or PhD preferred but not required.)
  • 5–10 years of experience in a similar role within a Notified Body/Accreditation Body environment, or a combination of education and relevant medical device industry experience.
  • Strong background in design engineering or manufacturing.
  • Experience in global regulatory affairs, including CE Medical Device Directives and related European frameworks.
  • Experience working within or managing one or more of the following schemes: ISO 13485, MDSAP, MDD, AIMD, IVD, MDR, IVDR, UKCA, TCP.
  • Broad knowledge of engineering principles and technical applications used in the development of medical devices.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to work effectively within project teams.
  • Comfort presenting findings to client leadership and mid-sized audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deliver results on time.
  • Proactive mindset, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently within established processes.

Physical Considerations:

  • Must be able to work in a variety of client locations, environments, and conditions.
  • Must be able to accommodate working various shifts as client activities are scheduled.
  • Must be able to withstand the rigors of travel.
  • May require difficult travel and long periods of driving.
  • Ability to move and conduct work with full range of motion.
  • Ability to lift 25-50lbs.
  • Extended periods of computer-based work
  • Extended periods of standing

Travel Considerations:

  • Domestic and/or international travel required, estimated up to 35%

What You’ll Receive for the Value You Bring:

Compensation:

The base pay for this position ranges from $120,000 annually to $190,000 annually. Actual pay is based on several factors including market location and position-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits:

DEKRA North America strives to provide a competitive benefits package to colleagues and promotes physical, emotional, and financial well-being. Colleagues can self-select from our benefits to create a package unique to their needs. These benefits include access to competitive health care and retirement benefits, paid time off, mental health well-being resources, and opportunities to learn and develop. Below is a list of benefits we offer our colleagues:

Health & Well-being Benefits:

  • Health care benefits: medical & prescription, dental, vision (including Domestic Partners)
  • Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity supplemental insurance
  • Company Health Savings Account contribution
  • Flexible Spending Account for eligible health care and dependent care expenses
  • Paid time off such as vacation, sick leave, and floating holidays
  • Mental and emotional support resources through our Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness Program to increase activity and health habits, with ability to earn participation rewards
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Travel Assist (Domestic/International)

Financial Benefits:

  • Participation in a 401(k) plan, with an employer match
  • Company paid Short- & Long-Term Disability benefits
  • Group term life insurance with options to buy-up for self and others
  • Tax-free Service Awards

Growth and Development Benefits:

  • Regional Advancement Program
  • Education Assistance Program
  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance
  • Internal training and development resources to grow your career
  • Annual Career Goal Setting and Performance Review cycle participation

This list provides an overview of benefits provided for US-based colleagues; the DEKRA North America Employee Benefits Guide outlines plan details and further related eligibility requirements.

Additional Position Details:

  • Reports to: Technical Director
  • Work Model:Remote
  • Work Location:US-based Remote
  • Supervises Others:No
  • Status: Full-time; Regular
  • FLSA Classification:Exempt
  • Visa Sponsorship Eligibility:This position is eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Growth in DEKRA:

DEKRA colleagues are welcome to apply for any position that is a potential match with their qualifications if performance in their current role is in good standing. The career path following this specific role is as follows:

  • Project Manager II
  • Senior Project Manager
  • Principal Project Manager

About Us:

As a global provider of comprehensive services and solutions, we help our customers improve their safety, security, and sustainability outcomes. DEKRA is the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification (TIC) companies offering innovative professional services in the fields of vehicle inspection, expert appraisals, industrial product testing & certification, management system certifications, leadership consulting, and much more. DEKRA is a purpose-driven organization with a deep passion to make the world a safer place on the road, at work, and at home. In DEKRA, you will be part of a continuously growing organization with a 100-year history involved in more than 50 countries on five continents.

We hope you’ll consider a career with DEKRA North America as we strive to become the Global Partner for a Safe World!

DEKRA North America is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

DEKRA North America is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or accommodation while seeking employment, call +1 (770) 971-3788. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

DEKRA North America will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.

raw.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Role Title: Senior NDT Inspector (Level II/III)
Role Type: Contractor

Job Summary

We are looking for experienced Senior NDT Inspectors to support an engineering AI training project. You'll apply your expertise in non-destructive testing to interpret inspection data, evaluate weld indications, and provide accurate technical assessments. AI experience is not required.

Scope of Work

  • Analyze and interpret radiographic images (RT), ultrasonic scans (UT/PAUT), and MT/PT indications.
  • Review inspection data for compliance with applicable codes and standards.
  • Evaluate weld defects and provide acceptance or disposition recommendations.
  • Review thermographic images and remote visual inspection (RVI) footage when required.
  • Prepare clear and technically accurate inspection reports.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to resolve complex or ambiguous indications.
  • Contribute to improving inspection protocols and project guidelines.

  • Active ASNT or ISO 9712 Level II/III certification in relevant NDT methods.
  • 8+ years of experience interpreting RT, UT/PAUT, MT/PT, and related NDT data.
  • Strong knowledge of ASME Section V, VIII, XI; API 510/570/653; API 1104; and AWS D1.1.
  • Experience applying code-based weld acceptance criteria.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Thermography or RVI experience is a plus.

Required Skills

  • Radiographic Testing (RT) Interpretation
  • Ultrasonic Testing (UT/PAUT)
  • MT/PT Indication Evaluation
  • ASME Section V & API 510/653
  • Weld Defect Acceptance Criteria

raw.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

**THIS MUST BE FILLED OUT PRIOR TO SUBMITTING. Please do not change the headers for each section below.**

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

​

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.


About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.


As a StaffSoftware Engineer working on dbt Fusion, you’ll help build a next-generation analytics engine written in Rust that significantly improves performance, correctness, and developer experience across dbt workflows. You’ll work on a modern, state-aware execution engine with deep SQL understanding across multiple warehouses, enabling faster debugging, smarter orchestration, and more efficient large-scale deployments.


This role offers the opportunity to contribute to both open source and commercial code while shaping the future of dbt’s core platform.


This position is a unique opportunity to work on mission-critical projects that will significantly improve the experience of our customers and developers. You’ll help build truly differentiated systems and engines that sets us apart from other database technologies.


What You’ll Do


  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Operations, and Security to deliver well-architected, scalable compute solutions.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions with a focus on query engines, storage systems, and distributed database design.
  • Build services, APIs, and experiences that support user delight, quality, high availability, and performance.
  • Tackle ambiguous, open-ended technical challenges with strategic thinking, balancing technical constraints with user needs and product goals.
  • Drive best practices in testing, observability, and system reliability.
  • Champion a culture of technical excellence and innovation, influencing engineering direction across multiple teams or domains.

Skills We’re Looking For


  • Strong coding skills (10+ years) in at least one of the following technologies: Rust, Python, Go or Java.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform).
  • Proven ability to participate in complex projects and collaborate across functions.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, clear communication, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Interest in systems, data infrastructure, compilers, or analytical tooling, even if experience is primarily academic.
  • Experience working on non-trivial projects (coursework, internships, research, open-source, personal projects) that required persistence and iteration.
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to work across the stack and learn new technologies as the problem demands.
  • Evidence of being self-directed and curious—you proactively learn new tools, languages, or concepts when needed

Bonus Skills​


  • Contributions to open source database technologies projects such as Apache Arrow, DuckDB, MongoDB Runtime, or other analytical data systems.
  • Expertise in database systems, query engines, or storage systems.
  • Experience with performance optimization, observability, or large-scale query engines.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

Savista partners with healthcare providers to improve their financial strength by implementing integrated spend management and revenue cycle solutions that help control cost, improve margins and cash flow, increase regulatory compliance, and optimize operational efficiency.

The Accounts Receivable Specialist I is responsible for ensuring the timely collection of outstanding government or commercial healthcare insurance receivables.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Update patient demographics/insurance information in appropriate systems -

  • Research/ Status unpaid or denied claims

  • Research EOBs for payments or adjustments to resolve claim

  • Contacts payers via phone or written correspondence to secure payment of claims

  • Access client systems for payment, patient, claim and data info

  • Follows guidelines for prioritization, timely filing deadlines, and notation protocols within appropriate systems

  • Secure needed medical documentation required or requested by third party insurance carriers

  • Maintain and respect the confidentiality of patient information in accordance with insurance collection guidelines and corporate policy and procedure

  • Perform other related duties as required

Minimum Requirements & Competencies:

  • 1-2 years of medical collections/billing experience

  • Basic knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS and NCCI

  • Basic knowledge of third party billing guidelines

  • Basic knowledge of billing claim forms(UB04/1500)

  • Basic knowledge of payor contracts

  • Working Knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel

  • Basic working knowledge of health information systems (i.e. EMR, Claim Scrubbers, Patient Accounting Systems, etc.)

Preferred Requirements & Competencies:

  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following Patient accounting systems - EPIC, Cerner, STAR, Meditech, CPSI, Invision, PBAR, All Scripts or Paragon

  • Working knowledge of DDE Medicare claim system

  • Knowledge of government rules and regulations

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media ecosystems, helping brands connect with shoppers at the moment of intent on Instacart Marketplace and 310+ partners. Sponsored Products is our anchor format, and its growth depends on how we merchandise and display products to consumers as well as the relevance, ranking, and personalization that drive customer and advertiser value.

As a Principal Product Manager on the Ad Product team, you will own the strategy for Ads Quality across the Sponsored Products franchise. You will partner with engineering, design, data science, and user research to build a virtuous flywheel between advertisers, customers and retailers; and to help define the future of how online grocery works.

About the Job

  • Create surface-level controls that balance customer value and advertiser value across Sponsored Products
  • Drive a high-velocity experimentation program in merchandising, ranking, and relevance - with a goal of shipping experiments that deliver multi-million dollar ARR impact.
  • Develop a comprehensive strategy for evolving our ranking and monetization systems to better represent customer intent per ad request
  • Lead system design for complex ranking and relevance systems in partnership with Machine Learning engineers, and advance improvements to core retrieval and ranking that power Sponsored Products
  • Establish yourself as a thought leader on search and how to monetize it as a surface, sharing your point of view internally and externally with partners and industry leaders
  • Define how Sponsored Products evolve in new experiences such as agentic commerce and conversational UI’s
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and UX research to turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into clear hypotheses, requirements, and measurable outcomes

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience with paid search or Sponsored Products advertising
  • Experience building machine learning products, including ranking, relevance, or recommendation systems
  • Experience with consumer-facing digital product work at a large, complex technology company
  • Strong analytical skills and data science savvy, with a record of using data to guide product decisions and design experiments.
  • Critical thinking and executive presence, with the ability to present complex subject matter to senior leaders and build cross-organizational buy-in.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS or MS in computer science, economics, or a related field.
  • 7-10 years of product management experience, including ownership of product lines generating $100M+ in revenue.
  • Fluency in data science and machine learning concepts.

We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.

About The Role

We are looking for a Content Writer dedicated to the Mexican market.

As a Content Writer, you will be responsible for producing high-quality, accurate, and SEO-driven content tailored to the Mexican audience. Your work will play a key role in attracting, engaging, and converting users across our iGaming and sports platforms.

Reporting to a Content Manager or Senior Content Manager, you will collaborate closely with Editors, SEO specialists, and other Writers to ensure our content meets the highest editorial standards while supporting traffic growth and monetization goals.

This role is ideal for writers who combine strong editorial skills, in-depth knowledge of the Mexican market, and a performance-driven mindset in fast-paced digital environments

Content Creation

  • Write original, high-quality articles following provided briefs, tone, and structure.

  • Adapt writing style to match different markets, audiences, and brands.

  • Conduct research on relevant topics, trends, and operators to ensure up-to-date and reliable information.

SEO Integration

  • Follow content briefs and editorial guidelines to optimize for visibility and conversion.

  • Collaborate with SEO specialists and Content Managers to adjust existing content when needed.

Collaboration & Feedback

Compliance & Quality

If you’re passionate about sports, content, and iGaming and you want to make an impact in one of Latin America’s key markets we’d love to hear from you.

👉 Apply now and help shape North Star Network’s content strategy across Latin America.

raw.description:
SUMMARY

Join Quorso at a pivotal moment in our growth. We're helping some of the world's most respected retailers transform the way they run their stores, making operations more data-led, agile and impactful. Using Quorso's intelligent management platform, you'll help turn vast amounts of retail data into clear, actionable insights that influence decisions from store level to the C-suite.

We're already powering performance for some of the biggest names in retail, including Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply Company and Circle K, and we're now expanding our data capability in the US to support new global growth.

ABOUT QUORSO

Quorso is one of retail’s most exciting SaaS scale-ups. Our intelligent management platform translates terabytes of data into smart, personalised daily actions across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. Backed by Summit Partners, we’re scaling fast and building the data foundations that will shape the future of retail performance.

ABOUT THE ROLEThis role sits at the heart of Quorso’s customer relationships. Your portfolio will be across large enterprise retail customers. This isn’t a support role. You’ll be the person clients rely on: the one who keeps things moving and spots risks before they escalate. If you want to grow fast and own something meaningful, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own your accounts end to end: run weekly working sessions, manage the client relationship, and make day-to-day decisions with real autonomy

  • Build trusted relationships across each client organization, from day-to-day users to senior decision-makers, so daily work ladders up to their strategic goals

  • Prepare and lead client meetings: own the agenda, drive the conversation, and leave every session with clear next steps and owners

  • Lead strategic planning sessions and QBRs

  • Run projects across your accounts: plan the work, coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders, and keep delivery on time and in scope

  • Partner with the Implementation Manager to keep builds on track, acting as the link between what the client needs and what gets delivered

  • Track account health across your portfolio, spot risks early, and bring a point of view on how to solve them

  • Own the operational side of account management (support tickets, bug triage and routine requests) so nothing falls through the cracks

  • Look for better ways of working, with clients and inside Quorso, and test new ideas

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Enterprise account experience:4+ years managing relationships with large enterprise customers

  • Strong project management:ability to run several projects at once, coordinate with multiple internal and external stakeholders, and keep delivery on track

  • Stakeholder management:you’re comfortable working across complex client organizations, aligning people with different priorities and keeping senior stakeholders informed

  • Ownership:a track record of driving initiatives to measurable outcomes without waiting to be asked

  • Clear, confident communication:you run a good meeting and earn clients’ trust on your own

NICE TO HAVE

  • Renewals experience:you’ve owned or supported renewal conversations with enterprise customers

  • Reporting and business cases:you’re comfortable with data, can build clear reports, and can turn account metrics into a business case a client’s leadership will act on

  • Retail operations background:hands-on experience in store operations or distribution centers, so you understand how retail teams work, the pressures they face, and how to speak their language

Don’t check every box? If you’re excited about the role and bring most of this, we’d still like to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

  • We’re drivers: everyone here owns outcomes and moves the dial for our customers and the business

  • We stay curious: we ask questions, test ideas and keep innovating; what worked last year is the starting point, not the ceiling

  • We set high expectations, and back people to meet them: high standards come with honest feedback, real support and room to grow

PAY AND BENEFITSThe base salary range for this role is 120–160K per year. This role is also eligible for (bonus / variable pay) and equity. The final offer will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience and location.
Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; other benefits.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITYQuorso is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on the skills, experience and potential people bring to the role. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process please let us know.

Start: ab sofort| Level: Intermediate | Location: Schweiz, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

In der Rolle als Marketing Manager (gn), übernimmst du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Markenstrategie für More Nutrition in der Schweiz.

More Nutrition macht bereits 8-stellige Umsätze in der Schweiz, die wir gemeinsam mit dir auf 9-stellige Umsätze ausweiten wollen.

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du wirkungsvolle Kampagnen, treibst lokale Marketinginitiativen voran und stellst ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis über alle Touchpoints hinweg sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams, Agenturen und lokalen Akteurenzusammen, um unsere Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt massiv auszubauen.

Deine Mission beiuns

  • Als Brand Guardian entwickelst und setzt du die Markenstrategie für die Schweiz um, indem du globale Leitlinien mit lokalen Consumer Insights verknüpfst
  • Du definierst den Marketing-Aktivierungskalender und leitest die Planung sowie Umsetzung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Massenmedien, Influencer Marketing, TikTok und Point of Sale)
  • Du gestaltest das lokale Produktportfolio basierend auf den Bedürfnissen und Potenzialen des Schweizer Marktes mit
  • Du briefst und steuerst Agenturen zur Erstellung markenkonformer, lokal relevanter Assets (in Deutsch und Französisch) und stellst eine termingerechte Kampagnenumsetzung sicher
  • Du trackst Markenmetriken (Awareness, Equity, Engagement) sowie Kampagnen-KPIs und nutzt diese Daten für eine kontinuierliche Optimierung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams zusammen, um ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis im D2C-Bereich, Pureplay und am Point of Sale zu garantieren
  • Du stimmst dich engmit den lokalen Commercial-Teams ab, um die Marketingaktivitätenperfekt auf die Markt- und Vertriebszieleauszurichten

DeineErfahrung & Skills

  • Du bringst 4–6 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung als Brand- oder Marketing Manager im FMCG- / Konsumgüterbereich mit. Gerne aus dem Bereich Food & Beverage
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung oder Betreuung einer oder mehrerer Marken in der Schweiz mit Umsätzen von mindestens 50 Mio. CHF
  • Du besitzt fundierte Erfahrungin der Steuerung einesD2C-Business sowie in der Steuerung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Mass Media, Influencer Marketing,Social Media wie TikTok und Meta, sowie Point of Sale + Pureplay)
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine starke Hands-on-Mentalität, ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement und echte Lust auf crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit aus
  • Du hast ein strategisches, kreatives und datengetriebenes Mindset und gehst sicher mit digitalen Marketing-Tools um
  • Du hast verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Schweizerdeutsch) sowie fließende Französischkenntnisse und nutzt Englisch sicher für unsere interne Kommunikation

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

What You’ll Work On

As an Abbott ICE Specialist, you will focus on providing exceptional technical and clinical support for Abbott's intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) technology. You’ll support physicians and healthcare professionals during procedures using Abbott ICE, educating them on proper product usage, and providing troubleshooting assistance. The ICE specialist will also gather customer feedback, ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines, and contributing to the improvement of Abbott's ICE product portfolio

  • Provide expert support during Cardiac ablation and Structural Heart procedures, including case planning, preparation, and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain deep clinical knowledge of cardiac anatomy, electrophysiology, and Intracardiac Echo technology, as well as other imaging modalities like TEE and TTE.
  • Educate physicians, healthcare professionals, and Abbott team members on the efficacy and use of Abbott ICE products.
  • Resolve technical issues and providing guidance on product usage through various communication channels.
  • Gather and relaying customer feedback to internal teams for product improvement and development.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant regulatory, quality, and safety guidelines.
  • Collaborate with sales, upstream/downstream marketing, and R&D teams to support business objectives and product advancements and collaborate closely with Electrophysiologists, interventional cardiologists, and lab staff to ensure optimal image acquisition and interpretation

Required Qualifications

  • An associate's degree or higher in nursing, sonography, cardiovascular technology, or a related clinical field, or equivalent clinical experience.
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in cardiovascular, electrophysiology, or structural heart procedures, including experience with ICE, TEE, TTE, and vascular ultrasound.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • A Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS) or Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS) certification

ABOUT THE ROLEThis role sits at the heart of Quorso’s customer relationships. Your portfolio will be across large enterprise retail customers. This isn’t a support role. You’ll be the person clients rely on: the one who keeps things moving and spots risks before they escalate. If you want to grow fast and own something meaningful, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own your accounts end to end: run weekly working sessions, manage the client relationship, and make day-to-day decisions with real autonomy

  • Build trusted relationships across each client organization, from day-to-day users to senior decision-makers, so daily work ladders up to their strategic goals

  • Prepare and lead client meetings: own the agenda, drive the conversation, and leave every session with clear next steps and owners

  • Lead strategic planning sessions and QBRs

  • Run projects across your accounts: plan the work, coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders, and keep delivery on time and in scope

  • Partner with the Implementation Manager to keep builds on track, acting as the link between what the client needs and what gets delivered

  • Track account health across your portfolio, spot risks early, and bring a point of view on how to solve them

  • Own the operational side of account management (support tickets, bug triage and routine requests) so nothing falls through the cracks

  • Look for better ways of working, with clients and inside Quorso, and test new ideas

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Enterprise account experience:4+ years managing relationships with large enterprise customers

  • Strong project management:ability to run several projects at once, coordinate with multiple internal and external stakeholders, and keep delivery on track

  • Stakeholder management:you’re comfortable working across complex client organizations, aligning people with different priorities and keeping senior stakeholders informed

  • Ownership:a track record of driving initiatives to measurable outcomes without waiting to be asked

  • Clear, confident communication:you run a good meeting and earn clients’ trust on your own

NICE TO HAVE

  • Renewals experience:you’ve owned or supported renewal conversations with enterprise customers

  • Reporting and business cases:you’re comfortable with data, can build clear reports, and can turn account metrics into a business case a client’s leadership will act on

  • Retail operations background:hands-on experience in store operations or distribution centers, so you understand how retail teams work, the pressures they face, and how to speak their language

Don’t check every box? If you’re excited about the role and bring most of this, we’d still like to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

  • We’re drivers: everyone here owns outcomes and moves the dial for our customers and the business

  • We stay curious: we ask questions, test ideas and keep innovating; what worked last year is the starting point, not the ceiling

  • We set high expectations, and back people to meet them: high standards come with honest feedback, real support and room to grow

PAY AND BENEFITSThe base salary range for this role is 120–160K per year. This role is also eligible for (bonus / variable pay) and equity. The final offer will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience and location.
Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; other benefits.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITYQuorso is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on the skills, experience and potential people bring to the role. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process please let us know.
