Start: ab sofort| Level: Intermediate | Location: Schweiz, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

In der Rolle als Marketing Manager (gn), übernimmst du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Markenstrategie für More Nutrition in der Schweiz.

More Nutrition macht bereits 8-stellige Umsätze in der Schweiz, die wir gemeinsam mit dir auf 9-stellige Umsätze ausweiten wollen.

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du wirkungsvolle Kampagnen, treibst lokale Marketinginitiativen voran und stellst ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis über alle Touchpoints hinweg sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams, Agenturen und lokalen Akteurenzusammen, um unsere Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt massiv auszubauen.

Deine Mission beiuns

  • Als Brand Guardian entwickelst und setzt du die Markenstrategie für die Schweiz um, indem du globale Leitlinien mit lokalen Consumer Insights verknüpfst
  • Du definierst den Marketing-Aktivierungskalender und leitest die Planung sowie Umsetzung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Massenmedien, Influencer Marketing, TikTok und Point of Sale)
  • Du gestaltest das lokale Produktportfolio basierend auf den Bedürfnissen und Potenzialen des Schweizer Marktes mit
  • Du briefst und steuerst Agenturen zur Erstellung markenkonformer, lokal relevanter Assets (in Deutsch und Französisch) und stellst eine termingerechte Kampagnenumsetzung sicher
  • Du trackst Markenmetriken (Awareness, Equity, Engagement) sowie Kampagnen-KPIs und nutzt diese Daten für eine kontinuierliche Optimierung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams zusammen, um ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis im D2C-Bereich, Pureplay und am Point of Sale zu garantieren
  • Du stimmst dich engmit den lokalen Commercial-Teams ab, um die Marketingaktivitätenperfekt auf die Markt- und Vertriebszieleauszurichten

DeineErfahrung & Skills

  • Du bringst 4–6 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung als Brand- oder Marketing Manager im FMCG- / Konsumgüterbereich mit. Gerne aus dem Bereich Food & Beverage
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung oder Betreuung einer oder mehrerer Marken in der Schweiz mit Umsätzen von mindestens 50 Mio. CHF
  • Du besitzt fundierte Erfahrungin der Steuerung einesD2C-Business sowie in der Steuerung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Mass Media, Influencer Marketing,Social Media wie TikTok und Meta, sowie Point of Sale + Pureplay)
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine starke Hands-on-Mentalität, ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement und echte Lust auf crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit aus
  • Du hast ein strategisches, kreatives und datengetriebenes Mindset und gehst sicher mit digitalen Marketing-Tools um
  • Du hast verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Schweizerdeutsch) sowie fließende Französischkenntnisse und nutzt Englisch sicher für unsere interne Kommunikation

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

What You’ll Work On

As an Abbott ICE Specialist, you will focus on providing exceptional technical and clinical support for Abbott's intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) technology. You’ll support physicians and healthcare professionals during procedures using Abbott ICE, educating them on proper product usage, and providing troubleshooting assistance. The ICE specialist will also gather customer feedback, ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines, and contributing to the improvement of Abbott's ICE product portfolio

  • Provide expert support during Cardiac ablation and Structural Heart procedures, including case planning, preparation, and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain deep clinical knowledge of cardiac anatomy, electrophysiology, and Intracardiac Echo technology, as well as other imaging modalities like TEE and TTE.

  • Gather and relaying customer feedback to internal teams for product improvement and development.

Required Qualifications

  • An associate's degree or higher in nursing, sonography, cardiovascular technology, or a related clinical field, or equivalent clinical experience.
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in cardiovascular, electrophysiology, or structural heart procedures, including experience with ICE, TEE, TTE, and vascular ultrasound.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • A Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS) or Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS) certification

raw.description:
Job Description: Evaluation Specialist / Recent Graduate

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking motivated Evaluation Specialists and recent graduates to contribute to a high-impact project focused on advancing artificial intelligence. In this role, you will use your research, analytical reasoning, and writing skills to develop challenging questions and evaluate AI model performance.

You will create original question-and-answer pairs, conduct in-depth research, verify information across multiple sources, and provide clear explanations supported by reliable citations. No prior AI experience is required. Strong research abilities, critical thinking, and subject-matter knowledge are the key requirements.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop original, challenging question-and-answer pairs designed to test the capabilities of advanced AI models across diverse subject areas.
  2. Conduct in-depth research and cross-verify information using multiple reliable sources to ensure accuracy, completeness, and strong supporting evidence.
  3. Create multi-step questions that require analytical reasoning, synthesis, and critical thinking rather than simple information retrieval.
  4. Test questions against AI models, analyze their responses, and refine the questions to adjust or increase their difficulty.
  5. Document research processes and provide clear citations, evidence, and logical explanations to support each answer.
  6. Revise and improve content based on reviewer feedback while ensuring compliance with project guidelines and quality standards.
  7. Maintain consistency, accuracy, and clarity across all submitted tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Strong ability to conduct independent research and critically evaluate information from multiple sources.
  2. Excellent English writing skills, with a high level of precision and clarity. English fluency is required but does not need to be your first language.
  3. Ability to create nuanced, well-structured questions that assess deep understanding and complex reasoning.
  4. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and information-synthesis skills.
  5. Self-motivation, reliability, and accountability when working independently in a remote environment.
  6. Interest in emerging AI technologies and evaluating the capabilities and limitations of advanced AI models.
  7. Previous experience in AI training, model evaluation, research, or content creation is an advantage but is not required.
  8. Open to recent graduates, advanced-degree holders, and candidates from diverse academic or professional backgrounds who demonstrate strong research and writing abilities.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based, with payment provided for tasks that meet the project's specifications and quality requirements. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply, and contributors are expected to complete a specified number of tasks each week.

Start Timeline and Availability

  • Hiring Timeline: Positions are typically filled within 48 hours.
  • Availability: Candidates should be ready to begin promptly.
  • Project Start: Selected candidates are expected to start their first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented researcher and critical thinker who can develop challenging questions, verify complex information, and communicate findings with clarity and precision. They should be comfortable working independently, adapting to feedback, and maintaining high-quality standards while contributing to the evaluation and improvement of advanced AI systems.

About Us:

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

Coding Specialists are an important part of the Team at CorroHealth. The Coding Team Member will provide CPT, HCPCS and ICD-10-CM coding a minimum of 1-4 specialties. Will be Coding Professional Fee, Facility, or HCC. Professional Fee Specialties could include UR, Podiatry, Plastics, Pediatrics, OB, Pain Management, Ortho, Addiction, General Surgery, Internal Medicine, Urgent Care, Pulmonary, or ED. Facility Chart types could include OT, PT, Urgent Care, ED, or a variety of other specialties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

  • Team Member must be able to work from home and be independent in their coding skills.
  • Provide various components of coding services to support our clients.
  • Calculate Facility E/M levels by using an algorithm created by our company
  • Recognize critical care cases by patient acuity.
  • Code same day surgery and observations
  • Code surgical procedures typical of an ER setting to capture additional revenue when appropriate.
  • Apply ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes to the highest level of specificity available.
  • Accurately apply diagnosis and procedure codes utilizing ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT®, and HCPCS
  • Interpret coding guidelines for accurate code assignment
  • Identify the importance of documentation on code assignment and the subsequent reimbursement impact.
  • Align conduct with AHIMA's Standards of Ethical Coding and the Company’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and support the Company’s Ethics and Compliance Program.
  • Comply with all internal policies and procedures.
  • Actively participate in Company provided training and education.
  • All Coders must maintain at least one credential through either AAPC or AHIMA.
  • Ensure individual compliance with all privacy and security rules and regulations and commit to the protection of all Company confidential information, including but not limited to, Personal Health Information

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:

  • All coders MUST be certified through either the AAPC (CPC or COC) or AHIMA (CCS or CCS-P).
  • Must have at least a minimum of 1 year of on the job experience.
  • Must have SDS, Outpatient surgery and Observations facility coding experience.
  • E&M, Injections/Infusions and ED experience is a plus.
  • Regular, predictable, and punctual attendance is required.
  • Must have working knowledge and experience with systems such as EMR, Billing, etc
  • Must have a phone, reliable internet connection and current coding materials such as CPT and ICD-10-CM coding references.
  • Will be required to maintain an ongoing productivity level and accuracy rate of 95% or higher
  • Will be required to maintain a quality score of 95% or higher

    • Strong, working knowledge of data maintenance requirements within mainstream RIM systems (e.g., Veeva Vault)

Nice to Have

At Climate Week NYC, London Climate Action Week, UN Climate COPs, the World Economic Forum, and more, we convene senior leaders from food, finance, and government with farmers and Indigenous communities in sessions built to drive measurable outcomes.

The role

This role is largely focused on supporting the execution of our Regen House events, but will also have the opportunity to work with our CEO and other leadership to support their admin. This is a chance to see up close how a fast-growing climate company builds partnerships, and to play a real part in it.

It's a great fit for someone who loves details, moves easily between priorities, and is passionate about climate and food systems.

Event Coordinator Responsibilities:

    • Event planning and admin: Support venue, vendor, run-of-show and logistics planning, and keep timelines and trackers up to date.

    • Partnership comms: Help manage outreach and ongoing communication with partners and sponsors.

raw.description:
At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.
Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.
The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.

  • Anchorage Digital is hiring a Market Risk Manager to own the market risk framework and day-to-day oversight for our Global Markets business, including our swap dealer. In this role, you will measure, limit and report the risk from derivatives, financing, spot trading with delayed settlement, and collateral rehypothecation. You will also build tools and systems that measure risk.
  • This is a second-line role, independent of trading and sales, and a hands-on one. Half the job is risk judgment: challenging a desk decision, sizing a stress scenario, explaining exposure to management. The other half is engineering: writing production code, owning risk data, and replacing spreadsheets with automated controls. You'll work with Trading, Treasury, Accounting, Operations and Engineering, and help represent the risk function to regulators and auditors.
  • People make this organization, and in this role, it is your mission to cultivate and contribute to a culture of risk management, continuous improvement, and strategic innovation. A healthy outcome is a business that is both agile and resilient, capable of navigating the complexities of the crypto market while achieving its strategic goals.

Technical Skills

  • Run daily market risk across spot, lending and derivatives books: VaR, stress tests, sensitivities (delta, gamma, vega, basis), concentration and liquidity-adjusted exposure.
  • Design, revise, and implement limits, escalating breaches and tracking remediation to closure.
  • Set and review collateral haircuts, initial and variation margin, concentration add-ons and liquidation thresholds.
  • Build historical and hypothetical stress scenarios and turn results into limits and capital/liquidity impacts.
  • Contribute to the swap dealer risk management program, including limit documentation
  • Work with platform, trading, and data teams on system design, access controls, and change management for risk-critical systems.
  • Produce risk reports for senior management, risk committees and regulators.

Complexity and Impact of Work

  • Own market risk for a 24/7 business where positions, collateral values, and client exposures can move sharply outside business hours.
  • Make risk calls on thinly traded and volatile assets where historical data is limited and standard models need judgment and adjustment.
  • Balance enabling business growth with protecting the firm’s capital, liquidity and regulatory standing.
  • Shape firm-level outcomes: limit, margin and haircut decisions that directly affect client capacity, revenue, capital usage and loss exposure.
  • Work on problems without established playbooks, including new products and new venues.
  • Identify gaps in risk coverage, data or systems, and drive fixes through to production.

Organizational Knowledge

  • Understand how the Global Markets business works end to end.
  • Understand the firm’s regulatory obligations, including CFTC and NFA requirements for the swap dealer, and how risk outputs feed capital, liquidity and regulatory reporting.
  • Understand the systems and data that produce positions, prices and collateral values, including their limitations.
  • Apply the firm’s risk appetite, policies and governance structure (risk committees, escalation paths, approvals) in day-to-day decisions.

Communication and Influence

  • Challenge the business leaders with sound rationale and hold the line on limits while keeping relationships constructive.
  • Translate complex quantitative concepts into clear, actionable insights for senior management, risk committees, and regulators.
  • Build relationships across teams to drive adoption of risk frameworks and influence how the organization thinks about risk

About Anchorage Digital: Who we are

The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.
Anchorage Digital is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.
Anchorage Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. Anchorage Digital considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with other legal requirements. “Anchorage Digital” refers to services that are offered either through Anchorage Digital Bank National Association, an OCC-chartered national trust bank, or Anchorage Lending CA, LLC a finance lender licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, License No. 60DBO-11976, or Anchorage Digital Singapore Pte Ltd, a Singapore private limited company, all wholly-owned subsidiaries of Anchor Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation.
Protecting your privacy rights is important to Anchorage Digital, and we work to maintain the trust and confidence of our clients when handling personal or financial information. Please see our privacy policy notices here.

This is a remote position.

Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Global (UK and Europe)

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote. Open to consultants based in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Czechia. Day rate: GBP 450 in the UK. EUR 450 in the other listed countries. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

raw.description:
Principal AI Engineer
BuzzBoard · Remote (WFH) · Engineering / AIThe role
BuzzBoard builds AI products for the B2SMB market — helping agencies, media companies, and sellers understand small businesses and market to them at a level of personalization that wasn't previously economical. Our platform is built on frontier models end to end. Not AI features bolted onto a legacy product — the products are agent systems.
Our products span multi-agent marketing content generation, real-time AI voice intake, and pre- and post-sales intelligence for SMBs — Zylo, IRIS, Ignite, and Ember. They share a common internal pipeline for orchestration, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and deployment.
This role owns the architecture underneath that pipeline. Not one feature — the shared layer every product depends on: how retrieval is built and measured, how agents reason and hold state and fail safely, which models run where and what happens when one degrades, how output quality is evaluated before it ships, and where the line sits between what a model decides and what deterministic code decides. You'll set that architecture, build the reusable patterns products inherit, guide the engineers implementing them, and own whether it holds up in production at volume.
It's a senior individual-contributor role. Two boundaries, stated plainly:
  • Not a research role. The deliverable is a shipped, reliable capability, not a paper or a demo.
  • Not a DevOps role. You need to be fluent in deployment and able to get a service into production, but full-time platform ownership sits elsewhere. Your center of gravity is AI system design.
If your GenAI experience is mostly notebooks and proofs of concept that never carried real traffic, this is not the role.
What you'll own
AI system architecture. Design the systems behind content generation, business intelligence, recommendations, and agentic workflows — including where the boundary sits between what a model decides and what deterministic code decides. Create reusable patterns, prompts, evaluation flows, and orchestration layers that hold up across products rather than being rebuilt per feature.
Agentic workflows. Lead the design of agents that reason, call tools and APIs, manage state, checkpoint, and hand tasks off cleanly. Build the guardrails that keep them grounded and predictable — the hard part is not making an agent act, it's making it fail safely and legibly when it's wrong.
Retrieval and model strategy. Design RAG pipelines end to end: chunking, embeddings, metadata, reranking, and retrieval evaluation that actually measures whether the right context arrived. Own model selection across ecosystems on the axes that matter — cost, latency, accuracy, reliability — and define the fallback and model-switching behavior for when a provider degrades.
Evaluation and quality. Stand up the evaluation frameworks that decide whether an AI output ships: output quality, edit ratio, hallucination rate, schema adherence, latency, failure rate, inference cost. Build regression testing so a prompt or model change can't silently break production. Turn “the output feels off” into a measured threshold.
Production readiness. Partner with engineering and platform teams so systems are deployable, observable, and maintainable. Package services (Python, FastAPI/Flask, Docker) when it's the fastest path, and diagnose the production failure modes specific to AI — rate limits, cost spikes, model failures, degraded output — rather than escalating them blind.
Technical leadership. Mentor GenAI engineers, review designs and prompts and workflows and evals, and translate product requirements into architecture with measurable acceptance criteria. Communicate the tradeoffs to engineers and to leadership in language each can act on.

What we're looking for
Required
  • 5+ years in engineering, AI, ML, or data-product work; 3+ years hands-on with GenAI / LLM systems
  • Production GenAI experience — non-negotiable. You have built or scaled systems that carried real traffic, and you can walk through one in detail: what broke, what it cost, what you changed.
  • Deep working knowledge of LLMs and SLMs: prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling
  • Hands-on with at least two major LLM ecosystems, and able to reason about the tradeoffs between them rather than defaulting to the one you know
  • RAG built for real: vector stores (Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent), embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval quality you've actually measured
  • Hands-on with at least one agentic framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) and the underlying concepts — memory, state, tool integration, failure handling — well enough to move across frameworks
  • Strong Python; comfortable with REST APIs, Docker, a cloud platform, and basic CI/CD
  • Demonstrated evaluation work: regression testing, hallucination checks, schema validation, output scoring — you can define metrics for quality, reliability, cost, and business impact
  • Track record guiding a small team or owning AI architecture end to end
  • Comfort creating structure in a fast-moving environment with shifting requirements
Preferred
  • Fine-tuning or supervised training workflows
  • SLM and open-source model deployment; model serving with vLLM, Ollama, or TensorRT-LLM
  • Multimodal work across text, image, audio, or video
  • Kubernetes or serverless deployment
  • Evaluation/observability tooling — LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent
  • Marketing technology, SMB intelligence, or content-automation domain experience
  • Responsible AI, privacy, security, and compliance practice
  • Experience scaling AI systems that generate high volumes of content, recommendations, or insights
What we care most about
  • You've built or scaled real GenAI systems, not just demos
  • You design AI workflows that are reliable, testable, and cost-aware from the start
  • You make practical model, prompt, retrieval, and architecture calls and can defend them
  • You know how to balance model intelligence against deterministic logic and engineering guardrails
  • You stay hands-on while guiding engineers — neither purely a manager nor purely an IC
  • You think past “which model” to the whole system around the model
What this role is not
  • Not a research or publications role
  • Not full-time DevOps or platform ownership
  • Not a role for someone whose GenAI track record is demos that never took production traffic
What we offer
  • Fully remote
  • A production GenAI foundation already carrying real volume — you scale it, you don't start from zero
  • Genuine architectural ownership over the agentic systems that come next
  • A small, high-context team that moves quickly and argues about the work
  • Real impact on small businesses
Apply if you've shipped GenAI systems that carried real traffic and you want to own the architecture of what comes next.

raw.description:
About the Role

The best demo isn't a tour of features. It's a clear, confident answer to the question every buyer is really asking: why does this matter to me?

As Senior Technical Enablement Manager (Pre-Sales), you'll be the technical voice that teaches Abnormal's Sales Engineers and Account Executives how to win. You'll go deep on how our behavioral AI actually works, then turn that depth into outcome-driven narratives sellers can carry into any conversation, with any persona, from the practitioner to the CISO. You're not a feature narrator. You teach why a demo is structured the way it is, what questions it's built to answer, and how to prove our value rather than just claim it. You'll partner closely with Product, PMM, Competitive Intelligence, and Enablement Programs to take in what's new, but you'll own how that knowledge is trained, framed, and put to work in the field. And you'll love owning the room, whether that's new hire bootcamp, a virtual session, or the main stage at an offsite.

Abnormal wasn't retrofitted with AI. We're built on it, and that's exactly the story you'll teach the field to tell. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. In July 2026, we extended our Behavioral AI platform beyond email into identity and AI security with the launch of Identity Threat Protection, Infiltration Prevention, and AI Governance. Every new product brings new demos, new competitors, and new POV motions, and you'll make sure our pre-sales team is ready for all of them.

What You Will Do

  • Own the technical core of new hire bootcamp. Deliver the foundations every seller needs: value-based selling, demo strategy and narrative, competitive positioning, and POV-focused technical education.
  • Lead live and virtual enablement for SEs and AEs. Run sessions that stay anchored in how sellers will apply what they learn and the outcomes customers care about.
  • Be the primary presenter on the big stages. Lead technical sessions at offsites and enablement events as the main voice in the room.
  • Teach the why, not just the what. Design training experiences around why specific capabilities matter, how sellers should talk about them, and what questions to ask and expect during demos and evaluations.
  • Keep every session sharp. Make sure each session is concise, structured, and built around a few clear top takeaways.
  • Evolve technical onboarding. Partner with Enablement Programs to own and continuously improve technical onboarding content, with a particular focus on demo, competitive, and POV readiness.
  • Set the bar for readiness. Partner with pre-sales management to define and enforce technical certification and readiness gates, and assess competency through live delivery, certification exercises, and observed execution.
  • Surface what you see. Identify readiness gaps, patterns, and risks across the team and bring them to leadership.
  • Run competitive deep dives. Help the field understand architectural differences, the strengths and limitations of competing approaches, and how to position Abnormal effectively in competitive conversations.
  • Train value-based POV execution. Teach pre-sales how to scope, narrate, and defend POV outcomes.
  • Stay current without losing the seller's lens. Collaborate with Competitive Intelligence, PMM, and Product so training reflects current market realities while staying focused on what sellers need.
  • Build content made for delivery. Partner with Enablement Programs and Content to create and evolve demo talk tracks and narratives, competitive frameworks and positioning guides, and technical POV enablement materials.
  • Choose clarity over completeness. Ruthlessly prioritize clarity and seller application over feature coverage, and keep refining content based on field feedback and observed execution.

Must Haves

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in pre-sales technical enablement, technical training, sales engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Strong cybersecurity domain knowledge, including email or identity security, plus familiarity with cloud-based SaaS architectures and common enterprise technologies.
  • Proven experience delivering live and virtual technical training to pre-sales audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to teach value-based demos, competitive positioning, and POV strategy, not just product functionality.
  • Excellent presentation presence, pacing, and audience engagement skills.
  • Ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, seller-focused takeaways.
  • Willingness to travel for bootcamps, offsites, and key enablement events.

Nice to Haves

  • Prior experience as a Sales Engineer or in a highly adjacent pre-sales role.
  • Experience training enterprise Sales Engineers or pre-sales teams at scale.
  • Strong cybersecurity background and an understanding of customer challenges across personas (practitioners, managers, and executives).
  • Familiarity with the competitive email or identity security landscape.
  • Experience designing or owning technical certification and readiness programs.
  • Strong partnership skills with Product, PMM, Competitive Intelligence, and Enablement Programs teams.
  • Background delivering technical enablement tied to deal execution and POVs.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$133,900—$192,500 USD

A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. raw.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


The Opportunity: Global Tax Lead

Tilt is hiring an International Tax Lead to own tax across all of Tilt's markets, in the US and internationally, including each new country we enter. You will be Tilt's tax subject-matter expert: the person Finance, Legal, Compliance, People and Product come to with tax questions, and the person who spots tax issues before they become problems.

We work with external tax advisors for preparation and specialist advice. You will direct and review their work, decide where we need outside help, and make sure every filing and position is accurate, on time and defensible. You report to the Head of Accounting and work closely with the finance leads in each market.


How You’ll Make an Impact

Lead and review external advisors

  • Manage Tilt's tax advisors in each country: scope the work, set calendars, review deliverables and hold firms to deadlines and budget

  • Review federal, state, and foreign income tax returns, indirect tax filings and withholding filings before they are filed

  • Evaluate advisor coverage and fees each year and recommend changes

Own global tax compliance and reporting

  • Maintain one global tax calendar covering all entities and jurisdictions

  • Own the quarterly and annual income tax provision (ASC 740), including foreign entities, uncertain tax positions and valuation allowances, and support the external audit

  • Oversee US international reporting, such as Forms 5471 and 5472, and the GILTI (global intangible low-taxed income) and Subpart F calculations

  • Oversee US state income, franchise and sales tax, and state business registrations and renewals

Cross-border and in-country tax

  • Own transfer pricing policy and documentation for intercompany services, loans and charges, and work with Accounting to book intercompany charges correctly

  • Manage withholding tax on cross-border payments, treaty eligibility and permanent establishment risk, including for remote employees and contractors

  • Partner with local finance teams and advisors on in-country corporate income tax, VAT and GST (value-added and goods-and-services tax) and lending-specific tax rules in each country where Tilt operates

  • Lead the tax workstream when Tilt enters a new country: entity and structure choices, registrations, advisor selection and the first year of filings

  • Respond to tax notices, inquiries and audits in every jurisdiction

Advise the business

  • Be the first call for tax questions from Finance, Legal, Compliance, People and Product

  • Review new products, pricing, fees, market entries, acquisitions and entity changes for tax impact before launch

  • Advise on equity compensation and payroll tax for a global workforce, working with People

  • Track tax law changes in each market and explain what they mean for Tilt in plain language

Build the function

  • Document tax processes and controls that meet audit standards

  • Improve how tax data flows from NetSuite and other finance systems

  • Look for planning opportunities that reduce Tilt's global tax cost within our risk appetite


Why You’re a Great Fit

  • 8+ years of corporate tax experience, combining a Big 4 or national accounting firm with in-house work at a multinational company

  • Hands-on experience with US international tax (GILTI, Subpart F, foreign tax credits, Forms 5471 and 5472) and transfer pricing

  • Strong ASC 740 tax provision experience, including foreign entities

  • A track record of managing and reviewing outside tax advisors across several countries

  • Working knowledge of US federal and state tax, and the judgment to know when to bring in a specialist

  • Ability to explain tax issues clearly to non-tax colleagues and leadership

  • Comfort working independently as a team of one in a fast-paced company, across time zones

  • Helpful but not required: experience with consumer lending, banking or fintech, including tax treatment of interest, fees and credit losses; tax experience in Latin American or Asian markets; experience integrating acquired foreign companies; experience with NetSuite

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

raw.description:
About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a hands-on Growth Lead to run the GTM experiment loop for our new self-serve business. This is a hybrid marketer and builder role: you’ll design tests against the self-serve funnel, build what’s needed to run them, interpret the results, and scale those that work.

What You’ll Do

Self-serve is a new business line at Higharc, and we’re placing bets in two parallel tracks, product and GTM. You’ll own the GTM experiment loop end to end. That means taking ideas from hypothesis to live test to a kill-or-scale decision fast.

You’ll build the landing pages, tooling, tracking, and automation each experiment needs, then judge the results with a sharp analytical eye. When something starts to feel magical, we shut down the weaker experiments and point more of the team at what’s working.

You’ll work closely with the Applications team and marketing, and both should see you as the fastest way to test an idea. The team works most often out of our Durham and NYC hubs.

Expect to:

  • Design and run rapid growth and PLG experiments across acquisition, activation, and conversion in the self-serve funnel

  • Build the landing pages, tooling, tracking, and automation needed to get each test live

  • Instrument the self-serve funnel well enough to see where people drop off and why

  • Interpret results and make fast kill-or-scale calls

  • Document and share experiment results so the team builds real signal over time

  • Move people and effort behind the experiments that work

  • Partner closely with the Applications team and marketing to turn ideas into live tests quickly and iteratively

About You

You’re part marketer, part builder, and your marketing instinct matters as much as your technical ability. You care more about speed and learning than polish, you’re fine throwing away work that didn’t pan out, and you can work with limited direction in a brand-new business line.

You own outcomes, stay steady when things are ambiguous, and can tell real signal from noise.

You have:

  • Experience shipping growth experiments end to end, ideally in a PLG or self-serve product

  • Hands-on technical skills: you’re comfortable writing code and working with analytics, automation, and AI tooling

  • Marketing instinct that carries as much weight as your technical ability

  • Strong analytical judgment and the honesty to call a failed test a failure

  • A preference for speed over polish

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to work with limited direction

  • A strong sense of ownership over the work and its results

A major plus if you also bring:

  • Experience building for or selling to homebuilders, or working in construction or AEC software

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

What You Can Expect

This role sits at the heart of Zoom's global indirect tax function, supporting end-to-end VAT and indirect tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions from our Ireland base. With compliance processes supported by automation, you will spend meaningful time on advisory work, process improvement, and AI-powered solutions that change how we manage tax at scale. Cross-functional collaboration is central to this position, connecting you with finance, engineering, and business teams across time zones. For someone energized by combining technical tax expertise with curiosity and a forward-thinking approach, this is a meaningful opportunity to shape how a global technology company manages its tax obligations.


About the Team

The indirect tax team at Zoom delivers global VAT and indirect tax compliance, strategic tax operations, and continuous improvement across the tax function. We work collaboratively across time zones to support the company's tax obligations with accuracy and efficiency. As part of Zoom's broader finance organization, our work enables business growth by ensuring tax accuracy and operational resilience at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end VAT and indirect tax compliance processes across multiple jurisdictions, from data review through submission and payment.
  • Execute VAT and indirect tax accounting during month-end and quarter-end close, including controls and management checks.
  • Support global e-invoicing, Continuous Transaction Controls, and digital tax reporting requirements in line with EU and international regulatory frameworks.
  • Partner with tax technology teams to identify automation opportunities and deliver AI-driven process improvements across the tax function.
  • Support audit responses and inquiries from tax authorities, third-party auditors, and internal teams, while assisting customer-facing teams with tax queries.
  • Contribute to US indirect tax and other tax areas as needed, broadening your expertise across the global tax function.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in indirect tax roles with multinational businesses, with demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-jurisdictional VAT and indirect tax compliance, GL accounting, and tax advisory, or equivalent experience.
  • In-house indirect tax experience preferred; Big Four experience also valued.
  • Proficiency with tax technology platforms such as Oracle, Avalara, or Zuora, and experience using AI or automation to improve tax processes.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP and its application to indirect tax processes in a multinational environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, comprehensive documentation; high attention to detail and accuracy across all deliverables.
  • Knowledge of the telecommunications industry and its relevance to indirect tax operations.
  • Exposure to US indirect tax is a plus.

€59,700.00 - €95,500.00

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations


Ways of Working

Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Vice President, Strategic Accounts


Position Summary


The Vice President, Strategic Accounts is responsible for leading Evolent’s strategic client relationships, driving retention and growth, and ensuring measurable value for clients and Evolent.

This leader serves as a trusted advisor to senior client executives and partners across clinical, operational, product, technology, finance, and commercial teams to execute account strategies, expand relationships, and deliver strong client and business outcomes.


What You Will Be Doing


Strategic Account Leadership

  • Lead Evolent’s strategically important client relationship(s)
  • Develop and execute multi-year account strategies aligned with client priorities and Evolent’s business objectives
  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite and senior client leaders
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for significant client opportunities, risks, and performance issues

Retention & Growth

  • Drive client retention, renewals, contract extensions, and expansion opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to broaden Evolent’s solutions within existing relationships
  • Lead strategic commercial discussions in partnership with Growth, Finance, Legal, Product, and other stakeholders
  • Maintain visibility into account health, competitive risks, and growth opportunities

Client Value & Execution

  • Ensure Evolent delivers measurable clinical, operational, and financial value and clearly communicate this value to clients
  • Partner with internal leaders to address performance gaps and advance client priorities
  • Mobilize cross-functional teams to resolve complex issues and execute strategic initiatives
  • Bring the voice of the customer into Evolent’s product, operating, and strategic priorities

Leadership

  • Establish clear expectations for executive relationship management, commercial discipline, and client accountability
  • Build organizational capability and succession across the Strategic Accounts function
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and client excellence

The Experience We Prefer

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, finance, or related field; advanced degree preferred
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare, managed care, healthcare services, or a related field

  • Demonstrated success driving client retention, renewals, expansion, and growth
  • Strong understanding of payer economics, healthcare operations, and value-based care
  • Experience leading complex negotiations and managing account economics
  • Proven ability to influence and execute across highly matrixed organizations
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing senior client-facing teams
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Technical Requirements:

We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. About the Role

Join a lean team at an early-stage AI-driven biotech company, owning computational and experimental work across protein design, laboratory testing, and model improvement. You will close the design-make-test loop, translating sequences into kinetics data and using results to improve the next round of designs.

What You'll Do

  • Improve discrete diffusion and companion folding models for peptide and protein design, including architecture refinements and hierarchical reasoning.

  • Operate and refine an inference platform, investigate usage patterns, and help scientists apply its outputs.

  • Write, debug, and maintain production protocols for liquid-handling robots and plate automation.

  • Run BLI and SPR workflows end to end, from assay design and immobilization through kinetic fitting and quality control.

  • Develop clear protocols for external laboratories and operate internal screening instrumentation.

  • Connect receptor biology, protein structure, scoring, and experimental results to identify failure modes and improve designs.

  • Support scientific platform users and customer workflows, including personalized technical outreach and navigating biotech and pharma purchasing processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Typically 3 to 11 years of relevant experience, including experience in biotech or life sciences software and customer-facing technical or commercial work.

  • Hands-on wet-lab experience and a background in biology, biochemistry, or a related life science.

  • Experience building or operating protein design, protein language, discrete diffusion, or structure prediction models in an experimental design-make-test cycle.

  • Practical use of tools such as ESM, ProtT5, RFdiffusion, BindCraft, or equivalents.

  • Personally developed and debugged production methods for Hamilton, Tecan, Opentrons, or equivalent liquid-handling platforms.

  • End-to-end BLI or SPR kinetic fitting experience, including diagnosing assay and measurement failure modes.

  • Python or equivalent scripting skills for automation and kinetic data analysis, plus an understanding of receptor biology, protein structure, and scoring.

  • Experience operating inference systems at scale, improving model architectures, and working across experimental biology, bioinformatics, and machine learning.

Compensation & Benefits

Consulting compensation is $3,000 to $5,000 per month. Full-time conversion offers a base salary of $80,000 to $200,000 annually, depending on experience, along with equity and deal-contingent upside. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid in New York, United States, with increased on-site presence expected as internal screening operations are established.

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

  • Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

  • Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

  • Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

  • Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of the role

GitLab is seeking an experienced Principal Field Security Engineer to tackle complex customer security challenges at the intersection of technical architecture and business requirements. In this role, you'll apply deep security expertise to answer technical questions, assess contract requirements, and enable GitLab’s Sales and field organizations to address security problems for enterprise customers. You'll work directly with customers and internal teams to provide technical guidance, create security content, and help customers understand how GitLab's security controls meet their compliance and risk management needs.

What you'll do:Customer Engagement & Assurance

  • Serve as the primary security point of contact for enterprise customer questions, requests, and concerns
  • Join customer and prospect meetings to provide expert guidance on GitLab’s security practices and controls in order to address security, privacy, and compliance requirements
  • Build and maintain templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and training that simplify and accelerate negotiations
  • Facilitate customer assurance activities through our Customer Assurance Activities Service Desk
  • Provide escalation support for complex security questionnaires, RFPs, and risk assessments

Contract & Legal Review

  • Perform comprehensive contract reviews for both customer agreements and vendor relationships
  • Analyze security and compliance clauses in legal documents
  • Provide risk-based recommendations and remediation guidance for contractual security requirements
  • Partner with Legal, Sales, Product, and Procurement teams to negotiate security-related contract terms. Manage escalations, collaborate across other teams, and develop solutions to enable team and business partners to close deals
  • Document and track contract-related security obligations

Security Evangelism & Thought Leadership

  • Act as a trusted technical thought leader, developing internal and external security content such as blog posts, whitepapers, technical standards, and field sales enablement training materials
  • Keep abreast of the rapidly evolving regulatory landscape affecting our agreements. Identify, track, and facilitate solutions for security related customer trends and improvement areas
  • Build and strengthen GitLab's security brand within the industry

Strategic Initiatives

  • Maintain and enhance GitLab's Trust Center and self-service security resources
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on customer security concerns in support of revenue growth
  • Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews to inform product and security roadmap decisions
  • Mentor and provide guidance to Security Assurance team members
  • Drive continuous improvement of Field Security processes and documentation
  • Design and implement solutions to enable Sales facing teams to successfully discuss security problems and topics with customers

What you'll bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in information security, with at least 5 years in customer-facing security roles
  • Deep expertise in security frameworks and standards such as (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, FedRAMP, NIST CSF, etc.)
  • Expertise in law and regulation such as (GDPR, CCPA, DORA, EU AI Act)
  • Proven track record of contract negotiation and security/privacy agreement reviews
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
  • Experience creating security content (blogs, whitepapers, presentations)
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, SaaS security models, and DevSecOps practices
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams
  • Ability to balance security risk with business objectives
  • Experience speaking at conferences is a plus
  • Preferred: One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or CIPP/CIPM. Equivalent demonstrated experience is equally valued.

Due to government requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to fill this position.

About the team

The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering.

You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. We work remote-first and asynchronously, and we write things down and share them openly, so you'll draft and revise policies and standards in the open with input from Security, Legal, Product, and Engineering.

AECOM is looking for a Mitigation Specialist to join our team. The Mitigation Specialist will assist local, state, tribal, and/or territorial clients with Hazard Mitigation Grant Program (HMGP) coordination and management. In this role, individuals will be responsible for working directly with clients to identify and develop projects, providing technical support and expertise in the development, submittal, and coordination of project documentation for FEMA review and approval. This position will be offered on a contingent basis, pending client request.

The Section 406 Mitigation Specialist responsibilities are as follows:

  • Provide technical guidance to clients navigating FEMA Hazard Mitigation Grant Program (HMGP) including application of Sections 404 and 406 as well as other related recovery programs.
  • Interpret and apply 44 CFR, Stafford Act, FEMA Hazard Mitigation Assistance (HMA) Program and Policy Guide, National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), and other applicable rules and regulations to evaluate and evaluate project documentation to support eligibility, scope accuracy, and cost reasonableness.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, and construction managers as needed to verify quantities, develop cost estimates, and reconcile discrepancies between site inspections and documentation.
  • Development of Benefit-Cost Analysis (BCA) for all identified projects.
  • Review project applications for compliance, eligibility, and feasibility; identify potential issues and/or resolutions prior to FEMA submission.
  • Draft and deliver program-specific guidance to sub-recipients.
  • Deliver customer service through day-to-day interactions with FEMA, state emergency management officers, and sub-recipients.
  • Maintain timely delivery while providing quality deliverables in compliance with AECOM quality standards.
  • Performs data entry into an electronic document management system.
  • Resolves routine questions and problems and refers more complex issues to higher/more experienced levels.
  • May prepare and maintain project filing system.
  • Assists in the receiving, processing, monitoring, and expediting of internal and external distribution of documentation.
  • Work alongside client teams to provide routine knowledge transfer, answer questions, and reinforce procedures for long-tern self-sufficiency.
  • Under general direction, applies advanced skills to the position.
  • Resolves problems using advanced techniques and procedures.
  • Ability to plan, organize, and complete assigned tasks.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university AND 4+ years of demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Successful candidate will have to pass a background check.
  • US Citizenship is a must, we are not able to sponsor for this role at this time or in the future.
  • A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy
  • Successful candidate will have to pass a drug and alcohol assessment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2 + years of past performance with FEMA HMA or other relevant programs at the state and/or federal level;
  • Experience delivering HMA Assistance on at two or more previous disasters.
  • Experience and practical knowledge of FEMA Categories and project worksheet development.
  • Possess flexibility to respond to and manage different tasks, often with competing priorities;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
  • Ability to work in a team environment;
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work independently.
  • Ability to deploy when activated to support disaster response and recovery efforts.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work outdoors in disaster-affected areas and navigate active debris operation sites while wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY FEBRUARY 8TH, 2027.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
