raw.excerpt: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
raw.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

About Us:

At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. We are seeking a Master DataOps Engineer to own the operational backbone — environments, CI/CD, and monitoring — for a large-scale Finance data platform modernization at a major US mortgage lender, so the platform being built is reliable and cost-governed from day one, not bolted on at the end.

Responsibilities:

Environment Provisioning & Platform Readiness

  • Own end-to-end environment provisioning and platform readiness across the full data stack — from SQL Server CDC source through Snowflake landing, raw, and curated layers — ahead of and during the build, with a formal readiness checklist delivered before sensitive-data build begins.

  • Provision and maintain Snowflake environments (DEV → QA → UAT → Prod) with dedicated, right-sized warehouses per workload class — replication/ingestion, curated-layer transformation, and BI serving — each with auto-suspend, resource monitors, and cost attribution from day one.

  • Coordinate Azure infrastructure provisioning: Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Azure Key Vault, self-hosted Azure DevOps agents, and VM infrastructure for the CDC replication tool — including firewall rules, TLS certificate requests, and DNS resolution for private Snowflake endpoints, all with documented lead times surfaced proactively.

  • Manage Snowflake RBAC provisioning: dedicated project-specific role hierarchy, clearly separated from broad IT, developer, analyst, and AI roles; positive and negative access tests executed before the environment is handed over to the build team.

  • Manage the full vendor and service account access lifecycle: named, individual, time-bound, least-privilege access for all delivery personnel; dedicated non-personal service accounts for replication, Snowflake, and BI integrations; credential storage and rotation via Azure Key Vault; revocation with documented evidence at engagement end.

CI/CD Pipeline Engineering

  • Build and operate the CI/CD pipeline for all data artifacts — transformation logic, metric definitions, replication configurations, Snowflake object DDL, and versioned SQL transformation models — using Azure DevOps Pipelines with YAML-based, version-controlled pipeline definitions.

  • Enforce a DEV → QA → UAT → Prod promotion path with branch policies, required reviewers, build validation on PRs, and written approval gates before any production deployment — no silent or automatic production changes.

  • Integrate automated regression, schema validation, row-count checks, and data quality assertions at every promotion stage — not only before go-live.

  • Externalize all environment-specific configuration from code; integrate Azure DevOps Variable Groups linked to Azure Key Vault so no credentials are stored as plaintext in pipeline definitions or repository files.

  • Integrate code scanning, dependency scanning, and IaC scanning (e.g., Checkov, Microsoft Defender for DevOps) into CI pipelines; remediate or formally document exceptions for all material findings before promotion to production.

  • Design, document, and rehearse rollback procedures for every promotion stage, including a full mock cutover and rollback rehearsal before the production readiness gate.

Monitoring, Alerting & Observability

  • Implement and own end-to-end pipeline monitoring using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics: replication health, CDC lag alerts, replication agent availability, Snowflake warehouse freshness against agreed SLA targets, schema-change and drift detection events at the landing zone, and semantic-definition change alerts.

  • Configure Azure Monitor Alert Rules routed via Action Groups to the client's approved ITSM tool (e.g., ServiceNow), with named alert owners, defined thresholds, and documented escalation paths — every alert fully operable by the client's DataOps team without vendor involvement post-handoff.

  • Enable and maintain Diagnostic Settings on all Azure resources (Key Vault, VMs, NSGs, Storage Accounts) feeding a centralized Log Analytics Workspace with appropriate retention, access control, and audit trails covering authentication, access grants, configuration changes, and deployments.

  • Implement Snowflake resource monitors and Azure Cost Management budget alerts for cost anomaly detection; produce periodic FinOps attribution reports by workload class.

Platform Cost Governance & FinOps

  • Own platform cost attribution and consumption monitoring across all Snowflake warehouses and Azure compute resources, with per-workload attribution established from day one using a consistent resource tagging strategy enforced via IaC.

  • Deliver a Snowflake and Azure cost model at architecture gate, including monitored budgets, right-sizing recommendations, and auto-suspend configurations — not estimated retrospectively.

  • Conduct periodic right-sizing reviews using Azure Advisor and Snowflake usage data; present findings in structured FinOps reviews with the client's Cloud Architecture team.

Infrastructure as Code

  • Manage all Azure infrastructure as code using Terraform (or Bicep where appropriate), including VNets, NSGs, Key Vault, VMs, storage accounts, Entra ID service principals, and RBAC role assignments — no manual portal configurations for anything that belongs in the production baseline.

  • Manage Snowflake object provisioning (databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, resource monitors) via the Snowflake Terraform provider, maintaining remote state in Azure Blob Storage with state locking.

  • Enforce configuration standards via Azure Policy guardrails (e.g., soft-delete on Key Vault, no public IPs on data resources, mandatory resource tagging) so IaC deployments are validated against policy before they reach production.

Architecture & Operational Documentation

  • Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and other living delivery artifacts alongside the Lead Architect — including network and connectivity design, environment topology, CI/CD promotion model, and security access design — in client-controlled repositories from the first commit.

  • Write and validate operational runbooks covering: replication failure, recovery, and resynchronization; CDC lag breach response; deployment and rollback procedures; reconciliation-discrepancy triage; access request and revocation workflows; cost-anomaly response; and incident routing via client ITSM — each exercised with the client's DataOps team before final handoff acceptance.

Knowledge Transfer & Client Engagement

  • Drive progressive knowledge transfer from the architecture phase onward through paired working sessions, shadowed deployments, and runbook exercises — not a single end-of-project handoff.

  • Act as the named point of contact for platform operations across the delivery team and the client's DataOps, Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure/Network, and Information Security teams — translating technical platform concerns into clear client-facing communications in fluent English.

  • Quantify and track client infrastructure dependencies — Snowflake environments, Azure network paths, service accounts, replication tool licensing, and production change windows — with named need-by dates and schedule-impact statements, escalating proactively when readiness is at risk.

Requirements:

  • Solid, hands-on experience in DataOps or platform engineering roles supporting a production cloud data platform end-to-end — covering provisioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and operational handoff.

  • Strong CI/CD experience for data pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), Git-based workflows with branch policies and approval gates, automated testing and regression gates, and multi-environment promotion paths.

  • Azure infrastructure fluency: Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Link and Private Endpoints, Azure Key Vault (secrets, certificates, and rotation), Microsoft Entra ID (service principals, managed identities, PIM, and access reviews), Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and Azure Cost Management.

  • Infrastructure as Code: hands-on Terraform experience including remote state management on Azure Blob Storage, the Snowflake Terraform provider, and IaC security scanning integrated into CI pipelines.

  • Snowflake platform experience: RBAC design, warehouse sizing and segregation, resource monitors, row-access policies, and dynamic data masking — experience across Enterprise or Business Critical editions preferred.

  • CDC replication pipeline monitoring and operations: experience monitoring and alerting on a CDC-based replication pipeline in production, including lag monitoring, restart and recovery procedures, and schema-drift detection at the landing layer.

  • Secrets management discipline: experience managing pipeline credentials via Azure Key Vault with no plaintext credentials in repositories or pipeline definitions, and documented rotation procedures.

  • Security-aware development practices: experience integrating code scanning, dependency scanning, and IaC scanning into CI pipelines; familiarity with least-privilege access design and audit logging requirements in regulated or sensitive-data environments.

  • Platform cost governance as a named responsibility: experience owning FinOps attribution, budget alerts, and right-sizing reviews — not as a shared or ambient concern.

  • Fluent English (B2+): this role is the named client-facing point of contact for all platform operations topics across delivery and client teams.

Nice to Have

  • Qlik Replicate: hands-on configuration of full-load and CDC replication — source and target endpoint setup, table scoping, schema-evolution handling, throttling and change-window management, latency monitoring, and restart and recovery procedures.

  • Azure SQL Server / SQL Server on Azure VM: familiarity with CDC prerequisites (SQL Server Agent, capture jobs, and service account permissions), connectivity requirements for private Azure environments, and coordination with DBA teams on change windows and backup schedules.

  • Microsoft Fabric / OneLake: operational experience with capacity management, landing-zone health, and monitoring in a Fabric environment.

  • Azure ExpressRoute and hybrid networking: experience designing or operating the connectivity layer between on-premises SQL Server instances and cloud-hosted data infrastructure.

  • Microsoft Entra ID Privileged Identity Management (PIM): experience implementing just-in-time access with approval workflows and audit trails for vendor and contractor access in a client environment.

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central / SQL Server source systems: familiarity with Business Central table structures, company-prefixed naming conventions, and schema-drift risk from vendor-managed upgrades.

  • Power BI semantic model operations: familiarity with workspace publication, scheduled refresh configuration, and gateway management in a governed enterprise deployment.

  • Production runbook authorship and knowledge transfer facilitation: demonstrated experience writing runbooks that a client's operations team can execute without vendor support, and leading structured knowledge transfer with competency-evidence checkpoints.

  • Mortgage, lending, or financial-services environments: experience operating under strict change-control discipline with sensitive financial data and audit-trail requirements covering every access and deployment event.

  • dbt or dbt-style versioned SQL transformation frameworks: experience operating dbt in a CI/CD pipeline — running tests, managing model promotion, and debugging failed runs in a Snowflake environment.

Our benefits:

-Health and dental insurance
-Meal and food allowance
-Childcare assistance
-Extended paternity leave
-Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
-Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);
-Life insurance
-Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);
-Discount club
-Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being
-Pregnancy and responsible parenting course
-Partnerships with online learning platforms
-Language learning platform
And many more!

See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here.This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it.
We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.

raw.title: Senior CRM Manager - Conversion & Lifecycle
raw.excerpt: Join our expanding Product Growth team!  We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA.
raw.description:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

The Impact 💚

You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.

🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.

🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.

Phase 2: Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.

Phase 3: Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.

Phase 4: Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:

  • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

  • Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

  • Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

  • Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

  • Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

Key Metrics You'll Influence

Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale

Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality

Campaign ROI and payback period across both

Your Environment

💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging

Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

What You Need

  • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

  • Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

  • Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would.

  • Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation.

  • Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here.

  • Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods.

Location & Benefits

  • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Description

We are seeking Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a project focused on advancing music and audio technology.

In this role, you will listen to short field recordings and accurately document audible details, including instruments, tempo, musical key, background sounds, and crowd reactions. You will use a structured web-based platform to complete annotations and, in later project phases, evaluate AI-generated descriptions against the actual audio recordings.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Listen to 30–90-second field recordings using headphones in a quiet workspace and complete structured annotations covering:
    • Instruments present in the recording.
    • Tempo and musical key.
    • Timestamps of background events such as traffic, sirens, and applause.
    • Relevant audio scene details.
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and identify similarities and differences.
  3. Review AI-generated descriptions of audio clips and identify accurate, incorrect, or fabricated information, providing brief written explanations.
  4. Attend paid onboarding and calibration sessions, along with short weekly project syncs.

Preferred Backgrounds

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are encouraged to apply:

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, music producers, or mixing engineers.
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band or choir directors, and conservatory students or graduates.
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast and documentary audio editors.

Required Qualifications

  1. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in music or audio-related work.
  2. Strong analytical listening skills, with the ability to identify individual instruments in busy, noisy, real-world audio recordings—not just studio recordings.
  3. Ability to identify tempo within a few BPM and recognize musical keys. Relative pitch with a reference is acceptable.
  4. Comfort with detailed and repetitive annotation tasks using web-based platforms, including dropdowns, timestamps, and structured notes.
  5. Clear written English skills for brief, evidence-based feedback (e.g., identifying when an accordion enters a recording).
  6. Access to quality headphones, a quiet workspace, and a reliable internet connection.
  7. Availability of 20–25 hours per week throughout the engagement period.

Interview language: English

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Senior Video Editing Quality Assurance Specialist (SME) to review and evaluate AI-generated and human-edited video content, ensuring professional post-production quality, technical accuracy, visual consistency, and adherence to project-specific guidelines.You will assess video outputs for editing quality, pacing, continuity, transitions, color grading, audio synchronization, storytelling, technical specifications, and overall production standards. You will identify editing errors, provide precise written feedback, compare multiple video outputs, and help establish consistent quality expectations across video editing and AI training projects.

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your professional video editing expertise will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by making their video understanding, editing, and generation capabilities more accurate, consistent, and aligned with professional production standards.Portfolio requirementMandatory: As a part of selection process, applicants must ready to provide a working link to a professional video demo reel or portfolio that can be accessed by the SuperAnnotate team.The portfolio should demonstrate professional editing capabilities, preferably including commercial, broadcast, film, television, or advanced digital video projects.

Your profile

  • 5+ years of professional video editing experience in film, television, broadcast, advertising, commercial production, digital media, or related post-production environments.
  • English proficiency at C1–C2 level to understand complex project guidelines, communicate technical feedback, and provide detailed written evaluations in English.
  • Advanced proficiency in at least two non-linear editing (NLE) systems, with Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred. Experience with Avid Media Composer or Final Cut Pro is also valuable.
  • Previous experience as a Lead Editor, Senior Video Editor, Post-Production Supervisor, QC Coordinator, or in a comparable quality-focused production role.
  • A shareable professional video demo reel or portfolio is mandatory, and must be accessible to the SuperAnnotate team for evaluation.
  • Deep understanding of editing fundamentals, including pacing, continuity, shot selection, narrative structure, transitions, visual composition, and storytelling.
  • Strong knowledge of video technical standards, including frame rates, resolutions, codecs, containers, aspect ratios, color spaces, export settings, and broadcast/digital delivery specifications.
  • Experience with color correction, color grading, audio editing, synchronization, sound mixing, subtitles, captions, and motion graphics.
  • Ability to identify subtle editing defects, including jump cuts, continuity errors, dropped frames, audio drift, inconsistent color, compression artifacts, inappropriate transitions, and technical delivery issues.
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to explain why an edit does or does not meet professional standards.
  • Experience reviewing other editors' work, providing structured feedback, conducting technical QC, or supervising post-production workflows.
  • Reliable, self-directed, and able to maintain consistent quality in an hourly, remote contractor environment across time zones.
  • Prior experience with AI-generated video evaluation, AI data training, video annotation, multimedia QA, or rubric-based evaluation is a strong plus.

Key responsibilities

  • Evaluate video editing quality: Review edited and AI-generated video content for pacing, continuity, transitions, storytelling, visual consistency, audio quality, and professional production standards.
  • Perform technical quality assurance: Identify frame-rate inconsistencies, dropped frames, codec issues, color mismatches, synchronization problems, compression artifacts, and export-related defects.
  • Optimize AI video performance: Evaluate and compare AI-generated video outputs, identifying visual artifacts, temporal inconsistencies, unnatural motion, continuity problems, and editing-quality issues.
  • Develop AI training content: Create expert-level editing scenarios, reference examples, quality assessments, and structured feedback that reflect real-world post-production standards.
  • Ensure production consistency: Evaluate adherence to creative briefs, editing instructions, style guides, technical specifications, and project-specific rubrics.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly document video editing errors, explain their impact, and recommend appropriate corrections using professional editing terminology.
  • Support quality calibration: Help establish consistent evaluation standards across editors, reviewers, and video quality assessment workflows.
  • Maintain professional standards: Ensure reviewed content meets expectations for visual storytelling, technical delivery, audio-visual coherence, and overall production quality.

Who are we?

At Hadrian, that's exactly what we're building: the future of offensive cybersecurity, powered by autonomous AI agents that think like hackers. Founded in Amsterdam in 2021, we're on a mission to change the way organisations defend themselves by helping them find and fix security weaknesses before attackers can exploit them.

Our platform brings together two products: Atlas, which continuously maps an organisation's external attack surface and validates which exposures are genuinely exploitable, and Nova, which uses AI agents to perform in-depth penetration testing on demand. Together, they give security teams the visibility and proof they need to focus on what really matters and stay ahead of emerging threats.

Backed by $65M in total funding, including our recent $40M Series B led by Forgepoint Capital International and SmartFin, we're investing in the next generation of autonomous offensive security and expanding our impact across global markets. With a team spanning 25+ countries and offices in Amsterdam, London, and New York, we're helping organisations rethink what's possible in cybersecurity.

raw.title: Product Manager, Consumer & Mobile Applications
raw.excerpt: About SunStrong Management SunStrong Management is an independent asset manager for renewable energy infrastructure — roughly 6 GW under management, including more than 500,000 residential solar and storage systems and 900+ commercial and utility-scale assets across 50+ markets.
raw.description:
About SunStrong Management

SunStrong Management is an independent asset manager for renewable energy infrastructure — roughly 6 GW under management, including more than 500,000 residential solar and storage systems and 900+ commercial and utility-scale assets across 50+ markets. We sit between asset owners and the day-to-day reality of keeping systems online: operations and maintenance, field service, customer care, billing and collections, and investor reporting.

We were built by solar-industry veterans who stepped in to keep systems producing when others stepped back. We are growing quickly — through portfolio acquisitions and organic expansion — and we run one operational standard at every scale. We make decisions with data, we measure what we manage, and we expect the systems we build to prove their value in the numbers.

The Opportunity

For most homeowners, the mobile app is SunStrong. It is where they pay a bill, ask a question, book a technician, and check whether the system on their roof is doing its job. Today that experience is fragmented. Many of the 500,000+ homeowners we serve came to us through the failure of the companies that installed and financed their systems, and they inherited those companies' apps along with their solar. Some of those apps still run, some run poorly, and none were designed to work together or to be part of one coherent customer experience.

We are hiring a Product Manager, Consumer and Mobile Applications to own the vision, roadmap, and execution for everything homeowners touch on their phones. You will decide how to absorb and gracefully evolve the legacy applications we have taken on — what to keep running, what to migrate, what to retire, and how to move customers without losing their trust — and you will build entirely new capability on top: customer care, bill payment, field service requests, and independent monitoring of a homeowner's own generation assets, free of any single OEM's portal.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and works directly with Customer Care, Servicing and Collections, Field Service Operations, Fleet Telemetry, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, and the design team. The goal is plain: make SunStrong the industry leader in elegant self-service for homeowners, measured by adoption, resolution without a phone call, and on-time payment.

What You'll Do

Set the vision and roadmap
  • Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for SunStrong's homeowner-facing mobile and web applications, and defend the sequencing to executive stakeholders and operating teams.
  • Define the end-to-end homeowner experience across care, payment, service, and monitoring, so that the product feels like one SunStrong rather than a collection of inherited parts.
Absorb and evolve the legacy applications
  • Inventory the inherited consumer apps from bankrupt providers — what each does, who still uses it, what it costs to run, and what risk it carries — and decide which to sustain, migrate, consolidate, or retire.
  • Plan and lead customer migrations that preserve trust: account and credential continuity, payment-method and autopay transfers, communication plans, store listing and release management, and clear sunset dates.
  • Evaluate build, buy, and partner options for the target platform, and document the recommendation, its basis, and the operating cost of each path.
Build the next generation of homeowner self-service
  • Deliver elegant self-service for customer care, including account management, case creation and status, knowledge and guided troubleshooting, and handoff to an agent when the app cannot resolve the issue.
  • Deliver bill pay and billing transparency: invoices, payment methods, autopay, payment plans, and delinquency communications that are clear, compliant, and respectful of the customer.
  • Deliver field service requests end to end: request, scheduling, technician tracking, and resolution, integrated with the Field Service and Salesforce teams.
  • Define independent monitoring for homeowners' own generation and storage assets, working with Fleet Telemetry so that production, system health, and alerts are accurate and are not tied to any single OEM portal.
Lead with data
  • Define and own the metrics this product is accountable for: monthly active users, legacy-to-SunStrong migration rate, self-service resolution and call-deflection rate, on-time payment and autopay adoption, field-service request completion, app store rating, crash-free sessions, and cost to serve.
  • Instrument features before launch, run experiments, and report on realized value after release rather than only on delivery.
  • Run continuous discovery with homeowners, customer care agents, and field technicians, and bring evidence rather than opinion to prioritization debates.
Operate across the organization
  • Serve as the connective tissue between Customer Care, Servicing and Collections, Field Service Operations, Fleet Telemetry, Engineering, Design, Legal and Compliance, and external vendors.
  • Ensure the products meet the obligations attached to consumer servicing: PCI-DSS for payment handling, consumer privacy and consent, accessibility, FDCPA and UDAAP considerations in collections communications, and app store policy requirements.
  • Write requirements engineers can build from on the first pass, own launch readiness including data migration, testing, support training, and adoption, and communicate trade-offs clearly to audiences from customer care agents to the executive team.
What Success Looks Like

First 30 days — You have inventoried every inherited and current consumer application, quantified usage, cost, and risk for each, and talked with homeowners and care agents about where the experience breaks. The VP of Product Management and operating leaders are aligned behind a prioritized problem inventory and a proposed disposition (sustain, migrate, or retire) for each legacy app.

First 90 days — A published, funded 12-month roadmap and target-state experience; a build, buy, or partner decision made and approved; the first legacy-app migration underway with a defined sunset date; and one new self-service capability in production with measured movement on a named baseline metric.

12 months — A majority of homeowners who use an app are on the unified SunStrong experience; legacy apps with a retirement plan are retired or on a dated path to it; and bill pay, care, and field service requests are available in-app. Call deflection, on-time payment, and app store ratings have improved against the baselines, and the first independent monitoring release is in homeowners' hands.

Required Qualifications
  • 6+ years in product management, owning consumer-facing software products end to end — discovery through launch and iteration.
  • 3+ years owning native mobile applications (iOS and Android) in production, including app store release management, versioning, and the day-to-day realities of supporting a live consumer user base.
  • Demonstrated experience with transactional consumer flows such as account management, payments or billing, and customer support, where accuracy and trust matter as much as polish.
  • Experience migrating, consolidating, or sunsetting applications or platforms — moving real users from an old product to a new one without losing them.
  • Strong analytical skills: SQL fluency, product analytics, and experimentation, with the habit of defining success metrics before building.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between engineering detail and executive summary without losing either audience.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives to completion and earning followership without formal authority.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in solar, distributed energy, utilities, telecom, or another business with a large installed base and a field service component.
  • Experience building monitoring or device-data experiences for consumers, including production dashboards, alerting, and connected-device or IoT applications.
  • Experience in consumer financial services or fintech subject to payments and collections regulation (PCI-DSS, FDCPA, UDAAP, state requirements).
  • Experience integrating customer-facing apps with Salesforce Field Service and Service Cloud, billing, ERP, or payments platforms.
  • Experience integrating products and customers following an acquisition or portfolio transition.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), design systems, and applying AI to customer self-service, such as guided troubleshooting and agent handoff.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, design, or a related field; advanced degree welcome but not required.
Location: San Francisco, CA · Houston, TX · or Remote (U.S.)

We believe better information leads to better decisions, and better decisions lead to better health outcomes. 4DMedical is committed to helping Veterans dealing with deployment-related respiratory diseases and toxic exposures.

Founded in Melbourne, Australia, 4DMedical is an ASX-listed company with a growing international presence and a strong focus on the U.S. healthcare market. Our portfolio brings together pulmonary function and structural imaging technologies to provide healthcare professionals with new ways to understand lung structure and function.

At 4DMedical, our people are central to our success. We value innovation, impact, collaboration, excellence, and a shared commitment to improving healthcare for people living with lung disease

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Events Manager to lead the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of 4DMedical’s conference, trade-show, symposia, webinar, and customer event program.

This role will build efficient, repeatable event-management processes, ensure events support commercial and strategic priorities, and deliver consistent, high-quality experiences for customers, partners, and internal teams.

A key part of the role is developing strategic relationships with medical societies and conference organizers to identify opportunities that enhance 4DMedical’s visibility, thought leadership, education, and engagement at priority events.

The Events Manager will work cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, MCA, leadership, key opinion leaders (KOLs), vendors, and external partners to plan programs, manage budgets and logistics, measure results, and continuously improve event performance.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to build and lead a more strategic, scalable event-management function.
  • High-impact role partnering with medical societies, clinical experts, and commercial leaders.
  • Broad ownership across conferences, trade shows, symposia, webinars, customer events, and educational programs.
  • Work with a knowledgeable, experienced, high-achieving, and collaborative team.
  • Opportunity to support innovative technologies that can make a meaningful difference for patients with lung conditions.

What You’ll Do

Event Strategy, Portfolio Planning & Process Improvement

  • Develop and manage an annual event strategy and calendar aligned with 4DMedical’s commercial, clinical, educational, and brand priorities.
  • Establish standardized workflows, timelines, templates, checklists, approval pathways, and documentation to improve event efficiency, visibility, and consistency.
  • Lead event scoping, prioritization, budgeting, forecasting, and resource planning.
  • Monitor event expenditure and identify opportunities to improve value, efficiency, and overall impact.
  • Maintain clear event briefs, project plans, stakeholder responsibilities, risks, timelines, and key decision points.
  • Conference, Trade show & Event Execution
  • Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of conferences, trade shows, regional meetings, dinner events, webinars, symposium, and conference sessions.
  • Coordinate venues, exhibit services, production, registration, travel, shipping, speaker logistics, hospitality, sponsorship deliverables, and on-site requirements.
  • Manage agencies, exhibit partners, venues, vendors, and contractors, including negotiating scopes of work and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Coordinate event messaging, creative assets, collateral, product demonstrations, staffing, training, lead capture, and post-event follow-up in collaboration with Marketing, Sales, MCA, and other internal teams.
  • Provide in-person event leadership and support as required, including on-site coordination, issue resolution, and post-event closeout.

Medical Society & Strategic Partnerships

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with medical societies, conference organizers, and education partners.
  • Identify and evaluate sponsorship opportunities, educational programs, speaking engagements, advisory activities, and other initiatives that strengthen 4DMedical’s presence at priority events.
  • Develop mutually valuable partnership opportunities that support audience engagement, thought leadership, education, and long-term brand visibility.
  • Represent 4DMedical professionally with external organizations and partners.
  • Ensure external commitments, sponsorship obligations, and deliverables are clearly documented, communicated, and completed.

Measurement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Define clear objectives and success measures for priority events, including participation, engagement, lead quality, follow-up, budget performance, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Conduct post-event reviews and provide timely reporting, insights, and recommendations to Marketing, Sales, and leadership.
  • Use event-performance data, commercial outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to improve event selection, planning, execution, and return on investment.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance event processes, attendee experiences, internal coordination, and overall program effectiveness.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Hospitality, Event Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ relevant event-management experience, including ownership of complex conferences, tradeshows, corporate events, or similar large-scale events.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex events, projects, priorities, and deadlines concurrently.
  • Demonstrated experience managing event budgets, vendors, contracts, negotiations, logistics, and on-site execution.
  • Strong project-management, organizational, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, MCA, leadership, agencies, vendors, and external partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence representing 4DMedical externally.
  • Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach with the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
  • Ability to travel domestically and occasionally internationally, including providing on-site support outside standard business hours when required.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated B2B environment.
  • Experience developing relationships and programs with professional or medical societies, healthcare associations, or conference organizations.
  • Established relationships within relevant medical societies, professional healthcare associations, or healthcare conference organizations.
  • Experience developing educational programs, symposia, webinars, or speaker-led events for healthcare professionals.
  • Experience supporting conferences and events across multiple regions or markets.
  • Experience with experiential marketing programs and other customer-facing brand activations.
  • Familiarity with event-management platforms, registration systems, and event technology.
  • Experience using CRM-based lead capture and post-event performance reporting.
  • Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of how events contribute to brand visibility, customer engagement, education, and business growth.
  • Experience developing efficient, repeatable event-management processes and frameworks.

Salary

Base salary: $100,000 to $130,000 USD per year PLUS benefits.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate's relevant experience, qualifications, clinical background, credentials, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

Reasonable business-related travel and other approved expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with 4DMedical's applicable expense policies.

Benefits
As a member of the 4DMedical U.S. team, you'll have access to a competitive benefits package designed to support your health, well being, and work-life balance, including:

Medical health insurance.

Dental insurance.

Vision insurance.

401(k) benefits, including employer contributions in accordance with the applicable 4DMedical plan.

20 paid vacation days per year for full-time employees, comprising 15 flexible vacation days and five fixed company vacation days.

Paid U.S. company holidays.

Company-provided technology and equipment appropriate to the role.

Reimbursement of reasonable business-related expenses in accordance with company policy.

Opportunities for professional growth and development within an innovative global medical technology company.

Veterans Encouraged to Apply
4DMedical strongly encourages veterans, transitioning service members, members of the National Guard and Reserves, and military spouses to apply.
Equal Employment Opportunity
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees and to maintaining a workplace free from unlawful discrimination.
4DMedical does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
4DMedical provides an inclusive work environment and embraces the diverse talent of its people.

How to Apply
If you're passionate about improving healthcare through innovative technology and enjoy working at the intersection of clinical practice, education, medical imaging, and customer success, we'd love to hear from you.
Submit a current CV and a Cover Letter(Mandatory) which details your alignment with the requirements of the role. Applications that do not have a Cover Letter will not be considered.

About XPUP

Všechno začalo docela jednoduše: hledali jsme lidi s těmi správnými digitálními dovednostmi, nemohli jsme je najít, tak jsme si řekli – výborně, vyškolíme si je sami.

Z toho malého projektu v Tbilisi v roce 2018 vyrostla globální Edtech platforma s více než 30 000 absolventy.

Naše programy tvoří lidé z praxe. Vycházejí z toho, co firmy opravdu potřebují. A učíme v prostředí, kde se spolupracuje, ptá se a roste.

V roce 2023 jsme se dali dohromady sTetherem, abychom to, co děláme, posunuli dál – za hranice, k lidem po celém světě, kteří chtějí vzdělávání, které je skutečně posune.

Dnes připravujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketéry, designéry, programátory, tvůrce. Lidi, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale chtějí něco měnit. Držíme se hodnot, kterými opravdu žijeme: lidé jsou na prvním místě, zůstáváme zvědaví, děláme skvělou práci a bereme za ni odpovědnost. A teď to teprve začíná.

Lead máme. Zájem máme. Teď potřebujeme někoho, kdo to umí dotáhnout.

Hledáme zkušeného closera, který dokáže ty, co zvažují změnu, dovést k samotnému rozhodnutí investovat do sebe samých.

Tahle role není o „péči o zákazníka“. Je to role s jasnou orientací na výsledky revenue, konverze a počet zapsaných studentů. Jde tu o tah na branku, práci s rozhodováním a uzavírání obchodů.

Co budeš dělat

Budeš mluvit s lidmi, kteří už o změně přemýšlí – chtějí novou kariéru, lepší skillset, posun v životě.

Tvůj úkol?

  • Pomoci jim přestat váhat a udělat konkrétní krok – koupit si kurz

  • Povedeš celý proces od prvního callu až po zaplacení

  • Budeš pracovat s inboundem, outboundem i vlastní pipeline

  • Budeš řídit tempo, ne čekat

  • Poradíš si s námitkami (cena, čas, důvěra, konkurence) denodenně

  • Tady se nehraje na „ozvi se, až budeš ready“

  • Tady se rozhodnutí dělají teď a s tebou

Requirements

Co od tebe potřebujeme

  • Min. 3 roky v B2C sales, kde jsi nesl/a target

  • Zkušenost s prodejem vzdělávání nebo služeb, kde se zákazník rozmýšlí

  • Reálné výsledky – ne pocit, ale čísla

  • Schopnost jet samostatně a neztrácet tempo

  • Rozumíš tomu, jak přemýšlí český zákazník

  • Umíš prodat hodnotu, ne cenu

  • A když přijde námitka, víš, že to není konec, ale začátek práce

Tohle není pro tebe, pokud:

  • Čekáš, až se zákazník rozhodne sám

  • Potřebuješ skripty na každou větu

  • Prodáváš hlavně slevou

  • Máš zkušenosti spíš z B2B než z přímého prodeje lidem

Co za to

  • Remote spolupráce

  • Velká míra svobody

  • Přístup ke všem našim kurzům + benefity pro rodinu

  • Referral program

  • Paid Time Off

  • Tým, kde se maká – ale zároveň drží při sobě

The Account Supervisor is responsible for assuring and maintaining client satisfaction as the primary client point of contact. The Account Supervisor serves as a liaison between client services leadership, strategy, and internal operations and is responsible for the success and profitability of all support projects.

  • Development of client agendas and slide presentations
  • Lead and/or support calls with client and LMR, faculty, and/or content experts regarding content and direction

Minimum Required:
